These findings reveal that optimal gain selection depends not on the desired task behavior, but on the learning paradigm employed. Project website: https://younghyopark.me/tune-to-learn

AI.tldr: 研究探讨位置控制器增益选择对机器人学习的影响，发现最佳增益取决于学习范式而非任务行为
AI.motivation: 传统基于任务刚度选择控制器增益的方法在与状态条件策略结合时失效，因为有效刚度源于学习反应与控制动力学的交互。需要研究增益选择如何影响学习算法的可学习性
AI.method: 系统研究位置控制器增益对现代机器人学习三大核心组件的影响：行为克隆、从零开始的强化学习、仿真到现实的迁移。在多个任务和机器人平台上进行广泛实验
AI.result: 1) 行为克隆受益于柔顺和过阻尼增益机制；2) 强化学习在所有增益机制中都能成功，但需要兼容的超参数调优；3) 仿真到现实迁移受到刚性和过阻尼增益机制的损害
AI.conclusion: 最优增益选择不取决于期望的任务行为，而取决于采用的学习范式。增益选择应基于可学习性而非传统刚度考虑

title: Not All Denoising Steps Are Equal: Model Scheduling for Faster Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Recent advances in masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) narrow the quality gap to autoregressive LMs, but their sampling remains expensive because generation requires many full-sequence denoising passes with a large Transformer and, unlike autoregressive decoding, cannot benefit from KV caching. In this work, we exploit the flexibility of the diffusion framework and study model scheduling, where a smaller MDLM replaces the full model at a subset of denoising steps. On OpenWebText, we show that early and late denoising steps are substantially more robust to such replacement than middle steps, enabling up to a 17% reduction in FLOPs with only modest degradation in generative perplexity. We support these findings with a step-importance analysis based on loss and KL divergence between small and large models across timesteps, as well as an exhaustive search over coarse step segments, both of which identify the middle of the diffusion trajectory as most sensitive. Our results suggest that simple, architecture-agnostic scheduling rules can significantly accelerate MDLM sampling while largely preserving generation quality as measured by generative perplexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何通过模型调度策略加速掩码扩散语言模型的采样过程，发现用小型模型替换大型模型在扩散过程的早期和晚期步骤中效果更好，可减少17%的计算量而质量下降有限。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）在质量上已接近自回归语言模型，但其采样过程计算成本高，需要多次全序列去噪过程，且无法像自回归解码那样受益于KV缓存。因此需要寻找方法来加速MDLM的采样过程。
AI.method: 提出模型调度策略，在部分去噪步骤中用小型MDLM替换大型模型。通过基于损失和KL散度的步骤重要性分析，以及粗粒度步骤段的穷举搜索，确定扩散轨迹中不同步骤对模型替换的敏感度。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText数据集上，发现早期和晚期去噪步骤对模型替换的鲁棒性显著高于中间步骤，可实现高达17%的FLOPs减少，而生成困惑度仅有适度下降。分析表明扩散轨迹的中间部分最为敏感。
AI.conclusion: 简单、架构无关的调度规则可以显著加速MDLM采样，同时在生成困惑度指标上基本保持生成质量。这为扩散语言模型的高效采样提供了实用方法。

title: Engagement Is Not Transfer: A Withdrawal Study of a Consumer Social Robot with Autistic Children at Home
summary: This study examines whether engagement with social robots translates into improved human-directed social abilities in autistic children. We conducted an 8-week home-based randomized controlled trial with 40 children aged 5--9 using a commercial social robot (Qrobot). Families were assigned to either continued robot access or robot withdrawal. Quantitative measures and caregiver interviews assessed anxiety, social motivation, emotion inference, and empathy. Results showed that continued robot access significantly reduced anxiety, confirming strong affective benefits and high usability. However, children in the withdrawal group demonstrated greater improvements in social motivation, emotion understanding, and empathic behaviors toward caregivers and peers. Qualitative findings revealed a "handoff versus siloing" pattern: withdrawal promoted reorientation toward human social interaction, while continued access concentrated engagement within the child--robot dyad and limited transfer to real-world contexts. We interpret these results as evidence that high engagement does not guarantee social transfer.

AI.tldr: 社交机器人干预对自闭症儿童的影响：持续接触降低焦虑但阻碍社交能力向人类转移，而撤回机器人反而促进社交动机和情感理解发展
AI.motivation: 研究社交机器人参与度是否能够转化为自闭症儿童对人类社交能力的改善，探索机器人干预对社交转移效果的影响
AI.method: 8周家庭随机对照试验，40名5-9岁自闭症儿童使用商业社交机器人Qrobot，分为持续接触组和撤回组，通过定量测量和照顾者访谈评估焦虑、社交动机、情绪推理和共情
AI.result: 持续接触组显著降低焦虑，确认强烈情感效益和高可用性；撤回组在社交动机、情绪理解和共情行为方面改善更大，表现出"交接vs隔离"模式：撤回促进重新定向人类社交，持续接触限制向现实世界转移
AI.conclusion: 高参与度不能保证社交转移，机器人撤回可能通过促进重新定向人类社交互动而带来更大社交效益，需要平衡机器人参与和人类社交转移

title: Beyond Message Passing: A Semantic View of Agent Communication Protocols
summary: Agent communication protocols are becoming critical infrastructure for large language model (LLM) systems that must use tools, coordinate with other agents, and operate across heterogeneous environments. This work presents a human-inspired perspective on this emerging landscape by organizing agent communication into three layers: communication, syntactic, and semantic. Under this framework, we systematically analyze 18 representative protocols and compare how they support reliable transport, structured interaction, and meaning-level coordination. Our analysis shows a clear imbalance in current protocol design. Most protocols provide increasingly mature support for transport, streaming, schema definition, and lifecycle management, but offer limited protocol-level mechanisms for clarification, context alignment, and verification. As a result, semantic responsibilities are often pushed into prompts, wrappers, or application-specific orchestration logic, creating hidden interoperability and maintenance costs. To make this gap actionable, we further identify major forms of technical debt in today's protocol ecosystem and distill practical guidance for selecting protocols under different deployment settings. We conclude by outlining a research agenda for interoperable, secure, and semantically robust agent ecosystems that move beyond message passing toward shared understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个三层框架（通信、句法、语义）来分析18种智能体通信协议，发现当前协议设计存在不平衡：传输和句法层支持成熟，但语义层机制不足，导致语义责任被推给提示词、包装器或应用逻辑，产生技术债务。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型系统需要工具使用、多智能体协调和异构环境操作，智能体通信协议变得至关重要。当前缺乏系统性的协议分析框架，且协议设计存在不平衡，语义层支持不足导致技术债务和互操作性问题。
AI.method: 提出人类启发的三层框架（通信层、句法层、语义层），系统分析18种代表性协议，评估它们在可靠传输、结构化交互和意义级协调方面的支持程度，识别技术债务形式并提供协议选择指导。
AI.result: 分析显示当前协议设计明显不平衡：大多数协议在传输、流式处理、模式定义和生命周期管理方面支持成熟，但在澄清、上下文对齐和验证等协议级语义机制方面有限。语义责任被推给提示词、包装器或应用特定编排逻辑，产生隐藏的互操作性和维护成本。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越消息传递，实现共享理解的互操作、安全和语义鲁棒的智能体生态系统。论文提出了研究议程，包括识别技术债务、提供协议选择指导，以及推动语义层协议机制的发展。

title: SentinelAgent: Intent-Verified Delegation Chains for Securing Federal Multi-Agent AI Systems
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Includes TLA+ mechanical verification, DelegationBench v4 benchmark (516 scenarios), live LangChain agent integration, and independent red-team evaluation
summary: When Agent A delegates to Agent B, which invokes Tool C on behalf of User X, no existing framework can answer: whose authorization chain led to this action, and where did it violate policy? This paper introduces SentinelAgent, a formal framework for verifiable delegation chains in federal multi-agent AI systems. The Delegation Chain Calculus (DCC) defines seven properties - six deterministic (authority narrowing, policy preservation, forensic reconstructibility, cascade containment, scope-action conformance, output schema conformance) and one probabilistic (intent preservation) - with four meta-theorems and one proposition establishing the practical infeasibility of deterministic intent verification. The Intent-Preserving Delegation Protocol (IPDP) enforces all seven properties at runtime through a non-LLM Delegation Authority Service. A three-point verification lifecycle achieves 100% combined TPR at 0% FPR on DelegationBench v4 (516 scenarios, 10 attack categories, 13 federal domains). Under black-box adversarial conditions, the DAS blocks 30/30 attacks with 0 false positives. Deterministic properties are unbreakable under adversarial stress testing; intent verification degrades to 13% against sophisticated paraphrasing. Fine-tuning the NLI model on 190 government delegation examples improves P2 from 1.7% to 88.3% TPR (5-fold cross-validated, F1=82.1%). Properties P1, P3-P7 are mechanically verified via TLA+ model checking across 2.7 million states with zero violations. Even when intent verification is evaded, the remaining six properties constrain the adversary to permitted API calls, conformant outputs, traceable actions, bounded cascades, and compliant behavior.

AI.tldr: SentinelAgent是一个用于联邦多智能体AI系统中可验证委托链的正式框架，通过委托链演算定义七个属性，并在运行时通过非LLM委托授权服务强制执行，实现100%真阳性率和0%假阳性率。
AI.motivation: 现有框架无法回答在复杂委托场景中（如A委托B，B代表用户X调用工具C）授权链的来源和策略违反点，需要建立可验证的委托链框架来解决联邦多智能体系统中的授权追溯和策略合规问题。
AI.method: 提出委托链演算（DCC）定义七个属性（六个确定性属性+一个概率性意图保持属性），设计意图保持委托协议（IPDP）通过非LLM委托授权服务在运行时强制执行这些属性，采用三点验证生命周期，并使用TLA+模型检查进行机械验证。
AI.result: 在DelegationBench v4（516个场景，10个攻击类别，13个联邦领域）上实现100%组合真阳性率和0%假阳性率；在黑盒对抗条件下，委托授权服务阻止30/30次攻击且无假阳性；确定性属性在对抗压力测试中不可破坏；意图验证在复杂改写攻击下降至13%，但通过微调NLI模型可将意图保持真阳性率从1.7%提升至88.3%。
AI.conclusion: SentinelAgent框架为联邦多智能体系统提供了可验证的委托链机制，即使意图验证被规避，其余六个确定性属性仍能约束对手行为，确保系统在授权追溯、策略合规和攻击防御方面的可靠性。

title: From Impact to Insight: Dynamics-Aware Proprioceptive Terrain Sensing on Granular Media
summary: Robots that traverse natural terrain must interpret contact forces generated under highly dynamic conditions. However, most terrain characterization approaches rely on quasi-static assumptions that neglect velocity- and acceleration-dependent effects arising during impact and rapid stance transitions. In this work, we investigate granular terrain interaction during high-speed hopping and develop a physics-based framework for dynamic terrain characterization using proprioceptive sensing alone. Through controlled hopping experiments with systematically varied impact speed and leg compliance, our measurements reveal that quasi-static based assumptions lead to large discrepancies in granular terrain property estimation during high-speed hopping, particularly upon touchdown and controller-induced stiffness transitions. Velocity-dependent drag alone cannot explain these discrepancies. Instead, acceleration-dependent added-mass effects-associated with grain entrainment beneath the foot-dominate transient force responses. We integrate this force decomposition with a momentum-observer-based estimator that compensates for rigid-body inertia and gravity, and introduce an acceleration-aware weighted regression to account for increased force variance during high-acceleration events. Together, these methods enable consistent recovery of granular stiffness parameters across locomotion conditions, closely matching linear-actuator ground truth. Our results demonstrate that accurate terrain inference during high-speed locomotion requires explicit treatment of acceleration-dependent granular effects, and provide a foundation for robots to characterize complex deformable terrain during dynamic exploration of terrestrial and planetary environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于物理的框架，用于在高速跳跃过程中仅使用本体感知进行动态地形表征，揭示了加速度相关的附加质量效应在高速运动中对颗粒地形力响应的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 大多数地形表征方法依赖于准静态假设，忽略了高速运动中的速度和加速度相关效应。机器人需要在高度动态条件下解释接触力，特别是在自然地形中移动时，需要准确理解冲击和快速姿态转换期间产生的力。
AI.method: 通过控制跳跃实验，系统性地改变冲击速度和腿部刚度，测量颗粒地形相互作用。开发了一个物理框架，将力分解与基于动量观测器的估计器相结合，补偿刚体惯性和重力，并引入加速度感知加权回归来处理高加速度事件期间增加的力方差。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于准静态的假设在高速跳跃期间会导致颗粒地形属性估计出现较大差异。速度相关的阻力无法解释这些差异，而是加速度相关的附加质量效应（与脚部下方颗粒夹带相关）主导了瞬态力响应。该方法能够在不同运动条件下一致地恢复颗粒刚度参数，与线性执行器地面真实值密切匹配。
AI.conclusion: 高速运动期间的准确地形推断需要明确处理加速度相关的颗粒效应。该研究为机器人在动态探索陆地和水星环境期间表征复杂可变形地形提供了基础。

title: LLM Reasoning with Process Rewards for Outcome-Guided Steps
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, submitted to IJCNN 2026 conference
summary:
Mathematical reasoning in large language models has improved substantially with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards, where final answers can be checked automatically and converted into reliable training signals. Most such pipelines optimize outcome correctness only, which yields sparse feedback for long, multi-step solutions and offers limited guidance on intermediate reasoning errors. Recent work therefore introduces process reward models (PRMs) to score intermediate steps and provide denser supervision. In practice, PRM scores are often imperfectly aligned with final correctness and can reward locally fluent reasoning that still ends in an incorrect answer. When optimized as absolute rewards, such signals can amplify fluent failure modes and induce reward hacking.
  We propose PROGRS, a framework that leverages PRMs while keeping outcome correctness dominant. PROGRS treats process rewards as relative preferences within outcome groups rather than absolute targets. We introduce outcome-conditioned centering, which shifts PRM scores of incorrect trajectories to have zero mean within each prompt group. It removes systematic bias while preserving informative rankings. PROGRS combines a frozen quantile-regression PRM with a multi-scale coherence evaluator. We integrate the resulting centered process bonus into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) without auxiliary objectives or additional trainable components. Across MATH-500, AMC, AIME, MinervaMath, and OlympiadBench, PROGRS consistently improves Pass@1 over outcome-only baselines and achieves stronger performance with fewer rollouts. These results show that outcome-conditioned centering enables safe and effective use of process rewards for mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: PROGRS框架通过结果条件中心化处理过程奖励，将过程奖励作为结果组内的相对偏好而非绝对目标，结合冻结分位数回归PRM和多尺度一致性评估器，在数学推理任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法主要优化最终答案正确性，但这对多步推理提供稀疏反馈。过程奖励模型(PRMs)虽能评分中间步骤，但常与最终正确性不完全对齐，可能奖励局部流畅但最终错误的推理，导致奖励黑客问题。
AI.method: 提出PROGRS框架：1) 结果条件中心化，将错误轨迹的PRM分数在每个提示组内零均值化，消除系统偏差同时保留信息性排名；2) 结合冻结分位数回归PRM和多尺度一致性评估器；3) 将中心化过程奖励融入GRPO，无需辅助目标或额外可训练组件。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、AMC、AIME、MinervaMath和OlympiadBench等数学推理基准上，PROGRS相比仅使用结果奖励的基线一致提升Pass@1，且用更少rollouts实现更强性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果条件中心化使过程奖励能安全有效地用于数学推理，通过将过程奖励作为结果组内的相对偏好而非绝对目标，解决了PRM与最终正确性不对齐的问题，避免了奖励黑客现象。

title: Beyond the AI Tutor: Social Learning with LLM Agents
summary: Most AI-based educational tools today adopt a one-on-one tutoring paradigm, pairing a single LLM with a single learner. Yet decades of learning science research suggest that multi-party interaction -- through peer modeling, co-construction, and exposure to diverse perspectives -- can produce learning benefits that dyadic tutoring alone cannot. In this paper, we investigate whether multi-agent LLM configurations can enhance learning outcomes beyond what a single LLM tutor provides. We present two controlled experiments spanning distinct learning contexts. In a convergent problem-solving study ($N=315$), participants tackle SAT-level math problems in a 2$\times$2 design that varies the presence of an LLM tutor and LLM peers, each making different kinds of errors (conceptual vs.\ arithmetic); participants who interacted with both a tutor and peers achieved the highest unassisted test accuracy. In a divergent composition study ($N=247$), participants write argumentative and creative essays with either no AI assistance, a single LLM (Claude or ChatGPT), or both Claude and ChatGPT together; while both LLM conditions improved essay quality, only the two-agent condition avoided the idea-level homogeneity that single-model assistance was found to produce. Together, these studies offer one of the first controlled investigations of multi-agent LLM learning environments, probing whether the move from one-on-one AI tutoring toward richer agent configurations can unlock the collaborative and observational benefits long documented in human social learning research.

AI.tldr: 多智能体LLM配置相比单一LLM导师能提升学习效果：在数学问题解决中，同时接触导师和同伴（犯不同类型错误）的参与者表现最佳；在写作任务中，双智能体配置避免了单一模型导致的思维同质化。
AI.motivation: 当前AI教育工具主要采用一对一辅导模式，但学习科学研究表明多主体互动（同伴建模、共同建构、接触多元视角）能带来一对一辅导无法实现的学习效益。研究旨在探索多智能体LLM配置是否能超越单一LLM导师的学习效果。
AI.method: 采用两个对照实验：1) 收敛性问题解决研究(N=315)，参与者解决SAT级别数学问题，采用2×2设计（有无LLM导师×有无LLM同伴，同伴犯不同类型错误）；2) 发散性写作研究(N=247)，参与者撰写议论文和创意文章，比较无AI辅助、单一LLM(Claude或ChatGPT)、双LLM(Claude+ChatGPT)三种条件。
AI.result: 数学问题解决中，同时与导师和同伴互动的参与者获得最高的独立测试准确率；写作任务中，两种LLM条件都提升了文章质量，但只有双智能体配置避免了单一模型辅助导致的思维同质化问题。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体LLM学习环境能提供比单一LLM导师更好的学习效果，从一对一AI辅导转向更丰富的智能体配置可以解锁人类社交学习研究中长期记录的协作和观察效益。

title: The Quantum-Cryptographic Co-evolution
summary: As quantum computing matures toward the realization of Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computers (CRQC), global cryptographic infrastructure faces an existential threat. This paper introduces a two-dimensional coordinate system to map the co-evolution of cryptographic resilience (x-axis) and computational capability (y-axis). By analyzing the four resulting quadrants, we categorize the transition from legacy classical systems to quantum-resilient architectures. We argue that the "Quantum Gap" - the delta between CRQC arrival and quantum-safe adoption represents the highest systemic risk, necessitating an immediate transition to crypto-agile frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出一个二维坐标系来映射密码学韧性与计算能力的协同演化，分析四个象限以分类从传统经典系统到量子安全架构的过渡，强调"量子鸿沟"是最高系统性风险
AI.motivation: 随着量子计算向密码学相关量子计算机(CRQC)的实现发展，全球密码基础设施面临生存威胁，需要解决量子计算对现有密码系统的破坏性影响
AI.method: 引入二维坐标系系统，x轴表示密码学韧性，y轴表示计算能力，通过分析四个象限来分类和映射从传统经典系统到量子安全架构的过渡过程
AI.result: 识别出"量子鸿沟"（CRQC到达与量子安全采用之间的差距）代表最高系统性风险，需要立即转向密码敏捷框架
AI.conclusion: 为应对量子计算威胁，必须采用二维坐标系方法来理解密码学韧性与计算能力的协同演化，并优先解决量子鸿沟问题，推动向密码敏捷框架的快速过渡

title: AI Disclosure with DAISY
summary: The use of AI tools in research is becoming routine, alongside growing consensus that such use should be transparently disclosed. However, AI disclosure statements remain rare and inconsistent, with policies offering limited guidance and authors facing social, cognitive, and emotional barriers when reporting AI use. To explore how structured disclosure shapes what authors report and how they experience disclosure, we present DAISY (Disclosure of AI-uSe in Your Research), a form-based tool for generating AI disclosure statements. DAISY was developed from literature-derived requirements and co-design (N =11), and deployed in a user study with authors (N=31). DAISY-supported disclosures met more completeness criteria, offering clearer breakdowns of AI use across research and writing than unsupported disclosures. Surprisingly, despite concerns about how transparently disclosed AI use might be perceived, the use of DAISY did not reduce author comfort with the disclosure statements. We discuss design implications and a research agenda for AI disclosure as a sociotechnical practice.

AI.tldr: DAISY是一个基于表单的工具，用于生成AI使用披露声明，通过结构化披露提高报告完整性和透明度，同时不降低作者对披露声明的舒适度。
AI.motivation: AI工具在研究中的使用日益普遍，但AI披露声明仍然罕见且不一致。现有政策指导有限，作者在报告AI使用时面临社会、认知和情感障碍，需要探索结构化披露如何影响作者报告内容和披露体验。
AI.method: 开发DAISY（Disclosure of AI-uSe in Your Research）表单工具，基于文献需求分析和共同设计（N=11），并在作者用户研究中进行部署（N=31），比较DAISY支持的披露与非结构化披露的差异。
AI.result: DAISY支持的披露满足更多完整性标准，在研究过程和写作中提供更清晰的AI使用细分。令人惊讶的是，尽管作者担心透明披露AI使用可能带来的负面看法，但使用DAISY并未降低他们对披露声明的舒适度。
AI.conclusion: 研究讨论了AI披露作为社会技术实践的设计意义和研究议程，表明结构化工具如DAISY可以改善AI使用报告的完整性和透明度，同时维持作者的心理舒适度。

title: Runtime Execution Traces Guided Automated Program Repair with Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Automated Program Repair (APR) struggles with complex logic errors and silent failures. Current LLM-based APR methods are mostly static, relying on source code and basic test outputs, which fail to accurately capture complex runtime behaviors and dynamic data dependencies. While incorporating runtime evidence like execution traces exposes concrete state transitions, a single LLM interpreting this in isolation often overfits to specific hypotheses, producing patches that satisfy tests by coincidence rather than correct logic. Therefore, runtime evidence should act as objective constraints rather than mere additional input. We propose TraceRepair, a multi-agent framework that leverages runtime facts as shared constraints for patch validation. A probe agent captures execution snapshots of critical variables to form an objective repair basis. Meanwhile, a committee of specialized agents cross-verifies candidate patches to expose inconsistencies and iteratively refine them. Evaluated on the Defects4J benchmark, TraceRepair correctly fixes 392 defects, substantially outperforming existing LLM-based approaches. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved efficiency and strong generalization on a newly constructed dataset of recent bugs, confirming that performance gains arise from dynamic reasoning rather than memorization.

AI.tldr: TraceRepair：一个基于多智能体的程序修复框架，利用运行时事实作为约束条件，通过捕获执行快照和委员会交叉验证来修复复杂逻辑错误
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的自动程序修复方法主要依赖静态代码和基本测试输出，难以准确捕捉复杂的运行时行为和动态数据依赖。虽然引入执行跟踪等运行时证据可以暴露具体状态转换，但单个LLM孤立解释这些证据容易过拟合到特定假设，产生仅巧合通过测试而非逻辑正确的补丁。因此，需要将运行时证据作为客观约束而非额外输入。
AI.method: 提出TraceRepair多智能体框架：1）探测智能体捕获关键变量的执行快照，形成客观修复基础；2）专门化智能体委员会交叉验证候选补丁，暴露不一致性并迭代优化。利用运行时事实作为共享约束进行补丁验证。
AI.result: 在Defects4J基准测试中，TraceRepair正确修复了392个缺陷，显著优于现有基于LLM的方法。扩展实验表明其在新建的近期bug数据集上具有改进的效率和强泛化能力，确认性能提升源于动态推理而非记忆。
AI.conclusion: TraceRepair通过将运行时证据作为客观约束，采用多智能体协同验证的方法，有效解决了复杂逻辑错误和静默故障的修复问题，显著提升了自动程序修复的准确性和泛化能力。

title: Differentiable SpaTiaL: Symbolic Learning and Reasoning with Geometric Temporal Logic for Manipulation Tasks
summary: Executing complex manipulation in cluttered environments requires satisfying coupled geometric and temporal constraints. Although Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) offers a principled specification framework, its use in gradient-based optimization is limited by non-differentiable geometric operations. Existing differentiable temporal logics focus on the robot's internal state and neglect interactive object-environment relations, while spatial logic approaches that capture such interactions rely on discrete geometry engines that break the computational graph and preclude exact gradient propagation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Differentiable SpaTiaL, a fully tensorized toolbox that constructs smooth, autograd-compatible geometric primitives directly over polygonal sets. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end differentiable symbolic spatio-temporal logic toolbox. By analytically deriving differentiable relaxations of key spatial predicates--including signed distance, intersection, containment, and directional relations--we enable an end-to-end differentiable mapping from high-level semantic specifications to low-level geometric configurations, without invoking external discrete solvers. This fully differentiable formulation unlocks two core capabilities: (i) massively parallel trajectory optimization under rigorous spatio-temporal constraints, and (ii) direct learning of spatial logic parameters from demonstrations via backpropagation. Experimental results validate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed framework.Code Available: https://github.com/plen1lune/DiffSpaTiaL

AI.tldr: 提出Differentiable SpaTiaL，首个端到端可微符号时空逻辑工具箱，通过构建平滑几何基元实现从高级语义规范到底层几何配置的可微映射
AI.motivation: 在杂乱环境中执行复杂操作需要满足耦合的几何和时间约束。现有可微时序逻辑忽略交互对象-环境关系，而考虑这些关系的空间逻辑方法依赖离散几何引擎，破坏计算图并阻碍精确梯度传播
AI.method: 提出完全张量化的工具箱，直接在多边形集合上构建平滑、自动微分兼容的几何基元。通过解析推导关键空间谓词（包括有符号距离、相交、包含和方向关系）的可微松弛版本
AI.result: 实现了两个核心能力：(i) 在严格时空约束下的大规模并行轨迹优化，(ii) 通过反向传播直接从演示中学习空间逻辑参数。实验验证了框架的有效性和可扩展性
AI.conclusion: Differentiable SpaTiaL是首个端到端可微符号时空逻辑工具箱，通过完全可微的公式化实现了从高级语义规范到底层几何配置的梯度传播，为机器人操作任务提供了新的优化和学习能力

title: Haiku to Opus in Just 10 bits: LLMs Unlock Massive Compression Gains
summary:
We study the compression of LLM-generated text across lossless and lossy regimes, characterizing a compression-compute frontier where more compression is possible at the cost of more compute. For lossless compression, domain-adapted LoRA adapters can improve LLM-based arithmetic coding by 2x over compression with the base LLM alone. For lossy compression, prompting a model for a succinct rewrite then applying arithmetic coding can achieve compression ratios of approximately 0.03, a 2x improvement over compressing the original response.
  We further introduce Question-Asking compression (QA), an interactive lossy protocol inspired by the game 'Twenty Questions'. A small model iteratively refines its response by asking yes/no questions to a stronger model, transferring exactly one bit per answer. On 8 benchmarks spanning math, science, and code, 10 binary questions recover 23% to 72% of the capability gap between a small and large model on standard benchmarks and 7% to 38% on harder benchmarks, achieving compression ratios of 0.0006 to 0.004. This is over 100x smaller than prior LLM-based compression (Deletang et al., 2024), suggesting that interactive protocols can transfer knowledge far more efficiently than transmitting full responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM生成文本的压缩，探索无损和有损压缩方案，提出基于问答的交互式压缩协议，显著提升压缩效率。
AI.motivation: 研究LLM生成文本的压缩问题，探索压缩与计算之间的权衡，旨在开发更高效的压缩方法以减少传输成本，特别是在资源受限环境下。
AI.method: 1. 无损压缩：使用领域适应的LoRA适配器改进基于LLM的算术编码；2. 有损压缩：先提示模型生成简洁重写，再应用算术编码；3. 问答压缩(QA)：受"二十个问题"游戏启发，小模型通过向强模型询问是/否问题迭代优化响应。
AI.result: 1. 无损压缩：领域适应LoRA适配器比基础LLM压缩提升2倍；2. 有损压缩：压缩比约0.03，比原始响应压缩提升2倍；3. QA压缩：在8个基准测试中，10个二进制问题可恢复小模型与大模型之间23%-72%的能力差距，压缩比0.0006-0.004，比先前LLM压缩小100倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 交互式压缩协议比传输完整响应更高效地传递知识，问答压缩展示了在极低比特率下实现显著能力提升的潜力，为资源受限环境中的高效知识传输提供了新途径。

title: Disrupting Cognitive Passivity: Rethinking AI-Assisted Data Literacy through Cognitive Alignment
summary: AI chatbots are increasingly stepping into roles as collaborators or teachers in analyzing, visualizing, and reasoning through data and domain problem. Yet, AI's default assistant mode with its comprehensive and one-off responses may undermine opportunities for practitioners to develop literacy through their own thinking, inducing cognitive passivity. Drawing on evidence from empirical studies and theories, we argue that disrupting cognitive passivity necessitates a nuanced approach: rather than simply making AI promote deliberative thinking, there is a need for more dynamic and adaptive strategy through cognitive alignment -- a framework that characterizes effective human-AI interaction as a function of alignment between users' cognitive demand and AI's interaction mode. In the framework, we provide the mapping between AI's interaction mode (transmissive or deliberative) and users' cognitive demand (receptive or deliberative), otherwise leading to either cognitive passivity or friction. We further discuss implications and offer open questions for future research on data literacy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出认知对齐框架，通过匹配用户认知需求与AI交互模式来避免认知被动性，促进数据素养发展
AI.motivation: AI助手默认的全面一次性响应模式可能导致用户认知被动性，削弱数据素养发展机会，需要更动态的交互策略
AI.method: 提出认知对齐框架，将AI交互模式（传递式或审慎式）与用户认知需求（接受式或审慎式）进行匹配，避免认知被动或摩擦
AI.result: 建立了有效人机交互作为用户认知需求与AI交互模式对齐的函数框架，提供了具体映射关系
AI.conclusion: 需要动态自适应策略而非简单让AI促进审慎思考，认知对齐框架为未来数据素养研究提供理论基础和开放问题

title: GBQA: A Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Quality Assurance Engineers
comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: The autonomous discovery of bugs remains a significant challenge in modern software development. Compared to code generation, the complexity of dynamic runtime environments makes bug discovery considerably harder for large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we take game development as a representative domain and introduce the Game Benchmark for Quality Assurance (GBQA), a benchmark containing 30 games and 124 human-verified bugs across three difficulty levels, to evaluate whether LLMs can autonomously detect software bugs. The benchmark is constructed using a multi-agent system that develops games and injects bugs in a scalable manner, with human experts in the loop to ensure correctness. Moreover, we provide a baseline interactive agent equipped with a multi-round ReAct loop and a memory mechanism, enabling long-horizon exploration of game environments for bug detection across different LLMs. Extensive experiments on frontier LLMs demonstrate that autonomous bug discovery remains highly challenging: the best-performing model, Claude-4.6-Opus in thinking mode, identifies only 48.39% of the verified bugs. We believe GBQA provides an adequate testbed and evaluation criterion, and that further progress on it will help close the gap in autonomous software engineering.

AI.tldr: GBQA基准测试评估LLMs在游戏开发中自主发现软件bug的能力，包含30个游戏和124个已验证bug，结果显示当前最佳模型仅能发现48.39%的bug
AI.motivation: 自主发现软件bug是现代软件开发的重要挑战，相比代码生成，动态运行时环境的复杂性使得大型语言模型在bug发现方面面临更大困难。游戏开发作为代表性领域，需要建立评估LLMs自主检测软件bug能力的基准测试
AI.method: 提出游戏质量保证基准测试(GBQA)，包含30个游戏和124个人工验证的bug，分为三个难度级别。使用多智能体系统以可扩展方式开发游戏并注入bug，同时引入人类专家确保正确性。提供基线交互式智能体，配备多轮ReAct循环和记忆机制，支持长时程游戏环境探索以检测bug
AI.result: 在领先LLMs上的广泛实验表明，自主bug发现仍然极具挑战性：表现最佳的模型Claude-4.6-Opus在思考模式下仅识别出48.39%的已验证bug
AI.conclusion: GBQA为自主软件工程提供了适当的测试平台和评估标准，在该基准上的进一步进展将有助于缩小自主软件工程领域的差距。当前LLMs在自主bug发现方面仍有很大提升空间

title: UnrealVis: A Testing Laboratory of Optimization Techniques in Unreal Engine for Scientific Visualization
summary: Visualizing large 3D scientific datasets requires balancing performance and fidelity, but traditional tools often demand excessive technical expertise. We introduce UnrealVis, an Unreal Engine optimization laboratory for configuring and evaluating rendering techniques during interactive exploration. Following a review of 55 papers, we established a taxonomy of 22 optimization techniques across six families, implementing them through engine subsystems such as Nanite, Level of Detail(LOD) schemes, and culling. The system features an intuitive workflow with live telemetry and A/B comparisons for local and global performance analysis. Validated through case studies of ribosomal structures and volumetric flow fields, along with an expert evaluation, UnrealVis facilitates the selection of optimization combinations that meet performance goals while preserving structural fidelity. UnrealVis is available at https://github.com/XAIber-lab/UnrealVis

AI.tldr: UnrealVis是一个基于Unreal Engine的优化实验室，用于在交互式探索中配置和评估渲染技术，帮助用户在性能和保真度之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 可视化大型3D科学数据集需要在性能和保真度之间取得平衡，但传统工具通常需要过多的技术专业知识，这限制了科学家的使用。
AI.method: 通过回顾55篇论文，建立了包含22种优化技术的分类法，涵盖六个技术家族，并通过Unreal Engine子系统（如Nanite、LOD方案和剔除技术）实现。系统提供直观的工作流程，包含实时遥测和A/B比较功能，用于本地和全局性能分析。
AI.result: 通过核糖体结构和体积流场的案例研究以及专家评估验证，UnrealVis能够帮助用户选择满足性能目标同时保持结构保真度的优化组合。
AI.conclusion: UnrealVis为科学可视化提供了一种系统化的优化方法，降低了技术门槛，使科学家能够更有效地在交互式探索中平衡渲染性能和视觉保真度。

title: ContractShield: Bridging Semantic-Structural Gaps via Hierarchical Cross-Modal Fusion for Multi-Label Vulnerability Detection in Obfuscated Smart Contracts
summary: Smart contracts are increasingly targeted by adversaries employing obfuscation techniques such as bogus code injection and control flow manipulation to evade vulnerability detection. Existing multimodal methods often process semantic, temporal, and structural features in isolation and fuse them using simple strategies such as concatenation, which neglects cross-modal interactions and weakens robustness, as obfuscation of a single modality can sharply degrade detection accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ContractShield, a robust multimodal framework with a novel fusion mechanism that effectively correlates multiple complementary features through a three-level fusion. Self-attention first identifies patterns that indicate vulnerability within each feature space. Cross-modal attention then establishes meaningful connections between complementary signals across modalities. Then, adaptive weighting dynamically calibrates feature contributions based on their reliability under obfuscation. For feature extraction, ContractShield integrates (1) CodeBERT with a sliding window mechanism to capture semantic dependencies in source code, (2) Extended long short-term memory (xLSTM) to model temporal dynamics in opcode sequences, and (3) GATv2 to identify structural invariants in control flow graphs (CFGs) that remain stable across obfuscation. Empirical evaluation demonstrates resilience of ContractShield, achieving a 89 percentage Hamming Score with only a 1-3 percentage drop compared to non-obfuscated data. The framework simultaneously detects five major vulnerability types with 91 percentage F1-score, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 6-15 percentage under adversarial conditions.

AI.tldr: ContractShield：一种针对智能合约漏洞检测的鲁棒多模态框架，通过三级融合机制有效关联语义、时序和结构特征，对抗混淆攻击，在对抗条件下优于现有方法6-15个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有智能合约漏洞检测方法面临两个主要问题：1）攻击者使用虚假代码注入和控制流操纵等混淆技术逃避检测；2）现有多模态方法通常孤立处理不同特征模态，使用简单的拼接融合策略，忽略了跨模态交互，导致当单一模态被混淆时检测精度急剧下降。
AI.method: 提出ContractShield框架，包含三个核心组件：1）特征提取：使用带滑动窗口的CodeBERT捕获源代码语义依赖，xLSTM建模操作码序列的时序动态，GATv2识别控制流图中的结构不变量；2）三级融合机制：自注意力识别各特征空间内的漏洞模式，跨模态注意力建立模态间互补信号的连接，自适应加权根据混淆条件下的可靠性动态校准特征贡献。
AI.result: 实验评估显示ContractShield具有强鲁棒性：在混淆数据上获得89%的汉明分数，仅比非混淆数据下降1-3个百分点；同时检测五种主要漏洞类型，F1分数达到91%，在对抗条件下比最先进方法高出6-15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ContractShield通过创新的三级融合机制有效关联多模态特征，显著提升了智能合约漏洞检测在对抗混淆攻击下的鲁棒性和准确性，为解决现有方法在跨模态交互和对抗鲁棒性方面的不足提供了有效方案。

title: MECO: A Multimodal Dataset for Emotion and Cognitive Understanding in Older Adults
summary: While affective computing has advanced considerably, multimodal emotion prediction in aging populations remains underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of dedicated datasets. Existing multimodal benchmarks predominantly target young, cognitively healthy subjects, neglecting the influence of cognitive decline on emotional expression and physiological responses. To bridge this gap, we present MECO, a Multimodal dataset for Emotion and Cognitive understanding in Older adults. MECO includes 42 participants and provides approximately 38 hours of multimodal signals, yielding 30,592 synchronized samples. To maximize ecological validity, data collection followed standardized protocols within community-based settings. The modalities cover video, audio, electroencephalography (EEG), and electrocardiography (ECG). In addition, the dataset offers comprehensive annotations of emotional and cognitive states, including self-assessed valence, arousal, six basic emotions, and Mini-Mental State Examination cognitive scores. We further establish baseline benchmarks for both emotion and cognitive prediction. MECO serves as a foundational resource for multimodal modeling of affect and cognition in aging populations, facilitating downstream applications such as personalized emotion recognition and early detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) in real-world settings. The complete dataset and supplementary materials are available at https://maitrechen.github.io/meco-page/.

AI.tldr: MECO是一个针对老年人群的多模态情感与认知数据集，包含视频、音频、EEG和ECG信号，旨在填补老龄化人群情感计算研究的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有情感计算研究主要针对年轻、认知健康的受试者，缺乏专门针对老龄化人群的数据集，而认知衰退会影响情感表达和生理反应，因此需要专门的数据资源来研究老年人群的情感与认知。
AI.method: 收集了42名参与者的多模态数据，包括视频、音频、EEG和ECG信号，采用标准化协议在社区环境中采集，确保生态效度。数据集包含30,592个同步样本，约38小时数据，并提供了情感状态（效价、唤醒度、六种基本情绪）和认知状态（MMSE评分）的全面标注。
AI.result: 建立了情感和认知预测的基准测试，MECO数据集可作为研究老龄化人群情感与认知多模态建模的基础资源，支持个性化情感识别和轻度认知障碍早期检测等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: MECO填补了老龄化人群多模态情感计算研究的空白，为理解认知衰退对情感表达的影响提供了重要数据支持，有助于开发针对老年人群的情感识别和认知健康监测系统。

title: Open Challenges for Secure and Scalable Wi-Fi Connectivity in Rural Areas
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures and 2 tables; Accepted for publication at SPAIC, AsiaCCS Workshops 2026
summary: Providing reliable, affordable, and secure Internet connectivity in rural areas remains a major challenge. Pay-for-use Wi-Fi hotspots are emerging as a scalable solution to provide affordable Internet access in underserved and rural regions. Despite their growing adoption, their security properties remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present a security analysis of these hotspot ecosystems based on Wi-Fi surveys and practical attack validation. We first perform a Wi-Fi survey conducted in two countries, namely the Philippines and India, to understand the deployment and adoption of such systems in practice. Our results suggest that Piso-WiFi pay-to-use hotspots are particularly widespread in rural regions of the Philippines, and that India's PM-WANI initiative is slowly gaining traction. We then perform a security assessment of these deployments and demonstrate two practical attacks: hijacking another user's paid connection; and rogue hotspots. We analyze the root causes of these vulnerabilities, introduce threat models tailored to pay-for-use hotspot deployments, and outline practical security improvements, including a secure caching architecture. Our findings highlight security challenges in emerging rural connectivity infrastructure and provide directions toward more secure and scalable deployments.

AI.tldr: 对农村付费Wi-Fi热点系统的安全分析，揭示了连接劫持和恶意热点等实际攻击，提出了安全改进方案
AI.motivation: 农村地区可靠、经济、安全的互联网连接仍面临挑战，付费Wi-Fi热点作为可扩展解决方案正在兴起，但其安全特性尚未得到充分研究
AI.method: 在菲律宾和印度进行Wi-Fi调查了解实际部署情况，对部署进行安全评估，演示两种实际攻击（劫持用户付费连接和恶意热点），分析漏洞根源，引入威胁模型并提出安全改进方案
AI.result: 发现菲律宾的Piso-WiFi付费热点在农村地区特别普遍，印度的PM-WANI倡议正在缓慢获得关注；成功演示了两种实际攻击，揭示了新兴农村连接基础设施的安全挑战
AI.conclusion: 付费Wi-Fi热点系统存在严重安全漏洞，需要针对性的安全改进措施，包括安全的缓存架构，以确保农村连接基础设施的安全性和可扩展性

title: V2X-QA: A Comprehensive Reasoning Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving Across Ego, Infrastructure, and Cooperative Views
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for autonomous driving, yet existing benchmarks remain largely ego-centric and therefore cannot systematically assess model performance in infrastructure-centric and cooperative driving conditions. In this work, we introduce V2X-QA, a real-world dataset and benchmark for evaluating MLLMs across vehicle-side, infrastructure-side, and cooperative viewpoints. V2X-QA is built around a view-decoupled evaluation protocol that enables controlled comparison under vehicle-only, infrastructure-only, and cooperative driving conditions within a unified multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) framework. The benchmark is organized into a twelve-task taxonomy spanning perception, prediction, and reasoning and planning, and is constructed through expert-verified MCQA annotation to enable fine-grained diagnosis of viewpoint-dependent capabilities. Benchmark results across ten representative state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models show that viewpoint accessibility substantially affects performance, and infrastructure-side reasoning supports meaningful macroscopic traffic understanding. Results also indicate that cooperative reasoning remains challenging since it requires cross-view alignment and evidence integration rather than simply additional visual input. To address these challenges, we introduce V2X-MoE, a benchmark-aligned baseline with explicit view routing and viewpoint-specific LoRA experts. The strong performance of V2X-MoE further suggests that explicit viewpoint specialization is a promising direction for multi-view reasoning in autonomous driving. Overall, V2X-QA provides a foundation for studying multi-perspective reasoning, reliability, and cooperative physical intelligence in connected autonomous driving. The dataset and V2X-MoE resources are publicly available at: https://github.com/junwei0001/V2X-QA.

AI.tldr: V2X-QA是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶中多视角推理能力的真实世界数据集和基准，涵盖车辆侧、基础设施侧和协同视角，通过专家验证的多选题标注实现细粒度诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶基准主要关注自我中心视角，无法系统评估模型在基础设施中心和协同驾驶条件下的性能，因此需要开发能够评估多视角推理能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建V2X-QA数据集，采用视图解耦评估协议，在统一的MCQA框架下支持车辆侧、基础设施侧和协同驾驶条件的受控比较。数据集按12任务分类法组织，涵盖感知、预测、推理和规划。同时提出V2X-MoE基准对齐基线，采用显式视图路由和视角特定的LoRA专家。
AI.result: 对10个代表性SOTA模型评估显示：视角可访问性显著影响性能；基础设施侧推理支持有意义的宏观交通理解；协同推理仍然具有挑战性，需要跨视图对齐和证据整合而非简单增加视觉输入。V2X-MoE表现出色，表明显式视角专业化是多视图推理的有前景方向。
AI.conclusion: V2X-QA为研究连接自动驾驶中的多视角推理、可靠性和协同物理智能提供了基础，显式视角专业化是提升多视图推理能力的有效方法。

title: DrugPlayGround: Benchmarking Large Language Models and Embeddings for Drug Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are in the ascendancy for research in drug discovery, offering unprecedented opportunities to reshape drug research by accelerating hypothesis generation, optimizing candidate prioritization, and enabling more scalable and cost-effective drug discovery pipelines. However there is currently a lack of objective assessments of LLM performance to ascertain their advantages and limitations over traditional drug discovery platforms. To tackle this emergent problem, we have developed DrugPlayGround, a framework to evaluate and benchmark LLM performance for generating meaningful text-based descriptions of physiochemical drug characteristics, drug synergism, drug-protein interactions, and the physiological response to perturbations introduced by drug molecules. Moreover, DrugPlayGround is designed to work with domain experts to provide detailed explanations for justifying the predictions of LLMs, thereby testing LLMs for chemical and biological reasoning capabilities to push their greater use at the frontier of drug discovery at all of its stages.

AI.tldr: DrugPlayGround：一个评估大语言模型在药物发现中性能的基准框架，涵盖药物特性、协同作用、相互作用及生理反应预测
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在药物发现研究中日益重要，但目前缺乏客观评估其相对于传统药物发现平台优势和局限性的方法
AI.method: 开发DrugPlayGround框架，用于评估和基准测试LLM在生成药物特性、药物协同作用、药物-蛋白质相互作用以及药物分子引入扰动后生理反应的文本描述方面的性能
AI.result: DrugPlayGround能够与领域专家合作，为LLM预测提供详细解释，测试LLM的化学和生物学推理能力
AI.conclusion: 该框架旨在推动LLM在药物发现各阶段的更广泛应用，通过系统评估提升其在药物研究中的可靠性和实用性

title: Same Feedback, Different Source: How AI vs. Human Feedback Attribution and Credibility Shape Learner Behavior in Computing Education
summary: As AI systems increasingly take on instructional roles - providing feedback, guiding practice, evaluating work - a fundamental question emerges: does it matter to learners who they believe is on the other side? We investigated this using a three-condition experiment (N=148) in which participants completed a creative coding tutorial and received feedback generated by the same large language model, attributed to either an AI system (with instant or delayed delivery) or a human teaching assistant (with matched delayed delivery). This three-condition design separates the effect of source attribution from the confound of delivery timing, which prior studies have not controlled. Source attribution and timing had distinct effects on different outcomes: participants who believed the human attribution spent more time on task than those receiving equivalently timed AI-attributed feedback (d=0.61, p=.013, uncorrected), while the delivery delay independently increased output complexity without affecting time measures. An exploratory analysis revealed that 46% of participants in the human-attributed condition did not believe the attribution, and these participants showed worse outcomes than those receiving transparent AI feedback (code complexity d=0.77, p=.003; time on task d=0.70, p=.007). These findings suggest that believed human presence may carry motivational value, but that this value depends on credibility. For computing educators, transparent AI attribution may be the lower-risk default in contexts where human attribution would not be credible.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨学习者对反馈来源的认知是否影响学习效果，通过三组实验（AI即时反馈、AI延迟反馈、人类延迟反馈）分离来源归因与时间因素，发现人类归因能增加学习时间但需要可信度支撑。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地承担教学角色（提供反馈、指导练习、评估作业），一个基本问题出现：学习者认为反馈来自谁是否重要？先前研究未能控制交付时间这一混淆变量，本研究旨在分离来源归因与时间因素的影响。
AI.method: 采用三条件实验设计（N=148）：参与者完成创意编码教程，接收由同一大型语言模型生成的反馈，分别归因于AI系统（即时或延迟交付）或人类助教（匹配延迟交付）。这种设计分离了来源归因与交付时间的影响。探索性分析还考察了参与者对归因可信度的认知。
AI.result: 来源归因和时间因素对不同结果有不同影响：认为反馈来自人类的参与者比接收同等时间AI归因反馈的参与者花费更多时间（d=0.61, p=.013）；交付延迟独立增加了输出复杂度但不影响时间测量。探索性分析显示，46%的人类归因组参与者不相信归因，这些参与者比接收透明AI反馈的参与者表现更差（代码复杂度d=0.77, p=.003；任务时间d=0.70, p=.007）。
AI.conclusion: 学习者认为的人类存在可能具有激励价值，但这种价值取决于可信度。对于计算教育者，在人类归因不可信的背景下，透明的AI归因可能是风险较低的默认选择。研究强调了分离归因与时间因素的重要性，并指出可信度是影响学习效果的关键中介变量。

title: Towards Secure Agent Skills: Architecture, Threat Taxonomy, and Security Analysis
summary: Agent Skills is an emerging open standard that defines a modular, filesystem-based packaging format enabling LLM-based agents to acquire domain-specific expertise on demand. Despite rapid adoption across multiple agentic platforms and the emergence of large community marketplaces, the security properties of Agent Skills have not been systematically studied. This paper presents the first comprehensive security analysis of the Agent Skills framework. We define the full lifecycle of an Agent Skill across four phases -- Creation, Distribution, Deployment, and Execution -- and identify the structural attack surface each phase introduces. Building on this lifecycle analysis, we construct a threat taxonomy comprising seven categories and seventeen scenarios organized across three attack layers, grounded in both architectural analysis and real-world evidence. We validate the taxonomy through analysis of five confirmed security incidents in the Agent Skills ecosystem. Based on these findings, we discuss defense directions for each threat category, identify open research challenges, and provide actionable recommendations for stakeholders. Our analysis reveals that the most severe threats arise from structural properties of the framework itself, including the absence of a data-instruction boundary, a single-approval persistent trust model, and the lack of mandatory marketplace security review, and cannot be addressed through incremental mitigations alone.

AI.tldr: 首次对Agent Skills框架进行系统性安全分析，揭示其生命周期各阶段的安全风险，构建威胁分类体系，并提出防御建议
AI.motivation: Agent Skills作为新兴的开放标准，已在多个智能体平台快速采用并形成大型社区市场，但其安全属性尚未得到系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，对Agent Skills框架进行全面的安全分析。
AI.method: 1. 定义Agent Skill的完整生命周期（创建、分发、部署、执行四个阶段）并识别各阶段的结构性攻击面；2. 基于生命周期分析构建威胁分类体系，包含7个类别和17个场景，覆盖三个攻击层；3. 通过分析Agent Skills生态系统中的5个已确认安全事件验证分类体系；4. 基于发现讨论各威胁类别的防御方向、识别开放研究挑战并提供可操作建议。
AI.result: 分析揭示最严重的威胁源于框架本身的结构特性：缺乏数据-指令边界、单一审批的持久信任模型、以及缺乏强制性的市场安全审查。这些根本性问题无法通过渐进式缓解措施单独解决。验证了威胁分类体系的有效性，并提供了具体的防御建议。
AI.conclusion: Agent Skills框架存在系统性安全风险，需要从根本上重新设计安全架构，而不仅仅是渐进式改进。研究为智能体技能生态系统的安全发展提供了重要指导，并指出了需要解决的关键研究挑战。

title: IndustryCode: A Benchmark for Industry Code Generation
summary: Code generation and comprehension by Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as core drivers of industrial intelligence and decision optimization, finding widespread application in fields such as finance, automation, and aerospace. Although recent advancements have demonstrated the remarkable potential of LLMs in general code generation, existing benchmarks are mainly confined to single domains and languages. Consequently, they fail to effectively evaluate the generalization capabilities required for real-world industrial applications or to reflect the coding proficiency demanded by complex industrial scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce IndustryCode, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to span multiple industrial domains and programming languages. IndustryCode comprises 579 sub-problems derived from 125 primary industrial challenges, accompanied by rigorous problem descriptions and test cases. It covers a wide range of fields, including finance, automation, aerospace, and remote sensing-and incorporates diverse programming languages such as MATLAB, Python, C++, and Stata. In our evaluation, the top-performing model, Claude 4.5 Opus, achieved an overall accuracy of 68.1% on sub-problems and 42.5% main problems. The benchmark dataset and automated evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: IndustryCode是首个跨工业领域和多编程语言的代码生成基准测试，包含579个子问题，覆盖金融、自动化、航空航天、遥感等领域，支持MATLAB、Python、C++、Stata等语言，用于评估LLM在复杂工业场景中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准测试主要局限于单一领域和语言，无法有效评估LLM在真实工业应用中的泛化能力，也不能反映复杂工业场景所需的编码能力。需要创建跨领域、多语言的工业代码生成基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建IndustryCode基准测试，包含579个子问题，源自125个主要工业挑战，每个问题都有严格的问题描述和测试用例。覆盖金融、自动化、航空航天、遥感等多个工业领域，支持MATLAB、Python、C++、Stata等多种编程语言。
AI.result: 在评估中，表现最佳的模型Claude 4.5 Opus在子问题上达到68.1%的总体准确率，在主问题上达到42.5%的准确率。基准测试数据集和自动化评估代码将在论文接受后公开。
AI.conclusion: IndustryCode填补了工业代码生成基准测试的空白，为评估LLM在复杂工业场景中的泛化能力提供了首个跨领域、多语言的综合性基准，有助于推动工业智能和决策优化的发展。

title: Learning Locomotion on Complex Terrain for Quadrupedal Robots with Foot Position Maps and Stability Rewards
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion over complex terrain has been a long-standing research topic in robotics. While recent reinforcement learning-based locomotion methods improve generalizability and foot-placement precision, they rely on implicit inference of foot positions from joint angles, lacking the explicit precision and stability guarantees of optimization-based approaches. To address this, we introduce a foot position map integrated into the heightmap, and a dynamic locomotion-stability reward within an attention-based framework to achieve locomotion on complex terrain. We validate our method extensively on terrains seen during training as well as out-of-domain (OOD) terrains. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method enables precise and stable movement, resulting in improved locomotion success rates on both in-domain and OOD terrains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合足部位置映射和动态稳定性奖励的注意力框架，用于四足机器人在复杂地形上的精确稳定运动
AI.motivation: 当前基于强化学习的四足运动方法虽然提高了泛化性和足部放置精度，但依赖于从关节角度隐式推断足部位置，缺乏基于优化的方法的显式精度和稳定性保证
AI.method: 引入集成到高度图中的足部位置映射，以及在注意力框架内的动态运动稳定性奖励，实现在复杂地形上的运动
AI.result: 在训练期间见过的地形和域外地形上广泛验证，结果表明所提方法能够实现精确稳定的运动，在域内和域外地形上都提高了运动成功率
AI.conclusion: 通过结合足部位置映射和动态稳定性奖励的注意力框架，成功解决了四足机器人在复杂地形上运动的精度和稳定性问题

title: FTimeXer: Frequency-aware Time-series Transformer with Exogenous variables for Robust Carbon Footprint Forecasting
comment: Accepted by The 5th International Conference on Electronics Technology and Artificial Intelligence (ETAI 2026)
summary: Accurate and up-to-date forecasting of the power grid's carbon footprint is crucial for effective product carbon footprint (PCF) accounting and informed decarbonization decisions. However, the carbon intensity of the grid exhibits high non-stationarity, and existing methods often struggle to effectively leverage periodic and oscillatory patterns. Furthermore, these methods tend to perform poorly when confronted with irregular exogenous inputs, such as missing data or misalignment. To tackle these challenges, we propose FTimeXer, a frequency-aware time-series Transformer designed with a robust training scheme that accommodates exogenous factors. FTimeXer features an Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)-driven frequency branch combined with gated time-frequency fusion, allowing it to capture multi-scale periodicity effectively. It also employs stochastic exogenous masking in conjunction with consistency regularization, which helps reduce spurious correlations and enhance stability. Experiments conducted on three real-world datasets show consistent improvements over strong baselines. As a result, these enhancements lead to more reliable forecasts of grid carbon factors, which are essential for effective PCF accounting and informed decision-making regarding decarbonization.

AI.tldr: 提出FTimeXer，一种频率感知的时间序列Transformer，用于准确预测电网碳强度，解决现有方法在处理非平稳性、周期性模式和异常外生输入方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 电网碳强度预测对产品碳足迹核算和脱碳决策至关重要，但现有方法难以有效处理碳强度的高非平稳性、周期性振荡模式，以及在面对缺失数据或错位等不规则外生输入时表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出FTimeXer模型，包含FFT驱动的频率分支与门控时频融合机制，有效捕捉多尺度周期性；采用随机外生掩码与一致性正则化的鲁棒训练方案，减少虚假相关性并增强稳定性。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，FTimeXer相比强基线模型取得了一致的性能提升，实现了更可靠的电网碳因子预测。
AI.conclusion: FTimeXer通过频率感知架构和鲁棒训练方案，显著提升了电网碳强度预测的准确性，为产品碳足迹核算和脱碳决策提供了更可靠的基础。

title: CASCADE: A Cascading Architecture for Social Coordination with Controllable Emergence at Low Cost
summary: Creating scalable and believable game societies requires balancing authorial control with computational cost. Existing scripted NPC systems scale efficiently but are often rigid, whereas fully LLM-driven agents can produce richer social behavior at a much higher runtime cost. We present CASCADE, a three-layer architecture for low-cost, controllable social coordination in sandbox-style game worlds. A Macro State Director (Level 1) maintains discrete-time world-state variables and macro-level causal updates, while a modular Coordination Hub decomposes state changes through domain-specific components (e.g., professional and social coordination) and routes the resulting directives to tag-defined groups. Then Tag-Driven NPCs (Level 3) execute responses through behavior trees and local state/utility functions, invoking large language models only for on-demand player-facing interactions. We evaluate CASCADE through multiple micro-scenario prototypes and trace-based analysis, showing how a shared macro event can produce differentiated yet logically constrained NPC behaviors without per-agent prompting in the main simulation loop. CASCADE provides a modular foundation for scalable social simulation and future open-world authoring tools.

AI.tldr: CASCADE是一个三层架构，用于在沙盒游戏中实现低成本、可控的社会协调，通过宏观状态管理、模块化协调中心和标签驱动NPC来平衡创作控制与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有脚本NPC系统虽然高效但僵化，而完全LLM驱动的智能体虽然能产生更丰富的社会行为但运行时成本过高。需要一种既能保持创作控制又能降低计算成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出CASCADE三层架构：1) 宏观状态导向器维护离散时间世界状态变量和宏观因果更新；2) 模块化协调中心通过领域特定组件分解状态变化，并将指令路由到标签定义组；3) 标签驱动NPC通过行为树和本地状态/效用函数执行响应，仅在面向玩家的交互中按需调用大语言模型。
AI.result: 通过多个微场景原型和基于轨迹的分析评估，显示共享宏观事件可以产生差异化但逻辑受限的NPC行为，而无需在主模拟循环中进行每个智能体的提示。CASCADE为可扩展的社会模拟和未来开放世界创作工具提供了模块化基础。
AI.conclusion: CASCADE提供了一个平衡创作控制与计算成本的解决方案，通过分层架构实现了低成本、可控的社会协调，为可扩展的游戏社会模拟提供了有效框架。

title: Analyzing Healthcare Interoperability Vulnerabilities: Formal Modeling and Graph-Theoretic Approach
summary: In a healthcare environment, the healthcare interoperability platforms based on HL7 FHIR allow concurrent, asynchronous access to a set of shared patient resources, which are independent systems, i.e., EHR systems, pharmacy systems, lab systems, and devices. The FHIR specification lacks a protocol for concurrency control, and the research on detecting a race condition only targets the OS kernel. The research on FHIR security only targets authentication and injection attacks, considering concurrent access to patient resources to be sequential. The gap in the research in this area is addressed through the introduction of FHIR Resource Access Graph (FRAG), a formally defined graph G = (P,R,E, λ, τ, S), in which the nodes are the concurrent processes, the typed edges represent the resource access events, and the race conditions are represented as detectable structural properties. Three clinically relevant race condition classes are formally specified: Simultaneous Write Conflict (SWC), TOCTOU Authorization Violation (TAV), and Cascading Update Race (CUR). The FRAG model is implemented as a three-pass graph traversal detection algorithm and tested against a time window-based baseline on 1,500 synthetic FHIR R4 transaction logs. Under full concurrent access (C2), FRAG attains a 90.0% F1 score vs. 25.5% for the baseline, a 64.5 pp improvement.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对HL7 FHIR医疗互操作性平台缺乏并发控制协议的问题，提出了FHIR资源访问图（FRAG）模型，用于检测三种临床相关的竞态条件类型，相比时间窗口基线方法在完全并发访问下实现了64.5个百分点的F1分数提升。
AI.motivation: HL7 FHIR医疗互操作性平台支持对共享患者资源的并发异步访问，但FHIR规范缺乏并发控制协议。现有研究仅关注操作系统内核的竞态条件检测，而FHIR安全研究只针对认证和注入攻击，将并发访问视为顺序处理，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出FHIR资源访问图（FRAG）模型，形式化定义为G = (P,R,E,λ,τ,S)，其中节点是并发进程，带类型边表示资源访问事件，竞态条件表示为可检测的结构属性。定义了三种临床相关竞态条件类：同时写入冲突（SWC）、TOCTOU授权违规（TAV）和级联更新竞态（CUR）。实现为三遍图遍历检测算法，并在1,500个合成的FHIR R4事务日志上进行测试。
AI.result: 在完全并发访问（C2）条件下，FRAG模型达到90.0%的F1分数，而基于时间窗口的基线方法仅为25.5%，提升了64.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FRAG模型有效解决了FHIR平台中并发访问控制的缺失问题，能够检测临床相关的竞态条件，显著优于传统的时间窗口方法，为医疗互操作性平台的安全性和可靠性提供了重要保障。

title: Geometrically-Constrained Radar-Inertial Odometry via Continuous Point-Pose Uncertainty Modeling
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables, accepted to RA-L
summary: Radar odometry is crucial for robust localization in challenging environments; however, the sparsity of reliable returns and distinctive noise characteristics impede its performance. This paper introduces geometrically-constrained radar-inertial odometry and mapping that jointly consolidates point and pose uncertainty. We employ the continuous trajectory model to estimate the pose uncertainty at any arbitrary timestamp by propagating uncertainties of the control points. These pose uncertainties are continuously integrated with heteroscedastic measurement uncertainty during point projection, thereby enabling dynamic evaluation of observation confidence and adaptive down-weighting of uninformative radar points. By leveraging quantified uncertainties in radar mapping, we construct a high-fidelity map that improves odometry accuracy under imprecise radar measurements. Moreover, we reveal the effectiveness of explicit geometrical constraints in radar-inertial odometry when incorporated with the proposed uncertainty-aware mapping framework. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, yielding substantial performance improvements in both accuracy and efficiency compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何约束的雷达-惯性里程计与建图方法，通过联合整合点和位姿不确定性，利用连续轨迹模型估计任意时间戳的位姿不确定性，并结合异方差测量不确定性进行动态观测置信度评估，自适应降权无信息雷达点，构建高保真地图提升里程计精度。
AI.motivation: 雷达里程计在恶劣环境下对鲁棒定位至关重要，但可靠回波的稀疏性和独特的噪声特性限制了其性能。现有方法在处理雷达点云稀疏性和噪声方面存在不足，需要更有效的不确定性建模和几何约束整合方法。
AI.method: 采用连续轨迹模型估计任意时间戳的位姿不确定性，通过控制点传播不确定性；将位姿不确定性与异方差测量不确定性在点投影过程中连续整合，实现动态观测置信度评估；利用量化不确定性进行雷达建图，构建高保真地图；在不确定性感知建图框架中融入显式几何约束。
AI.result: 在多样化真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在准确性和效率方面均优于现有基线，实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的几何约束雷达-惯性里程计与建图方法通过联合不确定性建模和自适应点云处理，有效解决了雷达稀疏性和噪声问题，在不确定性感知建图框架中融入几何约束进一步提升了系统性能。

title: Contextual Intelligence The Next Leap for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to AAMAS 2025 (Blue Sky Ideas Track)
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has produced spectacular results in games, robotics, and continuous control. Yet, despite these successes, learned policies often fail to generalize beyond their training distribution, limiting real-world impact. Recent work on contextual RL (cRL) shows that exposing agents to environment characteristics -- contexts -- can improve zero-shot transfer. So far, the community has treated context as a monolithic, static observable, an approach that constrains the generalization capabilities of RL agents.
  To achieve contextual intelligence we first propose a novel taxonomy of contexts that separates allogenic (environment-imposed) from autogenic (agent-driven) factors. We identify three fundamental research directions that must be addressed to promote truly contextual intelligence: (1) Learning with heterogeneous contexts to explicitly exploit the taxonomy levels so agents can reason about their influence on the world and vice versa; (2) Multi-time-scale modeling to recognize that allogenic variables evolve slowly or remain static, whereas autogenic variables may change within an episode, potentially requiring different learning mechanisms; (3) Integration of abstract, high-level contexts to incorporate roles, resource & regulatory regimes, uncertainties, and other non-physical descriptors that crucially influence behavior.
  We envision context as a first-class modeling primitive, empowering agents to reason about who they are, what the world permits, and how both evolve over time. By doing so, we aim to catalyze a new generation of context-aware agents that can be deployed safely and efficiently in the real world.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的上下文分类法，将上下文分为异源（环境施加）和自源（智能体驱动）因素，并提出了实现真正上下文智能的三个研究方向：异构上下文学习、多时间尺度建模和抽象高层上下文集成。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习在游戏、机器人和连续控制等领域取得了显著成果，但学习到的策略往往无法泛化到训练分布之外，限制了实际应用。现有的上下文强化学习将上下文视为单一、静态的观测变量，这种方法限制了智能体的泛化能力。需要更精细的上下文建模来提升智能体的上下文智能。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的上下文分类法，将上下文分为异源（环境施加）和自源（智能体驱动）因素。在此基础上，提出了三个关键研究方向：1) 异构上下文学习，利用分类法层次使智能体能够推理上下文对世界的影响及反之；2) 多时间尺度建模，识别异源变量演化缓慢或保持静态，而自源变量可能在单次情节内变化；3) 抽象高层上下文集成，纳入角色、资源与监管机制、不确定性等非物理描述符。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个系统性的框架，将上下文作为一等建模原语，使智能体能够推理自身身份、世界允许的行为以及两者随时间的演化。这为开发新一代上下文感知智能体奠定了基础，这些智能体能够在现实世界中安全高效地部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文视为核心建模原语，并采用提出的分类法和研究方向，可以催化新一代上下文感知智能体的发展。这些智能体能够理解自身在环境中的角色、环境的约束条件以及它们随时间的演化，从而实现更好的泛化能力和现实世界部署。

title: A Spectral Framework for Multi-Scale Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction
summary: Dimensionality reduction (DR) is characterized by two longstanding trade-offs. First, there is a global-local preservation tension: methods such as t-SNE and UMAP prioritize local neighborhood preservation, yet may distort global manifold structure, while methods such as Laplacian Eigenmaps preserve global geometry but often yield limited local separation. Second, there is a gap between expressiveness and analytical transparency: many nonlinear DR methods produce embeddings without an explicit connection to the underlying high-dimensional structure, limiting insight into the embedding process. In this paper, we introduce a spectral framework for nonlinear DR that addresses these challenges. Our approach embeds high-dimensional data using a spectral basis combined with cross-entropy optimization, enabling multi-scale representations that bridge global and local structure. Leveraging linear spectral decomposition, the framework further supports analysis of embeddings through a graph-frequency perspective, enabling examination of how spectral modes influence the resulting embedding. We complement this analysis with glyph-based scatterplot augmentations for visual exploration. Quantitative evaluations and case studies demonstrate that our framework improves manifold continuity while enabling deeper analysis of embedding structure through spectral mode contributions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的非线性降维光谱框架，解决全局-局部保持权衡和表达能力-分析透明度差距问题
AI.motivation: 解决降维中的两个长期权衡：1) 全局-局部保持矛盾（t-SNE/UMAP侧重局部但扭曲全局，Laplacian Eigenmaps保持全局但局部分离有限）；2) 表达能力与分析透明度之间的差距（许多非线性降维方法缺乏与高维结构的明确联系）
AI.method: 提出光谱框架，结合光谱基和交叉熵优化进行高维数据嵌入，支持多尺度表示以桥接全局和局部结构。利用线性光谱分解，通过图频率视角分析嵌入，研究光谱模式如何影响嵌入结果。辅以基于字形（glyph）的散点图增强进行可视化探索
AI.result: 定量评估和案例研究表明，该框架改善了流形连续性，同时通过光谱模式贡献实现了对嵌入结构的更深入分析
AI.conclusion: 提出的光谱框架解决了降维中的关键权衡问题，既保持了全局-局部结构的平衡，又提供了更好的分析透明度，为非线性降维提供了新的分析视角

title: Sustainability Analysis of Prompt Strategies for SLM-based Automated Test Generation
summary: The growing adoption of prompt-based automation in software testing raises important issues regarding its computational and environmental sustainability. Existing sustainability studies in AI-driven testing primarily focus on large language models, leaving the impact of prompt engineering strategies largely unexplored - particularly in the context of Small Language Models (SLMs). This gap is critical, as prompt design directly influences inference behavior, execution cost, and resource utilization, even when model size is fixed. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first systematic sustainability evaluation of prompt engineering strategies for automated test generation using SLMs. We analyze seven prompt strategies across three open-source SLMs under a controlled experimental setup. Our evaluation jointly considers execution time, token usage, energy consumption, carbon emissions, and coverage test quality, the latter assessed through coverage analysis of the generated test scripts. The results show that prompt strategies have a substantial and independent impact on sustainability outcomes, often outweighing the effect of model choice. Reasoning intensive strategies such as Chain of Thought and Self-Consistency achieve higher coverage but incur significantly higher execution time, energy consumption, and carbon emissions. In contrast, simpler strategies such as Zero-Shot and ReAct deliver competitive coverage test quality with markedly lower environmental cost, while Least-to-Most and Program of Thought offer balanced trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估小型语言模型提示工程策略在自动化测试生成中的可持续性影响，发现提示策略对可持续性结果的影响通常超过模型选择，推理密集型策略带来更高覆盖率但环境成本显著增加
AI.motivation: 随着基于提示的自动化测试日益普及，其计算和环境可持续性问题变得重要。现有AI测试可持续性研究主要关注大语言模型，而提示工程策略的影响（特别是在小型语言模型背景下）尚未得到充分探索，但提示设计直接影响推理行为、执行成本和资源利用
AI.method: 在受控实验设置下，分析三种开源小型语言模型的七种提示策略，联合评估执行时间、令牌使用量、能耗、碳排放和覆盖测试质量（通过对生成测试脚本进行覆盖分析）
AI.result: 提示策略对可持续性结果有显著且独立的影响，通常超过模型选择的影响。推理密集型策略（如思维链和自洽性）实现更高覆盖率，但执行时间、能耗和碳排放显著更高。相比之下，简单策略（如零样本和ReAct）以显著更低的环境成本提供有竞争力的覆盖测试质量，而Least-to-Most和程序思维提供平衡的权衡
AI.conclusion: 提示工程策略在小型语言模型驱动的自动化测试生成中具有重要的可持续性影响，需要在实际应用中权衡测试质量与环境成本，选择适当的提示策略可以显著改善测试过程的可持续性

title: OPRIDE: Offline Preference-based Reinforcement Learning via In-Dataset Exploration
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) can help avoid sophisticated reward designs and align better with human intentions, showing great promise in various real-world applications. However, obtaining human feedback for preferences can be expensive and time-consuming, which forms a strong barrier for PbRL. In this work, we address the problem of low query efficiency in offline PbRL, pinpointing two primary reasons: inefficient exploration and overoptimization of learned reward functions. In response to these challenges, we propose a novel algorithm, \textbf{O}ffline \textbf{P}b\textbf{R}L via \textbf{I}n-\textbf{D}ataset \textbf{E}xploration (OPRIDE), designed to enhance the query efficiency of offline PbRL. OPRIDE consists of two key features: a principled exploration strategy that maximizes the informativeness of the queries and a discount scheduling mechanism aimed at mitigating overoptimization of the learned reward functions. Through empirical evaluations, we demonstrate that OPRIDE significantly outperforms prior methods, achieving strong performance with notably fewer queries. Moreover, we provide theoretical guarantees of the algorithm's efficiency. Experimental results across various locomotion, manipulation, and navigation tasks underscore the efficacy and versatility of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出OPRIDE算法解决离线偏好强化学习中的查询效率问题，通过最大化查询信息量的探索策略和折扣调度机制，显著减少所需人类反馈数量。
AI.motivation: 偏好强化学习(PbRL)能避免复杂的奖励设计并更好对齐人类意图，但获取人类偏好反馈成本高、耗时长，成为PbRL应用的主要障碍。离线PbRL中查询效率低主要源于探索效率低下和奖励函数过优化两个问题。
AI.method: 提出OPRIDE算法，包含两个关键特征：1) 最大化查询信息量的原则性探索策略；2) 缓解奖励函数过优化的折扣调度机制。算法在离线设置下运行，通过理论保证效率。
AI.result: 实验表明OPRIDE显著优于现有方法，在更少查询下实现强大性能。在多种运动、操作和导航任务中验证了方法的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: OPRIDE有效解决了离线PbRL的查询效率问题，通过信息最大化探索和折扣调度机制，显著减少所需人类反馈，为实际应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: Evaluating the Environmental Impact of using SLMs and Prompt Engineering for Code Generation
summary: The shift from cloud-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) to locally deployed open-source Small Language Models (SLMs) has democratized AI-assisted coding; however, it has also decentralized the environmental footprint of AI. While prompting strategies - such as Chain-of-Thought and ReAct - serve as external mechanisms for optimizing code generation without modifying model parameters, their impact on energy consumption and carbon emissions remains largely invisible to developers. This paper presents the first systematic empirical study investigating how different prompt engineering strategies in SLM-based code generation impact code generation accuracy alongside sustainability factors. We evaluate six prominent prompting strategies across 11 open-source models (ranging from 1B to 34B parameters) using the HumanEval+ and MBPP+ benchmarks. By measuring Pass@1 accuracy alongside energy (kWh), carbon emissions (kgCO2eq), and inference latency, we reveal that sustainability often decouples from accuracy, allowing significant environmental optimizations without sacrificing performance. Our findings indicate that Chain-of-Thought, being a simpler prompting technique, can provide a near-optimal balance between reasoning capability and energy efficiency. Conversely, multi-sampling strategies often incur disproportionate costs for marginal gains. Finally, we identify grid carbon intensity as the dominant factor in deployment-time emissions, highlighting the need for practitioners to consider regional energy profiles. This work provides a quantitative foundation for "green" prompt engineering, enabling developers to align high-performance code generation with ecological responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了不同提示工程策略对小型语言模型代码生成准确性和可持续性（能耗、碳排放）的影响，发现可持续性与准确性往往解耦，简单提示策略如思维链能在推理能力和能源效率间提供接近最优平衡。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型向本地部署的开源小型语言模型转变，AI辅助编程得以普及，但AI的环境足迹也随之分散。虽然提示工程策略（如思维链、ReAct）作为外部机制可优化代码生成而无需修改模型参数，但其对能耗和碳排放的影响对开发者基本不可见。需要系统研究不同提示策略在代码生成准确性和可持续性方面的权衡。
AI.method: 评估六种主流提示策略在11个开源模型（参数规模1B-34B）上的表现，使用HumanEval+和MBPP+基准测试。同时测量Pass@1准确率、能耗（kWh）、碳排放（kgCO2eq）和推理延迟，分析准确性与可持续性指标之间的关系。
AI.result: 研究发现可持续性与准确性往往解耦，可在不牺牲性能的情况下实现显著的环境优化。思维链作为较简单的提示技术，能在推理能力和能源效率间提供接近最优平衡。而多重采样策略通常带来不成比例的成本增加，仅获得边际收益。电网碳强度是部署时碳排放的主导因素，表明开发者需要考虑区域能源结构。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为"绿色"提示工程提供了量化基础，使开发者能够在实现高性能代码生成的同时兼顾生态责任。研究揭示了简单提示策略的环境优势，并强调了考虑区域能源特征的重要性，为可持续AI开发提供了实践指导。

title: Vision-Based End-to-End Learning for UAV Traversal of Irregular Gaps via Differentiable Simulation
summary: -Navigation through narrow and irregular gaps is an essential skill in autonomous drones for applications such as inspection, search-and-rescue, and disaster response. However, traditional planning and control methods rely on explicit gap extraction and measurement, while recent end-to-end approaches often assume regularly shaped gaps, leading to poor generalization and limited practicality. In this work, we present a fully vision-based, end-to-end framework that maps depth images directly to control commands, enabling drones to traverse complex gaps within unseen environments. Operating in the Special Euclidean group SE(3), where position and orientation are tightly coupled, the framework leverages differentiable simulation, a Stop-Gradient operator, and a Bimodal Initialization Distribution to achieve stable traversal through consecutive gaps. Two auxiliary prediction modules-a gap-crossing success classifier and a traversability predictor-further enhance continuous navigation and safety. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the approach's effectiveness, generalization capability, and practical robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种完全基于视觉的端到端框架，使无人机能够直接根据深度图像生成控制指令，穿越复杂且未见过的间隙环境。
AI.motivation: 无人机在检查、搜救和灾难响应等应用中需要穿越狭窄不规则间隙，但传统方法依赖显式间隙提取和测量，而现有端到端方法通常假设规则形状间隙，导致泛化能力差和实用性有限。
AI.method: 开发了完全基于视觉的端到端框架，将深度图像直接映射到控制指令；在SE(3)群中操作，结合可微分模拟、停止梯度算子和双峰初始化分布实现稳定穿越；使用两个辅助预测模块（间隙穿越成功分类器和可穿越性预测器）增强连续导航和安全性。
AI.result: 广泛的模拟和真实世界实验证明了该方法的有效性、泛化能力和实际鲁棒性，能够成功穿越复杂且未见过的间隙环境。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为无人机在复杂环境中的自主导航提供了实用的解决方案，克服了传统方法和现有端到端方法的局限性，实现了稳定、泛化的间隙穿越能力。

title: Dependency-Guided Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation with Reinforcement Alignment
summary:
Automating C-to-Rust migration is critical for improving software security without sacrificing performance. Traditional rule-based methods struggle with diverse C idioms, often producing rigid and unidiomatic Rust code. Large Language Models (LLMs), trained on massive code corpora, offer a promising alternative by leveraging cross-language generalization to generate more idiomatic and maintainable Rust code. However, several challenges remain. First, existing LLM-based approaches fail to handle cross-file dependencies effectively, either ignoring them or including entire files as context, which limits accurate dependency modeling. Second, complex dependencies and structured inputs and outputs make it difficult to verify syntactic correctness and functional equivalence at the repository level. Third, the lack of large-scale C-Rust parallel data constrains model performance.
  We propose DepTrans, a framework that combines model capability enhancement with structured inference. DepTrans introduces Reinforcement-Aligned Syntax Training to improve generation quality through multi-task fine-tuning and feedback-driven reinforcement learning. It further applies Dependency-Guided Iterative Refinement to capture fine-grained cross-file dependencies and iteratively refine generated Rust code. We construct a dataset of 85k training samples and a benchmark of 145 repository-level instances. Experiments show that DepTrans achieves a 60.7 percent compilation success rate and 43.5 percent computational accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 22.8 and 17.3 percentage points. It also successfully builds 7 of 15 industrial C projects, demonstrating its practical potential.

AI.tldr: DepTrans是一个结合模型能力增强与结构化推理的C到Rust迁移框架，通过强化对齐语法训练和依赖引导迭代优化，在85k数据集上实现60.7%编译成功率和43.5%计算准确率。
AI.motivation: 自动化C到Rust迁移对提升软件安全性和性能至关重要。传统基于规则的方法难以处理多样化的C语言习惯用法，生成的Rust代码生硬且不符合习惯。虽然大语言模型通过跨语言泛化能力提供了有前景的替代方案，但仍面临三个主要挑战：1) 现有LLM方法无法有效处理跨文件依赖关系；2) 复杂依赖和结构化输入输出使得仓库级别的语法正确性和功能等价性验证困难；3) 缺乏大规模C-Rust并行数据限制了模型性能。
AI.method: DepTrans框架结合模型能力增强与结构化推理。采用强化对齐语法训练，通过多任务微调和反馈驱动的强化学习提升生成质量。应用依赖引导迭代优化，捕获细粒度跨文件依赖关系并迭代优化生成的Rust代码。构建了包含85k训练样本的数据集和145个仓库级实例的基准测试。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，DepTrans实现了60.7%的编译成功率和43.5%的计算准确率，分别比最强基线高出22.8和17.3个百分点。成功构建了15个工业C项目中的7个，展示了实际应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: DepTrans通过创新的强化对齐语法训练和依赖引导迭代优化，有效解决了C到Rust迁移中的跨文件依赖处理和代码质量提升问题，在编译成功率和计算准确性方面显著优于现有方法，并展示了在工业项目中的实际应用价值。

title: Modeling and Controlling Deployment Reliability under Temporal Distribution Shift
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Empirical study on temporally indexed credit-risk dataset (1.35M samples, 2007-2018)
summary:
Machine learning models deployed in non-stationary environments are exposed to temporal distribution shift, which can erode predictive reliability over time. While common mitigation strategies such as periodic retraining and recalibration aim to preserve performance, they typically focus on average metrics evaluated at isolated time points and do not explicitly model how reliability evolves during deployment.
  We propose a deployment-centric framework that treats reliability as a dynamic state composed of discrimination and calibration. The trajectory of this state across sequential evaluation windows induces a measurable notion of volatility, allowing deployment adaptation to be formulated as a multi-objective control problem that balances reliability stability against cumulative intervention cost.
  Within this framework, we define a family of state-dependent intervention policies and empirically characterize the resulting cost-volatility Pareto frontier. Experiments on a large-scale, temporally indexed credit-risk dataset (1.35M loans, 2007-2018) show that selective, drift-triggered interventions can achieve smoother reliability trajectories than continuous rolling retraining while substantially reducing operational cost.
  These findings position deployment reliability under temporal shift as a controllable multi-objective system and highlight the role of policy design in shaping stability-cost trade-offs in high-stakes tabular applications.

AI.tldr: 提出部署中心框架，将机器学习可靠性视为动态状态（区分度和校准），通过干预策略平衡可靠性稳定性与累积干预成本
AI.motivation: 非平稳环境中的机器学习模型面临时间分布漂移，会侵蚀预测可靠性。现有缓解策略（如定期重训练和重新校准）通常关注孤立时间点的平均指标，未明确建模可靠性在部署期间的演变过程
AI.method: 提出部署中心框架，将可靠性视为由区分度和校准组成的动态状态。通过顺序评估窗口中的状态轨迹定义可测量的波动性，将部署适应问题表述为多目标控制问题，平衡可靠性稳定性与累积干预成本。定义状态依赖的干预策略族，并在大规模时间索引信用风险数据集（135万笔贷款，2007-2018）上进行实验
AI.result: 选择性、漂移触发的干预策略能够比连续滚动重训练获得更平滑的可靠性轨迹，同时显著降低运营成本。实验展示了成本-波动性帕累托前沿
AI.conclusion: 将时间漂移下的部署可靠性定位为可控的多目标系统，强调策略设计在塑造高风险表格应用中稳定性-成本权衡中的作用

title: BugForge: Constructing and Utilizing DBMS Bug Repository to Enhance DBMS Testing
summary:
DBMSs are complex systems prone to bugs that may lead to system failures or compromise data integrity. Establishing unified DBMS bug repositories is crucial for systematically organizing bug-related data, enabling code improvement, and supporting automated testing. In particular, bug reports often contain valuable test inputs and bug-triggering clues that help explore rare execution paths and expose critical buggy behavior, thereby guiding automated DBMS testing. However, the heterogeneity of bug reports, along with their incomplete or inaccurate content, makes it challenging to build unified repositories and convert them into high-quality test cases.
  In this paper, we propose BugForge, a framework that constructs standardized DBMS bug repositories and leverages them to generate high-quality test cases to enhance DBMS testing. Specifically, BugForge progressively collects bug reports, then employs syntax-aware processing and input-adaptive raw PoC extraction to construct a DBMS bug repository. The repository stores structured bug-related data, including bug metadata and raw PoCs that entail potential bug-triggering semantics. These data are further refined into high-quality test cases through semantic-guided adaptation, thereby enabling enhanced DBMS testing methods, including DBMS fuzzing, regression testing, and cross-DBMS bug discovery. We implemented BugForge for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and MonetDB, totally integrated 37,632 bug reports spanning up to 28 years. Based on the repository, BugForge uncovered 35 previously unknown bugs with 22 confirmed by developers, demonstrating the value of constructing and utilizing bug repositories for DBMS testing.

AI.tldr: BugForge框架通过构建标准化的DBMS漏洞仓库并生成高质量测试用例来增强数据库管理系统测试
AI.motivation: DBMS是复杂的系统，容易产生可能导致系统故障或数据完整性受损的漏洞。建立统一的DBMS漏洞仓库对于系统化组织漏洞相关数据、改进代码和支持自动化测试至关重要。然而，漏洞报告的异构性以及内容不完整或不准确，使得构建统一仓库并将其转换为高质量测试用例具有挑战性。
AI.method: BugForge框架采用渐进式收集漏洞报告，然后使用语法感知处理和输入自适应原始PoC提取来构建DBMS漏洞仓库。该仓库存储结构化的漏洞相关数据，包括漏洞元数据和包含潜在漏洞触发语义的原始PoC。这些数据通过语义引导的适应进一步细化为高质量测试用例，从而支持增强的DBMS测试方法，包括DBMS模糊测试、回归测试和跨DBMS漏洞发现。
AI.result: BugForge为PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB和MonetDB实现，总共集成了37,632个漏洞报告，时间跨度长达28年。基于该仓库，BugForge发现了35个先前未知的漏洞，其中22个被开发者确认，证明了构建和利用漏洞仓库进行DBMS测试的价值。
AI.conclusion: BugForge框架成功构建了标准化的DBMS漏洞仓库，并能够生成高质量测试用例，有效支持多种DBMS测试方法，显著提升了漏洞发现能力，证明了统一漏洞仓库在DBMS测试中的实用价值。

title: Learning Structured Robot Policies from Vision-Language Models via Synthetic Neuro-Symbolic Supervision
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently demonstrated strong capabilities in mapping multimodal observations to robot behaviors. However, most current approaches rely on end-to-end visuomotor policies that remain opaque and difficult to analyze, limiting their use in safety-critical robotic applications. In contrast, classical robotic systems often rely on structured policy representations that provide interpretability, modularity, and reactive execution. This work investigates how foundation models can be specialized to generate structured robot policies grounded in multimodal perception, bridging high-dimensional learning and symbolic control. We propose a neuro-symbolic approach in which a VLM synthesizes executable Behavior Tree policies from visual observations, natural language instructions, and structured system specifications. To enable scalable supervision without manual annotation, we introduce an automated pipeline that generates a synthetic multimodal dataset of domain-randomized scenes paired with instruction-policy examples produced by a foundation model. Real-world experiments on two robotic manipulators show that structured policies learned entirely from synthetic supervision transfer successfully to physical systems. The results indicate that foundation models can be adapted to produce interpretable and structured robot policies, providing an alternative to opaque end-to-end approaches for multimodal robot decision making.

AI.tldr: VLM生成可执行行为树策略的神经符号方法，通过合成多模态数据集实现无人工标注监督，在真实机器人上验证了从合成数据到物理系统的成功迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视觉语言模型的端到端视觉运动策略不透明且难以分析，限制了其在安全关键机器人应用中的使用。而经典机器人系统依赖结构化策略表示，提供可解释性、模块化和反应式执行。需要弥合高维学习和符号控制之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出神经符号方法：VLM从视觉观察、自然语言指令和结构化系统规范合成可执行行为树策略。引入自动化管道生成合成多模态数据集，包含域随机化场景与基础模型生成的指令-策略对，实现无需人工标注的可扩展监督。
AI.result: 在两个机器人操纵器上的真实世界实验表明，完全从合成监督学习的结构化策略成功迁移到物理系统。基础模型能够生成可解释的结构化机器人策略。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可以适应生成可解释的结构化机器人策略，为多模态机器人决策提供不透明端到端方法的替代方案，弥合了高维学习和符号控制之间的鸿沟。

title: An Initial Exploration of Contrastive Prompt Tuning to Generate Energy-Efficient Code
comment: Published at the Third International Workshop on Large Language Models for Code (LLM4Code 2026)
summary: Although LLMs are capable of generating functionally correct code, they also tend to produce less energy-efficient code in comparison to human-written solutions. As these inefficiencies lead to higher computational overhead, they are in direct conflict with Green Software Development (GSD) efforts, which aim to reduce the energy consumption of code. To support these efforts, this study aims to investigate whether and how LLMs can be optimized to promote the generation of energy-efficient code. To this end, we employ Contrastive Prompt Tuning (CPT). CPT combines Contrastive Learning techniques, which help the model to distinguish between efficient and inefficient code, and Prompt Tuning, a Parameter-Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) approach that requires only a fraction of the cost of traditional fine tuning. This study evaluates CPT on Python, Java and C++ coding problems across three different models to provide a comprehensive evaluation. The method achieves consistent improvements in code accuracy for two models but efficiency gains vary by model, language and task complexity, indicating that improvements are not uniformly reliable.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出对比提示调优（CPT）方法，通过结合对比学习和提示调优技术，优化大语言模型生成更节能的代码，以支持绿色软件开发。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的代码虽然功能正确，但相比人工编写的解决方案能耗更高，这与绿色软件开发（GSD）减少代码能耗的目标相冲突。研究旨在探索如何优化LLM以促进生成节能代码。
AI.method: 采用对比提示调优（CPT）方法，结合对比学习技术（帮助模型区分高效和低效代码）和提示调优（一种参数高效微调方法，成本仅为传统微调的一小部分）。在Python、Java和C++三种语言的编码问题上对三个不同模型进行了全面评估。
AI.result: CPT方法在两个模型上实现了代码准确性的持续改进，但效率提升因模型、语言和任务复杂度而异，表明改进并非始终可靠。效率增益在不同情况下表现不一致。
AI.conclusion: 虽然CPT方法在提升代码准确性方面表现一致，但在生成节能代码方面的效果受多种因素影响，需要进一步研究以实现更可靠的节能代码生成优化。

title: MFE: A Multimodal Hand Exoskeleton with Interactive Force, Pressure and Thermo-haptic Feedback
summary: Recent advancements in virtual reality and robotic teleoperation have greatly increased the variety of haptic information that must be conveyed to users.
