While existing haptic devices typically provide unimodal feedback to enhance situational awareness, a gap remains in their ability to deliver rich, multimodal sensory feedback encompassing force, pressure, and thermal sensations. To address this limitation, we present the Multimodal Feedback Exoskeleton (MFE), a hand exoskeleton designed to deliver hybrid haptic feedback. The MFE features 20 degrees of freedom for capturing hand pose. For force feedback, it employs an active mechanism capable of generating 3.5-8.1 N of pushing and pulling forces at the fingers' resting pose, enabling realistic interaction with deformable objects. The fingertips are equipped with flat actuators based on the electro-osmotic principle, providing pressure and vibration stimuli and achieving up to 2.47 kPa of contact pressure to render tactile sensations. For thermal feedback, the MFE integrates thermoelectric heat pumps capable of rendering temperatures from 10 to 55 degrees Celsius. We validated the MFE by integrating it into a robotic teleoperation system using the X-Arm 6 and Inspire Hand manipulator. In user studies, participants successfully recognized and manipulated deformable objects and differentiated remote objects with varying temperatures. These results demonstrate that the MFE enhances situational awareness, as well as the usability and transparency of robotic teleoperation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态反馈外骨骼（MFE），用于在机器人遥操作中提供力、压力和热反馈，增强用户的情境感知能力。
AI.motivation: 当前触觉设备通常只能提供单一模态的反馈，无法同时传递力、压力和热等多种感官信息，限制了机器人遥操作系统的情境感知和用户体验。
AI.method: 开发了多模态反馈外骨骼（MFE），包含：20个自由度的手部姿态捕捉；主动力反馈机制（产生3.5-8.1N的推拉力）；基于电渗原理的平面执行器（提供压力和振动刺激，最大接触压力2.47kPa）；热电热泵（温度范围10-55°C）。系统集成到X-Arm 6和Inspire Hand机械臂的遥操作系统中。
AI.result: 用户研究显示，参与者能够成功识别和操作可变形物体，并能区分具有不同温度的远程物体。MFE增强了情境感知能力，提高了机器人遥操作系统的可用性和透明度。
AI.conclusion: MFE通过提供丰富的多模态触觉反馈（力、压力、热），有效解决了现有触觉设备反馈模式单一的问题，显著提升了机器人遥操作系统的性能和用户体验。

title: Combining Static Code Analysis and Large Language Models Improves Correctness and Performance of Algorithm Recognition
summary: Context: Since it is well-established that developers spend a substantial portion of their time understanding source code, the ability to automatically identify algorithms within source code presents a valuable opportunity. This capability can support program comprehension, facilitate maintenance, and enhance overall software quality. Objective: We empirically evaluate how combining LLMs with static code analysis can improve the automated recognition of algorithms, while also evaluating their standalone performance and dependence on identifier names. Method: We perform multiple experiments evaluating the combination of LLMs with static analysis using different filter patterns. We compare this combined approach against their standalone performance under various prompting strategies and investigate the impact of systematic identifier obfuscation on classification performance and runtime. Results: The combination of LLMs with lightweight static analysis performs surprisingly well, reducing required LLM calls by 72.39-97.50% depending on the filter pattern. This not only lowers runtime significantly but also improves F1-scores by up to 12 percentage points (pp) compared to the baseline. Regarding the different prompting strategies, in-context learning with two examples provides an effective trade-off between classification performance and runtime efficiency, achieving F1-scores of 75-77% with only a modest increase in inference time. Lastly, we find that LLMs are not solely dependent on name-information as they are still able to identify most algorithm implementations when identifiers are obfuscated. Conclusion: By combining LLMs with static analysis, we achieve substantial reductions in runtime while simultaneously improving F1-scores, underscoring the value of a hybrid approach.

AI.tldr: 结合LLMs与静态代码分析可显著提升算法识别性能，减少72.39-97.50%的LLM调用，F1分数提高达12个百分点，且LLM不依赖标识符名称
AI.motivation: 开发者花费大量时间理解源代码，自动识别算法有助于程序理解、维护和软件质量提升。需要评估LLMs与静态分析结合对算法识别的影响
AI.method: 通过多组实验评估LLMs与静态分析结合，使用不同过滤模式。比较单独使用LLMs的性能，研究不同提示策略的影响，并测试系统化标识符混淆对分类性能和运行时间的影响
AI.result: LLMs与轻量级静态分析结合表现优异：减少72.39-97.50%的LLM调用，显著降低运行时间；F1分数比基线提高达12个百分点；上下文学习（两个示例）在分类性能和运行效率间达到最佳平衡（F1 75-77%）；LLMs不依赖名称信息，即使标识符混淆仍能识别大多数算法实现
AI.conclusion: LLMs与静态分析结合可在显著减少运行时间的同时提高F1分数，证明了混合方法的有效性。LLMs不完全依赖名称信息，上下文学习是有效的平衡策略

title: From Broad Exploration to Stable Synthesis: Entropy-Guided Optimization for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Combining Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) improves text-to-image (T2I) generation, yet the underlying interaction between CoT's exploration and RL's optimization remains unclear. We present a systematic entropy-based analysis that yields three key insights: (1) CoT expands the generative exploration space, while RL contracts it toward high-reward regions; (2) final reward is strongly negatively correlated with both the mean and variance of image-token entropy, highlighting the need to reduce uncertainty and instability; and (3) the entropy of the textual CoT directly governs downstream image quality, with lower-entropy CoTs leading to better generations. Motivated by these findings, we propose Entropy-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a fine-tuning strategy that reallocates optimization budget by uncertainty: low-entropy tokens are excluded from reward-driven updates to preserve stability, while high-entropy tokens receive an entropy bonus that encourages structured exploration without collapse. Experiments on standard T2I benchmarks demonstrate that EG-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出EG-GRPO方法，通过熵分析指导CoT与RL在文本到图像生成中的交互，实现更优的生成质量
AI.motivation: 虽然结合思维链和强化学习能改进文本到图像生成，但两者之间的交互机制尚不明确，需要系统性分析来理解探索与优化的动态关系
AI.method: 进行熵基分析揭示三个关键发现，并基于此提出熵引导的组相对策略优化方法，根据不确定性重新分配优化预算
AI.result: 在标准文本到图像基准测试中，EG-GRPO实现了最先进的性能表现
AI.conclusion: 熵分析为理解CoT与RL交互提供了系统框架，EG-GRPO通过熵引导的优化策略有效平衡探索与稳定性，提升了文本到图像生成质量

title: Orientation Matters: Learning Radiation Patterns of Multi-Rotor UAVs In-Flight to Enhance Communication Availability Modeling
summary: The paper presents an approach for learning antenna Radiation Patterns (RPs) of a pair of heterogeneous quadrotor Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) by calibration flight data. RPs are modeled either as a Spherical Harmonics series or as a weighted average over inducing samples. Linear regression of polynomial coefficients simultaneously decouples the two independent UAVs' RPs. A joint calibration trajectory exploits available flight time in an obstacle-free anechoic altitude. Evaluation on a real-world dataset demonstrates the feasibility of learning both radiation patterns, achieving 3.6 dB RMS error, the measurement noise level. The proposed RP learning and decoupling can be exploited in rapid recalibration upon payload changes, thereby enabling precise autonomous path planning and swarm control in real-world applications where setup changes are expected.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过校准飞行数据学习异构四旋翼无人机对天线辐射模式的方法，使用球谐函数或加权平均建模，通过多项式系数线性回归同时解耦两个独立无人机的辐射模式，在真实数据集上达到3.6 dB RMS误差。
AI.motivation: 在真实世界应用中，无人机设置经常变化（如有效载荷改变），需要快速重新校准天线辐射模式，以实现精确的自主路径规划和集群控制。现有方法难以同时解耦和学习两个异构无人机的辐射模式。
AI.method: 1. 使用球谐函数级数或诱导样本加权平均建模天线辐射模式；2. 通过多项式系数线性回归同时解耦两个独立无人机的辐射模式；3. 设计联合校准轨迹，在无障碍无回波高度利用可用飞行时间收集数据。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上评估，成功学习两个辐射模式，达到3.6 dB RMS误差（测量噪声水平），验证了方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的辐射模式学习和解耦方法可用于快速重新校准（如有效载荷变化后），从而在预期设置变化的真实应用中实现精确的自主路径规划和集群控制。

title: PAFT: Preservation Aware Fine-Tuning for Minimal-Edit Program Repair
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are effective for automated program repair, but plausible patches that pass the full test suite often rewrite more code than necessary, increasing review and maintenance costs. This over-editing is common because most bugs are localized, while standard supervised fine-tuning provides no explicit signal about which tokens should be preserved and which should be changed. We propose PAFT, a preservation-aware fine-tuning method for minimal-edit program repair. PAFT derives token-level preservation signals by aligning buggy and fixed code, combines them with full-sequence masking, and applies an edit-difficulty curriculum. Across Defects4J and HumanEval-Java, PAFT improves pass@1 by up to 65.6% over standard supervised fine-tuning (StdFT) while reducing average edit distance (AED) by up to 32.6%. On Defects4J with DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B, PAFT also outperforms AdaPatcher, a strong preference-based repair baseline, improving pass@1 from 5.9% to 10.1% while reducing median AED from 61.0 to 42.0. Overall, PAFT preserves stable context and concentrates edits on faulty regions, yielding smaller, more localized, plausible patches without inference-time search, reranking, or post-processing.

AI.tldr: PAFT是一种用于程序修复的保留感知微调方法，通过标记级保留信号、全序列掩码和编辑难度课程，在提高修复成功率的同时显著减少不必要的代码修改。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在程序修复中存在过度编辑问题，即使生成的补丁能通过测试，也经常修改过多不必要的代码，增加了代码审查和维护成本。标准监督微调缺乏明确的标记级保留信号指导模型区分哪些代码应保留、哪些应修改。
AI.method: PAFT方法包含三个核心组件：1) 通过对齐错误代码和修复代码推导标记级保留信号；2) 结合全序列掩码技术；3) 应用编辑难度课程学习策略。该方法旨在让模型学习在修复过程中保留稳定上下文，将编辑集中在错误区域。
AI.result: 在Defects4J和HumanEval-Java基准测试中，PAFT相比标准监督微调将pass@1提高了65.6%，同时将平均编辑距离降低了32.6%。在Defects4J上使用DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B时，PAFT超越了AdaPatcher基线，将pass@1从5.9%提升到10.1%，中位编辑距离从61.0降至42.0。
AI.conclusion: PAFT能够在不依赖推理时搜索、重排序或后处理的情况下，生成更小、更局部化的合理补丁，有效解决了LLM程序修复中的过度编辑问题，提高了修复的精确性和实用性。

title: Dynamical structure of vanishing gradient and overfitting in multi-layer perceptrons
summary: Vanishing gradient and overfitting are two of the most extensively studied problems in the literature about machine learning. However, they are frequently considered in some asymptotic setting, which obscure the underlying dynamical mechanisms responsible for their emergence. In this paper, we aim to provide a clear dynamical description of learning in multi-layer perceptrons. To this end, we introduce a minimal model, inspired by studies by Fukumizu and Amari, to investigate vanishing gradients and overfitting in MLPs trained via gradient descent. Within this model, we show that the learning dynamics may pass through plateau regions and near-optimal regions during training, both of which consist of saddle structures, before ultimately converging to the overfitting region. Under suitable conditions on the training dataset, we prove that, with high probability, the overfitting region collapses to a single attractor modulo symmetry, which corresponds to the overfitting. Moreover, we show that any MLP trained on a finite noisy dataset cannot converge to the theoretical optimum and instead necessarily converges to an overfitting solution.

AI.tldr: 论文通过最小化模型研究多层感知机中的梯度消失和过拟合问题，揭示了学习动态会经过平台区和近最优区等鞍点结构，最终必然收敛到过拟合解。
AI.motivation: 梯度消失和过拟合是机器学习中最广泛研究的问题，但现有研究多在渐近设定下进行，这掩盖了导致这些问题出现的基本动态机制。本文旨在为多层感知机中的学习过程提供清晰的动态描述。
AI.method: 引入受Fukumizu和Amari研究启发的简化模型，研究通过梯度下降训练的多层感知机中的梯度消失和过拟合。该模型允许分析学习动态，包括平台区域和近最优区域等鞍点结构。
AI.result: 学习动态在训练过程中会经过平台区域和近最优区域（两者都由鞍点结构组成），最终收敛到过拟合区域。在训练数据集满足适当条件下，过拟合区域以高概率坍缩为单一吸引子（模对称性）。任何在有限噪声数据集上训练的MLP都无法收敛到理论最优解，而必然收敛到过拟合解。
AI.conclusion: 过拟合不是训练过程中的偶然现象，而是多层感知机在有限噪声数据集上训练的必然结果。该研究为理解梯度消失和过拟合提供了动态视角，揭示了这些现象的根本机制。

title: AI-Assisted Unit Test Writing and Test-Driven Code Refactoring: A Case Study
summary: Many software systems originate as prototypes or minimum viable products (MVPs), developed with an emphasis on delivery speed and responsiveness to changing requirements rather than long-term code maintainability. While effective for rapid delivery, this approach can result in codebases that are difficult to modify, presenting a significant opportunity cost in the era of AI-assisted or even AI-led programming. In this paper, we present a case study of using coding models for automated unit test generation and subsequent safe refactoring, with proposed code changes validated by passing tests. The study examines best practices for iteratively generating tests to capture existing system behavior, followed by model-assisted refactoring under developer supervision. We describe how this workflow constrained refactoring changes, the errors and limitations observed in both phases, the efficiency gains achieved, when manual intervention was necessary, and how we addressed the weak value misalignment we observed in models. Using this approach, we generated nearly 16,000 lines of reliable unit tests in hours rather than weeks, achieved up to 78\% branch coverage in critical modules, and significantly reduced regression risk during large-scale refactoring. These results illustrate software engineering's shift toward an empirical science, emphasizing data collection and constraining mechanisms that support fast, safe iteration.

AI.tldr: 使用AI编码模型进行自动化单元测试生成和后续安全重构的案例研究，通过测试验证代码变更，显著提高测试覆盖率和重构安全性
AI.motivation: 许多软件系统最初作为原型或MVP开发，注重交付速度而非长期代码可维护性，导致代码库难以修改，在AI辅助编程时代存在显著机会成本
AI.method: 采用编码模型进行自动化单元测试生成和后续安全重构的案例研究方法，通过迭代生成测试捕获现有系统行为，然后在开发者监督下进行模型辅助重构，使用通过测试验证代码变更
AI.result: 在数小时内生成近16,000行可靠单元测试（而非数周），关键模块达到78%分支覆盖率，大规模重构期间显著降低回归风险，展示了效率提升和局限性
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了软件工程向经验科学的转变，强调数据收集和约束机制，支持快速、安全的迭代开发，为AI辅助重构提供了实践框架

title: RAGE: A Tightly Coupled Radar-Aided Grip Estimator For Autonomous Race Cars
summary: Real-time estimation of vehicle-tire-road friction is critical for allowing autonomous race cars to safely and effectively operate at their physical limits. Traditional approaches to measure tire grip often depend on costly, specialized sensors that require custom installation, limiting scalability and deployment. In this work, we introduce RAGE, a novel real-time estimator that simultaneously infers the vehicle velocity, slip angles of the tires and the lateral forces that act on them, using only standard sensors, such as IMUs and RADARs, which are commonly available on most of modern autonomous platforms. We validate our approach through both high-fidelity simulations and real-world experiments conducted on the EAV-24 autonomous race car, demonstrating the accuracy and effectiveness of our method in estimating the vehicle lateral dynamics.

AI.tldr: RAGE：一种仅使用标准传感器（IMU和雷达）实时估计车辆速度、轮胎侧偏角和侧向力的新型实时估计器，适用于自动驾驶赛车在极限工况下的安全操作。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶赛车需要在物理极限下安全有效运行，实时估计车辆-轮胎-路面摩擦至关重要。传统方法依赖昂贵、需要定制安装的专用传感器，限制了可扩展性和部署。
AI.method: 提出RAGE（实时估计器），仅使用标准传感器（如IMU和雷达）同时推断车辆速度、轮胎侧偏角和作用于轮胎的侧向力。该方法不依赖昂贵专用传感器。
AI.result: 通过高保真仿真和在EAV-24自动驾驶赛车上进行的真实世界实验验证了该方法，证明了在估计车辆侧向动力学方面的准确性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: RAGE提供了一种使用标准传感器实时估计车辆-轮胎-路面摩擦的可行方案，解决了传统方法依赖昂贵专用传感器的问题，为自动驾驶赛车在极限工况下的安全操作提供了支持。

title: Learning Task-Invariant Properties via Dreamer: Enabling Efficient Policy Transfer for Quadruped Robots
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
summary: Achieving quadruped robot locomotion across diverse and dynamic terrains presents significant challenges, primarily due to the discrepancies between simulation environments and real-world conditions. Traditional sim-to-real transfer methods often rely on manual feature design or costly real-world fine-tuning. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the DreamTIP framework, which incorporates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model architecture to enhance sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Guided by large language models, DreamTIP identifies and leverages Task-Invariant Properties, such as contact stability and terrain clearance, which exhibit robustness to dynamic variations and strong transferability across tasks. These properties are integrated into the world model as auxiliary prediction targets, enabling the policy to learn representations that are insensitive to underlying dynamic changes. Furthermore, an efficient adaptation strategy is designed, employing a mixed replay buffer and regularization constraints to rapidly calibrate to real-world dynamics while effectively mitigating representation collapse and catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on complex terrains, including Stair, Climb, Tilt, and Crawl, demonstrate that DreamTIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both simulated and real-world environments. Our method achieves an average performance improvement of 28.1% across eight distinct simulated transfer tasks. In the real-world Climb task, the baseline method achieved only a 10\ success rate, whereas our method attained a 100% success rate. These results indicate that incorporating Task-Invariant Properties into Dreamer learning offers a novel solution for achieving robust and transferable robot locomotion.

AI.tldr: DreamTIP框架在Dreamer世界模型中引入任务不变属性学习，通过LLM识别接触稳定性、地形间隙等鲁棒属性作为辅助预测目标，结合混合回放缓冲和正则化约束，显著提升四足机器人在复杂地形上的sim-to-real迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 解决四足机器人在多样动态地形上运动时，仿真环境与真实世界条件差异带来的挑战。传统sim-to-real方法依赖手动特征设计或昂贵的真实世界微调，需要更高效鲁棒的迁移方法。
AI.method: 提出DreamTIP框架：1) 利用大语言模型识别任务不变属性（如接触稳定性、地形间隙）；2) 将这些属性作为辅助预测目标集成到Dreamer世界模型中；3) 设计混合回放缓冲和正则化约束的高效适应策略，快速校准真实世界动态，防止表示崩溃和灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在Stair、Climb、Tilt、Crawl等复杂地形上，DreamTIP显著优于现有方法：在8个模拟迁移任务中平均性能提升28.1%；真实世界Climb任务中，基线方法成功率仅10%，而DreamTIP达到100%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将任务不变属性整合到Dreamer学习中，为获得鲁棒且可迁移的机器人运动控制提供了新颖解决方案，有效解决了sim-to-real迁移中的动态变化挑战。

title: Mitigating Data Scarcity in Spaceflight Applications for Offline Reinforcement Learning Using Physics-Informed Deep Generative Models
summary: The deployment of reinforcement learning (RL)-based controllers on physical systems is often limited by poor generalization to real-world scenarios, known as the simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gap. This gap is particularly challenging in spaceflight, where real-world training data are scarce due to high cost and limited planetary exploration data. Traditional approaches, such as system identification and synthetic data generation, depend on sufficient data and often fail due to modeling assumptions or lack of physics-based constraints. We propose addressing this data scarcity by introducing physics-based learning bias in a generative model. Specifically, we develop the Mutual Information-based Split Variational Autoencoder (MI-VAE), a physics-informed VAE that learns differences between observed system trajectories and those predicted by physics-based models. The latent space of the MI-VAE enables generation of synthetic datasets that respect physical constraints. We evaluate MI-VAE on a planetary lander problem, focusing on limited real-world data and offline RL training. Results show that augmenting datasets with MI-VAE samples significantly improves downstream RL performance, outperforming standard VAEs in statistical fidelity, sample diversity, and policy success rate. This work demonstrates a scalable strategy for enhancing autonomous controller robustness in complex, data-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 提出MI-VAE方法解决航天控制中sim-to-real差距问题，通过物理信息生成模型增强有限真实数据，提升RL控制器泛化能力
AI.motivation: 强化学习控制器在物理系统部署中面临仿真到现实的泛化差距，在航天领域尤为严重，因为真实数据稀缺且成本高昂。传统方法如系统辨识和合成数据生成依赖充足数据且常因建模假设或缺乏物理约束而失败。
AI.method: 提出基于互信息的分割变分自编码器（MI-VAE），这是一种物理信息化的VAE，学习观测系统轨迹与基于物理模型预测轨迹之间的差异。MI-VAE的潜在空间能够生成尊重物理约束的合成数据集。
AI.result: 在行星着陆问题上评估MI-VAE，专注于有限真实数据和离线RL训练。结果显示，用MI-VAE样本增强数据集显著提升下游RL性能，在统计保真度、样本多样性和策略成功率方面优于标准VAE。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作展示了在复杂、数据受限环境中增强自主控制器鲁棒性的可扩展策略，通过物理信息生成模型有效缓解sim-to-real差距。

title: Open-Loop Planning, Closed-Loop Verification: Speculative Verification for VLA
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, as large foundation models for embodied control, have shown strong performance in manipulation tasks. However, their performance comes at high inference cost. To improve efficiency, recent methods adopt action chunking, which predicts a sequence of future actions for open-loop execution. Although effective for reducing computation, open-loop execution is sensitive to environmental changes and prone to error accumulation due to the lack of close-loop feedback. To address this limitation, we propose Speculative Verification for VLA Control (SV-VLA), a framework that combines efficient open-loop long-horizon planning with lightweight closed-loop online verification. Specifically, SV-VLA uses a heavy VLA as a low-frequency macro-planner to generate an action chunk together with a planning context, while a lightweight verifier continuously monitors execution based on the latest observations. Conditioned on both the current observation and the planning context, the verifier compares the planned action against a closed-loop reference action and triggers replanning only when necessary. Experiments demonstrate that SV-VLA combines the efficiency of chunked prediction with the robustness of closed-loop control, enabling efficient and reliable VLA-based control in dynamic environments. Code is available: https://github.com/edsad122/SV-VLA.

AI.tldr: SV-VLA框架结合了高效的开环长时程规划与轻量级闭环在线验证，在保持VLA模型效率的同时提升动态环境下的控制鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽然性能强大但推理成本高，采用动作分块预测的方法虽然提高了效率，但开环执行对环境变化敏感且容易累积误差，缺乏闭环反馈。
AI.method: 提出SV-VLA框架：使用重型VLA作为低频宏观规划器生成动作块和规划上下文，同时使用轻量级验证器基于最新观测持续监控执行。验证器结合当前观测和规划上下文，比较规划动作与闭环参考动作，仅在必要时触发重新规划。
AI.result: 实验表明SV-VLA成功结合了分块预测的效率和闭环控制的鲁棒性，能够在动态环境中实现高效可靠的VLA控制。
AI.conclusion: SV-VLA框架有效解决了VLA模型在效率与鲁棒性之间的权衡问题，为动态环境中的具身控制提供了既高效又可靠的解决方案。

title: Matrix Profile for Time-Series Anomaly Detection: A Reproducible Open-Source Benchmark on TSB-AD
summary: Matrix Profile (MP) methods are an interpretable and scalable family of distance-based methods for time-series anomaly detection, but strong benchmark performance still depends on design choices beyond a vanilla nearest-neighbor profile. This technical report documents an open-source Matrix Profile for Anomaly Detection (MMPAD) submission to TSB-AD, a benchmark that covers both univariate and multivariate time series. The submitted system combines pre-sorted multidimensional aggregation, efficient exclusion-zone-aware k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) retrieval for repeated anomalies, and moving-average post-processing. To serve as a reproducible reference for MP-based anomaly detection on TSB-AD, we detail the released implementation, the hyperparameter settings for the univariate and multivariate tracks, and the corresponding benchmark results. We further analyze how the system performs on the aggregate leaderboard and across specific dataset characteristics.The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/mcyeh/mmpad_tsb.

AI.tldr: MMPAD是一个基于矩阵轮廓(Matrix Profile)的时间序列异常检测开源系统，针对TSB-AD基准测试设计，结合了多维聚合、高效的k近邻检索和移动平均后处理技术。
AI.motivation: 矩阵轮廓方法虽然具有可解释性和可扩展性，但在时间序列异常检测中的基准性能仍然依赖于超越基本最近邻轮廓的设计选择。该技术报告旨在提供一个可复现的基于矩阵轮廓的异常检测参考系统，并参与TSB-AD基准测试。
AI.method: 系统结合了三种关键技术：1)预排序的多维聚合；2)高效的排除区感知k近邻检索，用于处理重复异常；3)移动平均后处理。系统针对单变量和多变量时间序列分别配置了超参数设置。
AI.result: 提供了完整的开源实现，详细记录了在TSB-AD基准测试中的超参数设置和对应结果。分析了系统在总体排行榜上的表现以及在不同数据集特性上的性能。
AI.conclusion: MMPAD为基于矩阵轮廓的时间序列异常检测提供了一个可复现的参考实现，通过结合多项优化技术提升了基准性能，并公开了完整的实现代码供研究社区使用。

title: A Flow Matching Framework for Soft-Robot Inverse Dynamics
summary: Learning the inverse dynamics of soft continuum robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional nonlinearities and complex actuation coupling. Conventional feedback-based controllers often suffer from control chattering due to corrective oscillations, while deterministic regression-based learners struggle to capture the complex nonlinear mappings required for accurate dynamic tracking. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an inverse-dynamics framework for open-loop feedforward control that learns the system's differential dynamics as a generative transport map. Specifically, inverse dynamics is reformulated as a conditional flow-matching problem, and Rectified Flow (RF) is adopted as a lightweight instance to generate physically consistent control inputs rather than conditional averages. Two variants are introduced to further enhance physical consistency: RF-Physical, utilizing a physics-based prior for residual modeling; and RF-FWD, integrating a forward-dynamics consistency loss during flow matching. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework reduces trajectory tracking RMSE by over 50% compared to standard regression baselines (MLP, LSTM, Transformer). The system sustains stable open-loop execution at a peak end-effector velocity of 1.14 m/s with sub-millisecond inference latency (0.995 ms). This work demonstrates flow matching as a robust, high-performance paradigm for learning differential inverse dynamics in soft robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于流匹配的软体连续机器人逆动力学学习框架，将逆动力学重构为条件流匹配问题，使用Rectified Flow生成物理一致的控制输入，相比传统回归方法将轨迹跟踪RMSE降低50%以上。
AI.motivation: 软体连续机器人的逆动力学学习面临高维非线性和复杂驱动耦合的挑战。传统反馈控制器存在控制抖动问题，确定性回归方法难以捕捉复杂非线性映射以实现精确动态跟踪。
AI.method: 提出开环前馈控制的逆动力学框架，将逆动力学重构为条件流匹配问题，采用Rectified Flow作为轻量级实例生成物理一致的控制输入而非条件平均值。引入两个变体增强物理一致性：RF-Physical使用物理先验进行残差建模；RF-FWD在流匹配中集成前向动力学一致性损失。
AI.result: 框架将轨迹跟踪RMSE降低50%以上（相比MLP、LSTM、Transformer等基线）。系统在1.14 m/s的峰值末端执行器速度下保持稳定开环执行，推理延迟低于1毫秒（0.995 ms）。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配为软体机器人系统学习微分逆动力学提供了鲁棒、高性能的范式，能够生成物理一致的控制输入，显著提升轨迹跟踪精度和系统性能。

title: Do We Need Frontier Models to Verify Mathematical Proofs?
summary: Advances in training, post-training, and inference-time methods have enabled frontier reasoning models to win gold medals in math competitions and settle challenging open problems. Gaining trust in the responses of these models requires that natural language proofs be checked for errors. LLM judges are increasingly being adopted to meet the growing demand for evaluating such proofs. While verification is considered easier than generation, what model capability does reliable verification actually require? We systematically evaluate four open-source and two frontier LLMs on datasets of human-graded natural language proofs of competition-level problems. We consider two key metrics: verifier accuracy and self-consistency (the rate of agreement across repeated judgments on the same proof). We observe that smaller open-source models are only up to ~10% behind frontier models in accuracy but they are up to ~25% more inconsistent. Furthermore, we see that verifier accuracy is sensitive to prompt choice across all models. We then demonstrate that the smaller models, in fact, do possess the mathematical capabilities to verify proofs at the level of frontier models, but they struggle to reliably elicit these capabilities with general judging prompts. Through an LLM-guided prompt search, we synthesize an ensemble of specialized prompts that overcome the specific failure modes of smaller models, boosting their performance by up to 9.1% in accuracy and 15.9% in self-consistency. These gains are realized across models and datasets, allowing models like Qwen3.5-35B to perform on par with frontier models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro for proof verification.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了LLM在数学证明验证中的能力，发现开源模型在准确性上仅比前沿模型落后约10%，但在一致性上落后达25%。通过LLM引导的提示搜索，开发了专门提示词集合，将小模型的性能提升9.1%准确性和15.9%一致性。
AI.motivation: 随着前沿推理模型在数学竞赛和解决开放问题方面取得突破，需要验证其自然语言证明的正确性。LLM裁判被广泛采用来评估这些证明，但验证所需的具体模型能力尚不明确。研究旨在系统评估不同LLM在验证竞赛级数学证明时的准确性和一致性表现。
AI.method: 系统评估了4个开源模型和2个前沿LLM在人类评分的自然语言证明数据集上的表现。采用两个关键指标：验证器准确性和自我一致性（同一证明重复判断的一致性率）。通过LLM引导的提示搜索，合成专门提示词集合来克服小模型的特定失败模式。
AI.result: 发现开源模型在准确性上仅比前沿模型落后约10%，但在自我一致性上落后达25%。所有模型的验证准确性都对提示选择敏感。通过专门提示词集合，小模型的性能可提升9.1%准确性和15.9%一致性，使Qwen3.5-35B等模型达到与Gemini 3.1 Pro相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 小模型实际上具备与前沿模型相当的数学验证能力，但难以通过通用判断提示可靠地激发这些能力。专门设计的提示词集合可以显著提升小模型的验证性能，使其在证明验证任务上达到前沿模型的水平，这为高效利用较小模型进行可靠证明验证提供了实用方法。

title: Asymptotically-Bounded 3D Frontier Exploration enhanced with Bayesian Information Gain
comment: Submitted for review to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Robotic exploration in large-scale environments is computationally demanding due to the high overhead of processing extensive frontiers. This article presents an OctoMap-based frontier exploration algorithm with predictable, asymptotically bounded performance. Unlike conventional methods whose complexity scales with environment size, our approach maintains a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{F}|)$, where $|\mathcal{F}|$ is the number of frontiers. This is achieved through strategic forward and inverse sensor modeling, which enables approximate yet efficient frontier detection and maintenance. To further enhance performance, we integrate a Bayesian regressor to estimate information gain, circumventing the need to explicitly count unknown voxels when prioritizing viewpoints. Simulations show the proposed method is more computationally efficient than the existing OctoMap-based methods and achieves computational efficiency comparable to baselines that are independent of OctoMap. Specifically, the Bayesian-enhanced framework achieves up to a $54\%$ improvement in total exploration time compared to standard deterministic frontier-based baselines across varying spatial scales, while guaranteeing task completion. Real-world experiments confirm the computational bounds as well as the effectiveness of the proposed enhancement.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于OctoMap的边界探索算法，具有可预测的渐近有界性能，计算复杂度为O(|F|)，通过贝叶斯回归器估计信息增益，相比现有方法显著提升计算效率
AI.motivation: 大规模环境中的机器人探索计算需求高，传统方法复杂度随环境规模增长，需要一种具有可预测性能边界的高效探索算法
AI.method: 采用OctoMap表示环境，通过战略性的前向和逆向传感器建模实现近似但高效的边界检测和维护，集成贝叶斯回归器估计信息增益以避免显式计数未知体素
AI.result: 仿真显示该方法比现有OctoMap方法计算效率更高，与独立于OctoMap的基线方法相当，贝叶斯增强框架相比确定性边界基线在不同空间尺度上总探索时间提升达54%
AI.conclusion: 提出的算法具有可预测的渐近有界性能，计算复杂度与边界数量线性相关，贝叶斯增强显著提升探索效率，实际实验验证了计算边界和增强效果

title: On the Geometric Structure of Layer Updates in Deep Language Models
summary:
We study the geometric structure of layer updates in deep language models. Rather than analyzing what information is encoded in intermediate representations, we ask how representations change from one layer to the next. We show that layerwise updates admit a decomposition into a dominant tokenwise component and a residual that is not captured by restricted tokenwise function classes.
  Across multiple architectures, including Transformers and state-space models, we find that the full layer update is almost perfectly aligned with the tokenwise component, while the residual exhibits substantially weaker alignment, larger angular deviation, and significantly lower projection onto the dominant tokenwise subspace. This indicates that the residual is not merely a small correction, but a geometrically distinct component of the transformation.
  This geometric separation has functional consequences: approximation error under the restricted tokenwise model is strongly associated with output perturbation, with Spearman correlations often exceeding 0.7 and reaching up to 0.95 in larger models. Together, these results suggest that most layerwise updates behave like structured reparameterizations along a dominant direction, while functionally significant computation is concentrated in a geometrically distinct residual component.
  Our framework provides a simple, architecture-agnostic method for probing the geometric and functional structure of layer updates in modern language models.

AI.tldr: 研究发现深度语言模型的层间更新可分解为主导的tokenwise成分和几何上不同的残差成分，后者承载了重要的功能计算。
AI.motivation: 研究深度语言模型中层间更新的几何结构，而非中间表示编码的信息，旨在理解表示如何从一层变化到下一层。
AI.method: 提出一个架构无关的框架，将层间更新分解为tokenwise成分和残差成分，分析两者的几何对齐、角度偏差和投影特性，并评估近似误差与输出扰动的关系。
AI.result: 层间更新几乎完美对齐于tokenwise成分，而残差成分对齐较弱、角度偏差较大、在主导子空间投影较低。近似误差与输出扰动强相关（Spearman相关系数常超过0.7，大模型中可达0.95）。
AI.conclusion: 大多数层间更新表现为沿主导方向的结构化重参数化，而功能上重要的计算集中在几何上不同的残差成分中，这为理解现代语言模型的层更新结构提供了新视角。

title: Behavior-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Credit Assignment for High-Performance Control
summary: Learning high-performance control policies that remain consistent with expert behavior is a fundamental challenge in robotics. Reinforcement learning can discover high-performing strategies but often departs from desirable human behavior, whereas imitation learning is limited by demonstration quality and struggles to improve beyond expert data. We propose a behavior-constrained reinforcement learning framework that improves beyond demonstrations while explicitly controlling deviation from expert behavior. Because expert-consistent behavior in dynamic control is inherently trajectory-level, we introduce a receding-horizon predictive mechanism that models short-term future trajectories and provides look-ahead rewards during training. To account for the natural variability of human behavior under disturbances and changing conditions, we further condition the policy on reference trajectories, allowing it to represent a distribution of expert-consistent behaviors rather than a single deterministic target. Empirically, we evaluate the approach in high-fidelity race car simulation using data from professional drivers, a domain characterized by extreme dynamics and narrow performance margins. The learned policies achieve competitive lap times while maintaining close alignment with expert driving behavior, outperforming baseline methods in both performance and imitation quality. Beyond standard benchmarks, we conduct human-grounded evaluation in a driver-in-the-loop simulator and show that the learned policies reproduce setup-dependent driving characteristics consistent with the feedback of top-class professional race drivers. These results demonstrate that our method enables learning high-performance control policies that are both optimal and behavior-consistent, and can serve as reliable surrogates for human decision-making in complex control systems.

AI.tldr: 提出行为约束强化学习框架，在赛车仿真中学习高性能控制策略，保持与专家行为一致的同时超越演示数据性能
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：强化学习能发现高性能策略但偏离专家行为，模仿学习受限于演示质量且难以超越专家数据。需要一种既能超越演示性能又能控制与专家行为偏差的方法
AI.method: 提出行为约束强化学习框架，引入滚动时域预测机制建模短期未来轨迹，提供前瞻奖励；通过参考轨迹条件化策略，表示专家一致行为的分布而非单一确定性目标
AI.result: 在高保真赛车仿真中使用专业车手数据进行评估，学习策略在保持与专家驾驶行为紧密对齐的同时获得有竞争力的圈速，在性能和模仿质量上均优于基线方法；在驾驶员在环仿真中的人类评估显示策略能再现与顶级职业赛车手反馈一致的设置依赖性驾驶特性
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够学习既最优又行为一致的高性能控制策略，可作为复杂控制系统中人类决策的可靠替代，实现超越演示性能的同时保持专家行为一致性

title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation remains challenging for reinforcement learning (RL) because sparse rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment. Practical policy improvement thus relies on richer intermediate supervision, such as dense progress rewards, which are costly to obtain and ill-suited to non-monotonic behaviors such as backtracking and recovery. To address this, we propose Advantage Reward Modeling (ARM), a framework that shifts from hard-to-quantify absolute progress to estimating relative advantage. We introduce a cost-effective tri-state labeling strategy -- Progressive, Regressive, and Stagnant -- that reduces human cognitive overhead while ensuring high cross-annotator consistency. By training on these intuitive signals, ARM enables automated progress annotation for both complete demonstrations and fragmented DAgger-style data. Integrating ARM into an offline RL pipeline allows for adaptive action-reward reweighting, effectively filtering suboptimal samples. Our approach achieves a 99.4% success rate on a challenging long-horizon towel-folding task, demonstrating improved stability and data efficiency over current VLA baselines with near-zero human intervention during policy training.

AI.tldr: ARM框架通过相对优势估计替代稀疏奖励，使用三状态标注策略减少人工标注成本，在长时程机器人操作任务中实现99.4%成功率
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作中稀疏奖励难以指导信用分配，而密集进度奖励成本高且不适用于非单调行为（如回溯和恢复）
AI.method: 提出优势奖励建模（ARM）框架，从难以量化的绝对进度转向估计相对优势；引入三状态标注策略（进步、退步、停滞）减少人工认知负担；训练模型实现自动化进度标注；将ARM集成到离线RL管道中进行自适应动作-奖励重加权
AI.result: 在挑战性长时程毛巾折叠任务中达到99.4%成功率，相比当前VLA基线在稳定性和数据效率方面均有提升，策略训练期间几乎无需人工干预
AI.conclusion: ARM框架通过相对优势估计和三状态标注策略有效解决了长时程机器人操作中的奖励稀疏问题，实现了高效、稳定的策略学习

title: Time-Warping Recurrent Neural Networks for Transfer Learning
summary:
Dynamical systems describe how a physical system evolves over time. Physical processes can evolve faster or slower in different environmental conditions. We use time-warping as rescaling the time in a model of a physical system. This thesis proposes a new method of transfer learning for Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) based on time-warping. We prove that for a class of linear, first-order differential equations known as time lag models, an LSTM can approximate these systems with any desired accuracy, and the model can be time-warped while maintaining the approximation accuracy.
  The Time-Warping method of transfer learning is then evaluated in an applied problem on predicting fuel moisture content (FMC), an important concept in wildfire modeling. An RNN with LSTM recurrent layers is pretrained on fuels with a characteristic time scale of 10 hours, where there are large quantities of data available for training. The RNN is then modified with transfer learning to generate predictions for fuels with characteristic time scales of 1 hour, 100 hours, and 1000 hours. The Time-Warping method is evaluated against several known methods of transfer learning. The Time-Warping method produces predictions with an accuracy level comparable to the established methods, despite modifying only a small fraction of the parameters that the other methods modify.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于时间扭曲的RNN迁移学习方法，证明了LSTM可以准确近似时间滞后模型，并在野火建模的燃料水分含量预测应用中验证了该方法，仅修改少量参数即可达到与传统方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 物理系统的动态演化在不同环境条件下会有不同的时间尺度，传统迁移学习方法需要大量参数调整。研究旨在开发一种基于时间扭曲的迁移学习方法，通过简单的时间尺度调整来适应不同时间特性的系统，减少参数修改量。
AI.method: 提出基于时间扭曲的RNN迁移学习方法：1) 证明LSTM可以任意精度近似线性一阶微分方程（时间滞后模型）；2) 通过时间扭曲（时间尺度重缩放）调整模型以适应不同时间尺度；3) 在燃料水分含量预测应用中，先在10小时时间尺度的燃料数据上预训练LSTM，然后通过时间扭曲调整模型以预测1小时、100小时和1000小时时间尺度的燃料；4) 与传统迁移学习方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 1) 理论证明LSTM可以准确近似时间滞后模型，且时间扭曲后仍能保持近似精度；2) 在燃料水分含量预测应用中，时间扭曲方法仅修改少量参数，但预测精度与传统迁移学习方法相当；3) 该方法在适应不同时间尺度系统时表现出高效性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于时间扭曲的迁移学习方法为RNN适应不同时间尺度的物理系统提供了一种有效途径，仅需少量参数调整即可达到与传统方法相当的精度，在野火建模等时间尺度敏感的应用中具有实用价值。

title: Enhancing Multi-Robot Exploration Using Probabilistic Frontier Prioritization with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixtures
comment: Submitted for review IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Multi-agent autonomous exploration is essential for applications such as environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and industrial-scale surveillance. However, effective coordination under communication constraints remains a significant challenge. Frontier exploration algorithms analyze the boundary between the known and unknown regions to determine the next-best view that maximizes exploratory gain. This article proposes an enhancement to existing frontier-based exploration algorithms by introducing a probabilistic approach to frontier prioritization. By leveraging Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model (DP-GMM) and a probabilistic formulation of information gain, the method improves the quality of frontier prioritization. The proposed enhancement, integrated into two state-of-the-art multi-agent exploration algorithms, consistently improves performance across environments of varying clutter, communication constraints, and team sizes. Simulations showcase an average gain of $10\%$ and $14\%$ for the two algorithms across all combinations. Successful deployment in real-world experiments with a dual-drone system further corroborates these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率前沿优先级的增强方法，通过Dirichlet过程高斯混合模型和信息增益的概率公式，改进了多智能体自主探索中的前沿优先级排序，在多种环境下平均提升10%-14%性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体自主探索在环境监测、搜救等应用中至关重要，但在通信约束下的有效协调仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的前沿探索算法虽然通过分析已知与未知区域的边界来确定最大化探索收益的最佳视角，但在前沿优先级排序方面仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 提出了一种概率前沿优先级增强方法，采用Dirichlet过程高斯混合模型（DP-GMM）和信息增益的概率公式来改进前沿优先级排序。该方法被集成到两种最先进的多智能体探索算法中，通过概率方法评估前沿区域的信息价值。
AI.result: 在模拟实验中，该方法在两种算法上分别实现了平均10%和14%的性能提升，覆盖了不同杂乱程度、通信约束和团队规模的环境。在真实世界的双无人机系统实验中成功部署，进一步验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的概率前沿优先级增强方法显著提高了多智能体探索算法的性能，特别是在通信受限的环境中。该方法通过更精确地评估前沿区域的信息价值，实现了更好的探索协调和效率。

title: SEDGE: Structural Extrapolated Data Generation
summary: This paper proposes a framework for Structural Extrapolated Data GEneration (SEDGE) based on suitable assumptions on the underlying data generating process. We provide conditions under which data satisfying new specifications can be generated reliably, together with the approximate identifiability of the distribution of such data under certain ``conservative" assumptions. On the algorithmic side, we develop practical methods to achieve extrapolated data generation, based on the structure-informed optimization strategy or diffusion posterior sampling, respectively. We verify the extrapolation performance on synthetic data and also consider extrapolated image generation as a real-world scenario to illustrate the validity of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出基于数据生成过程假设的结构外推数据生成框架SEDGE，确保满足新规范的数据可靠生成及其分布近似可识别性，并提供基于结构优化或扩散后验采样的实用方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据生成方法在外推到新规范时面临挑战，需要建立理论保证和实用方法，确保生成数据满足新规范要求且分布可识别。
AI.method: 基于数据生成过程的结构假设，提出SEDGE框架：1) 理论层面建立新规范数据可靠生成条件及其分布近似可识别性；2) 算法层面开发基于结构信息优化策略或扩散后验采样的实用外推数据生成方法。
AI.result: 在合成数据上验证外推性能，并在外推图像生成这一真实场景中展示框架有效性，证明所提方法能够可靠生成满足新规范的数据。
AI.conclusion: SEDGE框架为结构外推数据生成提供了理论保证和实用算法，能够在保守假设下可靠生成满足新规范的数据并近似识别其分布，在合成和真实场景中均验证了有效性。

title: Joint Prediction of Human Motions and Actions in Human-Robot Collaboration
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE AIM 2026
summary: Fluent human--robot collaboration requires robots to continuously estimate human behaviour and anticipate future intentions. This entails reasoning jointly about \emph{continuous movements} and \emph{discrete actions}, which are still largely modelled in isolation. In this paper, we introduce \textsf{MA-HERP}, a hierarchical and recursive probabilistic framework for the \emph{joint estimation and prediction} of human movements and actions. The model combines: (i) a hierarchical representation in which movements compose into actions through admissible Allen interval relations, (ii) a unified probabilistic factorisation coupling continuous dynamics, discrete labels, and durations, and (iii) a recursive inference scheme inspired by Bayesian filtering, alternating top-down action prediction with bottom-up sensory evidence. We present a preliminary experimental evaluation based on neural models trained on musculoskeletal simulations of reaching movements, showing accurate motion prediction, robust action inference under noise, and computational performance compatible with on-line human--robot collaboration.

AI.tldr: MA-HERP：用于人机协作的层次递归概率框架，联合估计和预测人类连续运动和离散动作
AI.motivation: 流畅的人机协作需要机器人持续估计人类行为并预测未来意图，这需要联合推理连续运动和离散动作，而这两者在现有研究中大多被孤立建模。
AI.method: 提出MA-HERP框架：1）层次表示，通过Allen区间关系将运动组合为动作；2）统一概率因子分解，耦合连续动态、离散标签和持续时间；3）受贝叶斯滤波启发的递归推理方案，交替进行自上而下的动作预测和自下而上的感官证据整合。
AI.result: 基于肌肉骨骼模拟的神经模型初步实验评估显示：准确的运动预测、噪声下的鲁棒动作推断，以及兼容在线人机协作的计算性能。
AI.conclusion: MA-HERP框架能够有效联合估计和预测人类运动和动作，为人机协作中的实时意图理解提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Flash-Mono: Feed-Forward Accelerated Gaussian Splatting Monocular SLAM
summary: Monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM suffers from critical limitations in time efficiency, geometric accuracy, and multi-view consistency. These issues stem from the time-consuming $\textit{Train-from-Scratch}$ optimization and the lack of inter-frame scale consistency from single-frame geometry priors. We contend that a feed-forward paradigm, leveraging multi-frame context to predict Gaussian attributes directly, is crucial for addressing these challenges. We present Flash-Mono, a system composed of three core modules: a feed-forward prediction frontend, a 2D Gaussian Splatting mapping backend, and an efficient hidden-state-based loop closure module. We trained a recurrent feed-forward frontend model that progressively aggregates multi-frame visual features into a hidden state via cross attention and jointly predicts camera poses and per-pixel Gaussian properties. By directly predicting Gaussian attributes, our method bypasses the burdensome per-frame optimization required in optimization-based GS-SLAM, achieving a $\textbf{10x}$ speedup while ensuring high-quality rendering. The power of our recurrent architecture extends beyond efficient prediction. The hidden states act as compact submap descriptors, facilitating efficient loop closure and global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ optimization to mitigate the long-standing challenge of drift. For enhanced geometric fidelity, we replace conventional 3D Gaussian ellipsoids with 2D Gaussian surfels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Flash-Mono achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tracking and mapping quality, highlighting its potential for embodied perception and real-time reconstruction applications. Project page: https://victkk.github.io/flash-mono.

AI.tldr: Flash-Mono是一种基于前馈预测的单目3D高斯溅射SLAM系统，通过多帧上下文直接预测高斯属性，相比传统优化方法实现10倍加速，同时通过2D高斯面元和隐藏状态闭环模块提升几何精度和多视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统单目3D高斯溅射SLAM存在时间效率低、几何精度差和多视角一致性不足的问题，主要源于每帧从头开始优化的耗时过程以及单帧几何先验缺乏帧间尺度一致性。作者认为需要一种利用多帧上下文直接预测高斯属性的前馈范式来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 系统包含三个核心模块：1) 前馈预测前端：训练循环前馈模型，通过交叉注意力逐步聚合多帧视觉特征到隐藏状态，联合预测相机位姿和逐像素高斯属性；2) 2D高斯溅射映射后端：用2D高斯面元替代传统3D高斯椭球体以增强几何保真度；3) 基于隐藏状态的高效闭环模块：利用隐藏状态作为紧凑子图描述符，实现高效闭环和全局Sim(3)优化以缓解漂移问题。
AI.result: Flash-Mono相比基于优化的GS-SLAM方法实现了10倍加速，同时确保了高质量渲染。通过隐藏状态闭环和全局优化有效缓解了长期漂移问题。在跟踪和建图质量方面均达到了最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: Flash-Mono通过前馈预测范式成功解决了传统单目3D高斯溅射SLAM的效率、精度和一致性挑战，展示了在具身感知和实时重建应用中的潜力。系统的高效性和高质量表现使其成为该领域的重要进展。

title: Re-analysis of the Human Transcription Factor Atlas Recovers TF-Specific Signatures from Pooled Single-Cell Screens with Missing Controls
summary: Public pooled single-cell perturbation atlases are valuable resources for studying transcription factor (TF) function, but downstream re-analysis can be limited by incomplete deposited metadata and missing internal controls. Here we re-analyze the human TF Atlas dataset (GSE216481), a MORF-based pooled overexpression screen spanning 3,550 TF open reading frames and 254,519 cells, with a reproducible pipeline for quality control, MORF barcode demultiplexing, per-TF differential expression, and functional enrichment. From 77,018 cells in the pooled screen, we assign 60,997 (79.2\%) to 87 TF identities. Because the deposited barcode mapping lacks the GFP and mCherry negative controls present in the original library, we use embryoid body (EB) cells as an external baseline and remove shared batch/transduction artifacts by background subtraction. This strategy recovers TF-specific signatures for 59 of 61 testable TFs, compared with 27 detected by one-vs-rest alone, showing that robust TF-level signal can be rescued despite missing intra-pool controls. HOPX, MAZ, PAX6, FOS, and FEZF2 emerge as the strongest transcriptional remodelers, while per-TF enrichment links FEZF2 to regulation of differentiation, EGR1 to Hippo and cardiac programs, FOS to focal adhesion, and NFIC to collagen biosynthesis. Condition-level analyses reveal convergent Wnt, neurogenic, EMT, and Hippo signatures, and Harmony indicates minimal confounding batch effects across pooled replicates. Our per-TF effect sizes significantly agree with Joung et al.'s published rankings (Spearman $ρ= -0.316$, $p = 0.013$; negative because lower rank indicates stronger effect). Together, these results show that the deposited TF Atlas data can support validated TF-specific transcriptional and pathway analyses when paired with principled external controls, artifact removal, and reproducible computation.

AI.tldr: 重新分析人类TF Atlas数据集，开发可重复流程进行质量控制、条形码解复用、差异表达和功能富集分析，使用外部对照恢复TF特异性信号，验证数据集可用于可靠的TF功能研究
AI.motivation: 公共单细胞扰动图谱是研究转录因子功能的重要资源，但下游再分析常受限于不完整的元数据和缺失的内部对照，需要开发方法从现有数据中恢复可靠的TF特异性信号
AI.method: 重新分析GSE216481数据集，开发可重复流程进行质量控制、MORF条形码解复用、TF特异性差异表达和功能富集分析；使用胚胎体细胞作为外部基线，通过背景减除去除批次/转导伪影
AI.result: 从77,018个细胞中成功分配60,997个（79.2%）到87个TF身份；恢复59/61个可测试TF的特异性信号（vs. 仅27个通过one-vs-rest检测）；识别HOPX、MAZ、PAX6、FOS、FEZF2为最强转录重塑因子；发现TF特异性富集模式；与已发表排名显著一致（Spearman ρ=-0.316, p=0.013）
AI.conclusion: 当结合原则性外部对照、伪影去除和可重复计算时，已存储的TF Atlas数据能够支持经过验证的TF特异性转录和通路分析，为TF功能研究提供可靠资源

title: An Open-Source LiDAR and Monocular Off-Road Autonomous Navigation Stack
summary: Off-road autonomous navigation demands reliable 3D perception for robust obstacle detection in challenging unstructured terrain. While LiDAR is accurate, it is costly and power-intensive. Monocular depth estimation using foundation models offers a lightweight alternative, but its integration into outdoor navigation stacks remains underexplored. We present an open-source off-road navigation stack supporting both LiDAR and monocular 3D perception without task-specific training. For the monocular setup, we combine zero-shot depth prediction (Depth Anything V2) with metric depth rescaling using sparse SLAM measurements (VINS-Mono). Two key enhancements improve robustness: edge-masking to reduce obstacle hallucination and temporal smoothing to mitigate the impact of SLAM instability. The resulting point cloud is used to generate a robot-centric 2.5D elevation map for costmap-based planning. Evaluated in photorealistic simulations (Isaac Sim) and real-world unstructured environments, the monocular configuration matches high-resolution LiDAR performance in most scenarios, demonstrating that foundation-model-based monocular depth estimation is a viable LiDAR alternative for robust off-road navigation. By open-sourcing the navigation stack and the simulation environment, we provide a complete pipeline for off-road navigation as well as a reproducible benchmark. Code available at https://github.com/LARIAD/Offroad-Nav.

AI.tldr: 提出一个支持LiDAR和单目3D感知的开源越野导航框架，使用Depth Anything V2进行零样本深度估计，结合VINS-Mono进行度量深度重标定，通过边缘掩码和时间平滑增强鲁棒性，在仿真和真实环境中性能接近高分辨率LiDAR。
AI.motivation: 越野自主导航需要可靠的3D感知以在非结构化地形中实现鲁棒的障碍物检测。LiDAR虽然准确但成本高、功耗大，而基于基础模型的单目深度估计提供了轻量级替代方案，但其在户外导航系统中的集成尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出开源越野导航框架，支持LiDAR和单目3D感知。单目方案结合零样本深度预测（Depth Anything V2）和稀疏SLAM测量（VINS-Mono）的度量深度重标定。采用边缘掩码减少障碍物幻觉，时间平滑缓解SLAM不稳定性影响。生成点云后创建机器人中心的2.5D高程地图，用于基于代价地图的规划。
AI.result: 在逼真仿真（Isaac Sim）和真实非结构化环境中评估，单目配置在大多数场景中匹配高分辨率LiDAR性能，表明基于基础模型的单目深度估计是越野导航中可行的LiDAR替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过开源导航框架和仿真环境，提供了完整的越野导航流程和可复现基准。证明基于基础模型的单目深度估计能够替代LiDAR实现鲁棒的越野导航，为低成本、低功耗的越野自主系统提供了可行方案。

title: AdaHOP: Fast and Accurate Low-Precision Training via Outlier-Pattern-Aware Rotation
summary: Low-precision training (LPT) commonly employs Hadamard transforms to suppress outliers and mitigate quantization error in large language models (LLMs). However, prior methods apply a fixed transform uniformly, despite substantial variation in outlier structures across tensors. Through the first systematic study of outlier patterns across weights, activations, and gradients of LLMs, we show that this strategy is fundamentally flawed: the effectiveness of Hadamard-based suppression depends on how the transform's smoothing direction aligns with the outlier structure of each operand -- a property that varies substantially across layers and computation paths. We characterize these patterns into three types: Row-wise, Column-wise, and None. Each pair requires a tailored transform direction or outlier handling strategy to minimize quantization error. Based on this insight, we propose AdaHOP (Adaptive Hadamard transform with Outlier-Pattern-aware strategy), which assigns each matrix multiplication its optimal strategy: Inner Hadamard Transform (IHT) where inner-dimension smoothing is effective, or IHT combined with selective Outlier Extraction (OE) -- routing dominant outliers to a high-precision path -- where it is not. Combined with hardware-aware Triton kernels, AdaHOP achieves BF16 training quality at MXFP4 precision while delivering up to 3.6X memory compression and 1.8X kernel acceleration} over BF16 full-precision training.

AI.tldr: AdaHOP提出自适应Hadamard变换策略，根据LLM中不同张量的异常值模式选择最优量化方案，在MXFP4精度下达到BF16训练质量，实现3.6倍内存压缩和1.8倍内核加速。
AI.motivation: 现有低精度训练方法采用固定的Hadamard变换来抑制异常值和减少量化误差，但忽略了不同张量间异常值结构的显著差异。研究发现异常值模式在权重、激活和梯度中变化很大，固定变换策略存在根本缺陷。
AI.method: 首先系统研究LLM中权重、激活和梯度的异常值模式，将其分为行向、列向和无异常三种类型。基于此提出AdaHOP：根据每个矩阵乘法的异常值模式分配最优策略：当内维度平滑有效时使用内Hadamard变换；否则结合选择性异常值提取，将主导异常值路由到高精度路径。配合硬件感知的Triton内核实现。
AI.result: AdaHOP在MXFP4精度下达到BF16训练质量，相比BF16全精度训练实现高达3.6倍内存压缩和1.8倍内核加速。
AI.conclusion: 异常值模式在LLM的不同张量中存在显著差异，需要针对性的处理策略。AdaHOP通过自适应Hadamard变换和异常值模式感知策略，有效解决了低精度训练中的量化误差问题，在保持训练质量的同时显著提升了效率和内存利用率。

title: FSUNav: A Cerebrum-Cerebellum Architecture for Fast, Safe, and Universal Zero-Shot Goal-Oriented Navigation
summary: Current vision-language navigation methods face substantial bottlenecks regarding heterogeneous robot compatibility, real-time performance, and navigation safety. Furthermore, they struggle to support open-vocabulary semantic generalization and multimodal task inputs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes FSUNav: a Cerebrum-Cerebellum architecture for fast, safe, and universal zero-shot goal-oriented navigation, which innovatively integrates vision-language models (VLMs) with the proposed architecture. The cerebellum module, a high-frequency end-to-end module, develops a universal local planner based on deep reinforcement learning, enabling unified navigation across heterogeneous platforms (e.g., humanoid, quadruped, wheeled robots) to improve navigation efficiency while significantly reducing collision risk. The cerebrum module constructs a three-layer reasoning model and leverages VLMs to build an end-to-end detection and verification mechanism, enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary goal navigation without predefined IDs and improving task success rates in both simulation and real-world environments. Additionally, the framework supports multimodal inputs (e.g., text, target descriptions, and images), further enhancing generalization, real-time performance, safety, and robustness. Experimental results on MP3D, HM3D, and OVON benchmarks demonstrate that FSUNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on object, instance image, and task navigation, significantly outperforming existing methods. Real-world deployments on diverse robotic platforms further validate its robustness and practical applicability.

AI.tldr: FSUNav提出了一种大脑-小脑架构，用于快速、安全、通用的零样本目标导航，通过整合视觉语言模型和深度强化学习，解决了异构机器人兼容性、实时性能、导航安全和开放词汇语义泛化等挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言导航方法面临异构机器人兼容性差、实时性能不足、导航安全性有限等瓶颈，且难以支持开放词汇语义泛化和多模态任务输入。需要一种能同时解决这些挑战的通用导航框架。
AI.method: 提出FSUNav大脑-小脑架构：1) 小脑模块：基于深度强化学习的高频端到端通用局部规划器，支持异构平台统一导航；2) 大脑模块：三层推理模型，利用视觉语言模型构建端到端检测验证机制，实现零样本开放词汇目标导航；3) 支持文本、目标描述、图像等多模态输入。
AI.result: 在MP3D、HM3D和OVON基准测试中，FSUNav在物体导航、实例图像导航和任务导航方面达到最先进性能，显著优于现有方法。在多种机器人平台上的实际部署验证了其鲁棒性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: FSUNav通过创新的大脑-小脑架构成功解决了异构机器人导航的兼容性、实时性、安全性和开放词汇泛化问题，为通用零样本目标导航提供了有效解决方案，在仿真和真实环境中均表现出优越性能。

title: Jump Start or False Start? A Theoretical and Empirical Evaluation of LLM-initialized Bandits
summary: The recent advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers new opportunities to generate user preference data to warm-start bandits. Recent studies on contextual bandits with LLM initialization (CBLI) have shown that these synthetic priors can significantly lower early regret. However, these findings assume that LLM-generated choices are reasonably aligned with actual user preferences. In this paper, we systematically examine how LLM-generated preferences perform when random and label-flipping noise is injected into the synthetic training data. For aligned domains, we find that warm-starting remains effective up to 30% corruption, loses its advantage around 40%, and degrades performance beyond 50%. When there is systematic misalignment, even without added noise, LLM-generated priors can lead to higher regret than a cold-start bandit. To explain these behaviors, we develop a theoretical analysis that decomposes the effect of random label noise and systematic misalignment on the prior error driving the bandit's regret, and derive a sufficient condition under which LLM-based warm starts are provably better than a cold-start bandit. We validate these results across multiple conjoint datasets and LLMs, showing that estimated alignment reliably tracks when warm-starting improves or degrades recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM生成偏好数据在注入随机和标签翻转噪声时的表现，发现对齐领域在30%污染内有效，40%失去优势，50%以上性能下降；系统不对齐时LLM先验可能导致比冷启动更高的遗憾
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设LLM生成的用户偏好数据与实际偏好合理对齐，但缺乏对噪声和不对齐情况的系统性分析。需要研究LLM生成数据在不同噪声水平下的表现，以及系统不对齐对上下文多臂赌博机性能的影响。
AI.method: 通过向LLM生成的合成训练数据注入随机和标签翻转噪声，系统性地测试不同噪声水平下的性能。开发理论分析框架，分解随机标签噪声和系统不对齐对先验误差的影响，推导LLM热启动优于冷启动的充分条件。在多个联合数据集和LLM上进行验证。
AI.result: 在对齐领域，热启动在30%污染内保持有效，40%左右失去优势，超过50%性能下降。当存在系统不对齐时，即使没有额外噪声，LLM生成的先验也可能导致比冷启动更高的遗憾。估计的对齐度能可靠地追踪热启动何时改善或降低推荐质量。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成偏好数据的热启动效果受噪声和不对齐程度显著影响。理论分析提供了LLM热启动优于冷启动的充分条件，对齐度估计可作为实际应用中判断热启动有效性的可靠指标。

title: The Compression Gap: Why Discrete Tokenization Limits Vision-Language-Action Model Scaling
summary: Scaling Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by upgrading the vision encoder is expected to improve downstream manipulation performance--as it does in vision-language modeling. We show that this expectation fails when actions are represented as discrete tokens, and explain why through an information-theoretic principle we call the Compression Gap: in any visuomotor pipeline, scaling behavior is governed by the location of the tightest information bottleneck. When actions are continuous (e.g., Diffusion Policy), the vision encoder is the binding constraint, and upgrading it directly improves performance. When actions are discretized through a fixed-capacity codebook (e.g., OAT), the codebook becomes the binding constraint, and encoder improvements cannot propagate past it--regardless of how rich the upstream representation is. We validate this principle on the LIBERO benchmark with three lines of evidence: a factorial experiment showing that encoder upgrades improve Diffusion Policy by over 21 percentage points while OAT gains are substantially attenuated across model scales; an encoder quality gradient across four encoders confirming that Diffusion Policy tracks encoder quality monotonically while OAT remains flat; and a codebook size experiment demonstrating that relaxing codebook capacity partially recovers encoder sensitivity, providing causal evidence for the bottleneck hypothesis. Our findings reveal that scaling in Physical AI requires identifying where information bottlenecks lie in the pipeline, rather than uniformly increasing model or data size.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在视觉-语言-动作模型中，当动作表示为离散标记时，升级视觉编码器无法提升下游操作性能，这与视觉-语言建模不同。原因在于"压缩间隙"信息瓶颈原理：离散化动作的固定容量码本成为约束瓶颈，阻止了上游编码器改进的传播。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，在视觉-语言-动作模型中升级视觉编码器应该像在视觉-语言模型中一样提升下游性能。然而，当动作表示为离散标记时，这种预期可能不成立。研究旨在探索为什么会出现这种差异，并揭示影响物理AI系统扩展性的关键因素。
AI.method: 提出"压缩间隙"信息瓶颈原理，通过LIBERO基准测试进行三方面验证：1) 因子实验比较Diffusion Policy和OAT在不同模型规模下的性能变化；2) 使用四种不同质量编码器验证编码器质量梯度对两种方法的影响；3) 码本容量实验，通过放松码本容量来检验瓶颈假设的因果证据。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：Diffusion Policy（连续动作）通过升级视觉编码器性能提升超过21个百分点，而OAT（离散动作）的增益显著衰减；编码器质量梯度实验中，Diffusion Policy性能随编码器质量单调提升，而OAT保持平坦；增加码本容量能部分恢复编码器敏感性，为瓶颈假设提供因果证据。
AI.conclusion: 物理AI系统的扩展性取决于识别信息流程中的瓶颈位置，而非简单地增加模型或数据规模。当动作离散化时，固定容量的码本成为约束瓶颈，阻止上游视觉编码器改进的传播。这为设计可扩展的视觉-语言-动作系统提供了重要指导。

title: Fast NF4 Dequantization Kernels for Large Language Model Inference
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, EMC2 Workshop at ASPLOS 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have grown beyond the memory capacity of single GPU devices, necessitating quantization techniques for practical deployment. While NF4 (4-bit NormalFloat) quantization enables 4$\times$ memory reduction, inference on current NVIDIA GPUs (e.g., Ampere A100) requires expensive dequantization back to FP16 format, creating a critical performance bottleneck. This paper presents a lightweight shared memory optimization that addresses this gap through principled memory hierarchy exploitation while maintaining full ecosystem compatibility. We compare our technique against the open-source BitsAndBytes implementation, achieving 2.0--2.2$\times$ kernel speedup across three models (Gemma 27B, Qwen3 32B, and Llama3.3 70B) and up to 1.54$\times$ end-to-end improvement by leveraging the 12--15$\times$ latency advantage of shared memory over global memory access. Our optimization reduces instruction counts through simplified indexing logic while using only 64 bytes of shared memory per thread block, demonstrating that lightweight optimizations can deliver substantial performance gains with minimal engineering effort. This work provides a plug-and-play solution for the HuggingFace ecosystem that democratizes access to advanced models on existing GPU infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级共享内存优化技术，解决NF4量化模型在NVIDIA GPU上推理时的性能瓶颈，通过内存层次结构利用实现2-2.2倍内核加速，保持完整生态系统兼容性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已超出单GPU设备的内存容量，需要量化技术进行实际部署。虽然NF4量化可实现4倍内存减少，但在当前NVIDIA GPU上进行推理时需要昂贵的反量化回FP16格式，这造成了关键性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出轻量级共享内存优化技术，通过原则性的内存层次结构利用来解决这一差距。该技术利用共享内存相对于全局内存12-15倍的延迟优势，通过简化索引逻辑减少指令计数，每个线程块仅使用64字节共享内存。
AI.result: 在三个模型（Gemma 27B、Qwen3 32B和Llama3.3 70B）上实现了2.0-2.2倍的内核加速，通过利用共享内存优势实现高达1.54倍的端到端改进。与开源BitsAndBytes实现相比，展示了显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级优化能以最小工程努力提供实质性性能增益。这项工作为HuggingFace生态系统提供了一个即插即用的解决方案，使现有GPU基础设施能够更高效地运行先进模型。

title: Safety-Critical Centralized Nonlinear MPC for Cooperative Payload Transportation by Two Quadrupedal Robots
summary: This paper presents a safety-critical centralized nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for cooperative payload transportation by two quadrupedal robots. The interconnected robot-payload system is modeled as a discrete-time nonlinear differential-algebraic system, capturing the coupled dynamics through holonomic constraints and interaction wrenches. To ensure safety in complex environments, we develop a control barrier function (CBF)-based NMPC formulation that enforces collision avoidance constraints for both the robots and the payload. The proposed approach retains the interaction wrenches as decision variables, resulting in a structured DAE-constrained optimal control problem that enables efficient real-time implementation. The effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through extensive hardware experiments on two Unitree Go2 platforms performing cooperative payload transportation in cluttered environments under mass and inertia uncertainty and external push disturbances.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于双四足机器人协同载荷运输的安全关键集中式非线性模型预测控制框架，通过控制屏障函数确保避障安全，并在硬件实验中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决多机器人协同载荷运输中的安全控制问题，特别是在复杂环境中需要同时确保机器人、载荷和环境障碍物之间的碰撞避免，同时处理系统动力学耦合、质量惯性不确定性和外部扰动。
AI.method: 1) 将互联机器人-载荷系统建模为离散时间非线性微分代数系统，通过完整约束和交互力矩捕捉耦合动力学；2) 开发基于控制屏障函数的NMPC框架，强制执行机器人和载荷的碰撞避免约束；3) 将交互力矩保留为决策变量，形成结构化DAE约束最优控制问题，实现高效实时计算。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2平台上进行了广泛的硬件实验，验证了算法在杂乱环境中协同载荷运输的有效性，能够处理质量和惯性不确定性以及外部推力扰动。
AI.conclusion: 提出的安全关键集中式NMPC框架成功实现了双四足机器人的协同载荷运输，通过CBF确保安全约束，DAE建模准确捕捉系统耦合，硬件实验证明了其在现实条件下的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: ROMAN: A Multiscale Routing Operator for Convolutional Time Series Models
summary: We introduce ROMAN (ROuting Multiscale representAtioN), a deterministic operator for time series that maps temporal scale and coarse temporal position into an explicit channel structure while reducing sequence length. ROMAN builds an anti-aliased multiscale pyramid, extracts fixed-length windows from each scale, and stacks them as pseudochannels, yielding a compact representation on which standard convolutional classifiers can operate. In this way, ROMAN provides a simple mechanism to control the inductive bias of downstream models: it can reduce temporal invariance, make temporal pooling implicitly coarse-position-aware, and expose multiscale interactions through channel mixing, while often improving computational efficiency by shortening the processed time axis. We formally analyze the ROMAN operator and then evaluate it in two complementary ways by measuring its impact as a preprocessing step for four representative convolutional classifiers: MiniRocket, MultiRocket, a standard CNN-based classifier, and a fully convolutional network (FCN) classifier. First, we design synthetic time series classification tasks that isolate coarse position awareness, long-range correlation, multiscale interaction, and full positional invariance, showing that ROMAN behaves consistently with its intended mechanism and is most useful when class information depends on temporal structure that standard pooled convolution tends to suppress. Second, we benchmark the same models with and without ROMAN on long-sequence subsets of the UCR and UEA archives, showing that ROMAN provides a practically useful alternative representation whose effect on accuracy is task-dependent, but whose effect on efficiency is often favorable. Code is available at https://github.com/gon-uri/ROMAN

AI.tldr: ROMAN是一种确定性时间序列算子，通过构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔，将时间尺度和粗粒度时间位置映射到显式通道结构中，同时减少序列长度，为卷积分类器提供紧凑的多尺度表示。
AI.motivation: 标准卷积分类器在处理时间序列时通常通过池化操作获得时间不变性，但这会抑制对时间结构（如粗粒度位置、长程相关性、多尺度交互）的敏感性。需要一种机制来显式控制下游模型的归纳偏置，使其能够更好地捕捉时间序列中的结构信息。
AI.method: ROMAN算子构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔，从每个尺度提取固定长度的窗口，并将它们堆叠为伪通道，形成紧凑表示。该表示将时间尺度和粗粒度时间位置映射到通道维度，同时缩短处理的时间轴。标准卷积分类器可直接在此表示上操作。
AI.result: 在合成任务中，ROMAN在需要粗粒度位置感知、长程相关性、多尺度交互和完全位置不变性的场景中表现一致，特别适用于标准池化卷积倾向于抑制的时间结构信息。在UCR和UEA档案的长序列子集上，ROMAN的效果因任务而异，但在计算效率方面通常具有优势。
AI.conclusion: ROMAN提供了一种简单有效的机制来控制卷积分类器的归纳偏置，使其能够更好地处理时间序列中的结构信息。它通过将多尺度表示映射到通道维度，在保持或提升性能的同时提高了计算效率，为时间序列分类提供了一种实用的替代表示方法。

title: VoxelCodeBench: Benchmarking 3D World Modeling Through Code Generation
summary: Evaluating code generation models for 3D spatial reasoning requires executing generated code in realistic environments and assessing outputs beyond surface-level correctness. We introduce a platform VoxelCode, for analyzing code generation capabilities for 3D understanding and environment creation. Our platform integrates natural language task specification, API-driven code execution in Unreal Engine, and a unified evaluation pipeline supporting both automated metrics and human assessment. To demonstrate its utility, we construct VoxelCodeBench, a benchmark of voxel manipulation tasks spanning three reasoning dimensions: symbolic interpretation, geometric construction, and artistic composition. Evaluating leading code generation models, we find that producing executable code is far easier than producing spatially correct outputs, with geometric construction and multi-object composition proving particularly challenging. By open-sourcing our platform and benchmark, we provide the community with extensible infrastructure for developing new 3D code generation benchmarks and probing spatial reasoning in future models.

AI.tldr: VoxelCode平台用于评估3D空间推理的代码生成模型，通过Unreal Engine执行代码并评估输出，构建了VoxelCodeBench基准测试，发现生成可执行代码比生成空间正确输出更容易
AI.motivation: 评估3D空间推理的代码生成模型需要在实际环境中执行生成的代码，并评估超越表面正确性的输出质量。现有方法缺乏统一的评估平台
AI.method: 开发VoxelCode平台，集成自然语言任务规范、Unreal Engine的API驱动代码执行，以及支持自动指标和人工评估的统一评估流水线。构建VoxelCodeBench基准测试，包含符号解释、几何构造和艺术创作三个推理维度的体素操作任务
AI.result: 评估领先的代码生成模型发现：生成可执行代码远比生成空间正确的输出容易，几何构造和多对象组合任务尤其具有挑战性
AI.conclusion: 通过开源平台和基准测试，为社区提供了可扩展的基础设施，用于开发新的3D代码生成基准测试，并探索未来模型的空间推理能力

title: Steerable but Not Decodable: Function Vectors Operate Beyond the Logit Lens
summary: Function vectors (FVs) -- mean-difference directions extracted from in-context learning demonstrations -- can steer large language model behavior when added to the residual stream. We hypothesized that FV steering failures reflect an absence of task-relevant information: the logit lens would fail alongside steering. We were wrong. In the most comprehensive cross-template FV transfer study to date - 4,032 pairs across 12 tasks, 6 models from 3 families (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-v0.3; base and instruction-tuned), 8 templates per task - we find the opposite dissociation: FV steering succeeds even when the logit lens cannot decode the correct answer at any layer. This steerability-without-decodability pattern is universal: steering exceeds logit lens accuracy for every task on every model, with gaps as large as -0.91. Only 3 of 72 task-model instances show the predicted decodable-without-steerable pattern, all in Mistral. FV vocabulary projection reveals that FVs achieving over 0.90 steering accuracy still project to incoherent token distributions, indicating FVs encode computational instructions rather than answer directions. FVs intervene optimally at early layers (L2-L8); the logit lens detects correct answers only at late layers (L28-L32). The previously reported negative cosine-transfer correlation (r=-0.572) dissolves at scale: pooled r ranges from -0.199 to +0.126, and cosine adds less than 0.011 in R-squared beyond task identity. Post-steering analysis reveals a model-family divergence: Mistral FVs rewrite intermediate representations; Llama/Gemma FVs produce near-zero changes despite successful steering. Activation patching confirms causal localization: easy tasks achieve perfect recovery at targeted layers; hard tasks show zero recovery everywhere.

AI.tldr: 研究发现函数向量（FVs）即使在对数透镜无法解码正确答案时仍能成功引导模型行为，揭示了FVs编码的是计算指令而非答案方向，且不同模型家族在引导机制上存在差异。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在验证假设：函数向量引导失败反映了任务相关信息的缺失，即对数透镜会与引导同时失败。通过大规模跨模板FV转移研究来检验这一假设。
AI.method: 进行了迄今为止最全面的跨模板FV转移研究：4,032对样本，涵盖12个任务、6个模型（来自3个家族：Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Mistral-7B-v0.3的基础版和指令调优版），每个任务8个模板。使用对数透镜和FV词汇投影分析，并进行激活修补以验证因果定位。
AI.result: 发现与假设相反：FV引导成功时，对数透镜仍无法在任何层解码正确答案。引导-无解码模式具有普遍性：在所有任务和模型上，引导准确率均超过对数透镜，最大差距达-0.91。仅3个任务-模型实例显示预测的解码-无引导模式（均在Mistral中）。FV词汇投影显示高引导准确率的FVs仍投影到不连贯的标记分布。FV在早期层（L2-L8）干预效果最佳，而对数透镜仅在晚期层（L28-L32）检测到正确答案。先前报告的负余弦转移相关性（r=-0.572）在大规模研究中消失。不同模型家族在引导机制上存在差异：Mistral FVs重写中间表示，而Llama/Gemma FVs产生近零变化。
AI.conclusion: 函数向量编码的是计算指令而非答案方向，其引导机制与对数透镜的解码能力存在根本性分离。不同模型家族采用不同的引导策略，且任务难度影响因果定位效果。这些发现挑战了关于FV引导机制的现有假设，为理解语言模型内部计算提供了新视角。

title: Analytic Drift Resister for Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning
summary: Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning (NECGL) seeks to eliminate the privacy risks intrinsic to rehearsal-based paradigms by retaining solely class-level prototype representations rather than raw graph examples for mitigating catastrophic forgetting. However, this design choice inevitably precipitates feature drift. As a nascent alternative, Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) capitalizes on the intrinsic generalization properties of frozen pre-trained models to bolster continual learning performance. Nonetheless, a key drawback resides in the pronounced attenuation of model plasticity. To surmount these challenges, we propose Analytic Drift Resister (ADR), a novel and theoretically grounded NECGL framework. ADR exploits iterative backpropagation to break free from the frozen pre-trained constraint, adapting to evolving task graph distributions and fortifying model plasticity. Since parameter updates trigger feature drift, we further propose Hierarchical Analytic Merging (HAM), performing layer-wise merging of linear transformations in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via ridge regression, thereby ensuring absolute resistance to feature drift. On this basis, Analytic Classifier Reconstruction (ACR) enables theoretically zero-forgetting class-incremental learning. Empirical evaluation on four node classification benchmarks demonstrates that ADR maintains strong competitiveness against existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: ADR是一个新颖的非示例持续图学习框架，通过分层分析合并和解析分类器重建来解决特征漂移问题，实现零遗忘的类增量学习。
AI.motivation: 现有NECGL方法因仅保留类级原型表示而导致特征漂移，而ACL方法虽然利用预训练模型的泛化特性，但模型可塑性显著衰减。需要克服这两个挑战。
AI.method: 提出ADR框架：1) 使用迭代反向传播打破预训练模型冻结约束，增强模型可塑性；2) 提出HAM通过岭回归对GNN的线性变换进行分层合并，绝对抵抗特征漂移；3) 提出ACR实现理论上零遗忘的类增量学习。
AI.result: 在四个节点分类基准测试上的实证评估表明，ADR与现有最先进方法相比保持了强大的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ADR通过结合迭代反向传播、分层分析合并和解析分类器重建，有效解决了NECGL中的特征漂移问题，同时保持了模型可塑性，实现了零遗忘的持续图学习。

title: AXELRAM: Quantize Once, Never Dequantize
summary:
We propose AXELRAM, a smart SRAM macro architecture that computes attention scores directly from quantized KV cache indices without dequantization. The key enabler is a design-time fixed codebook: orthogonal-transform-based quantization concentrates each coordinate's distribution to N(0,1/d), so the optimal quantizer depends only on dimension d and bit-width b, not on input data. The asymmetric path design -- transform on write, table-lookup on read with no inverse transform -- reduces per-query multiplications by 102.4x (a mathematical identity).
  Through multi-seed evaluation (10 seeds x 3 models), we discover that sign pattern sensitivity causes catastrophic PPL spikes (Delta > 50) on certain models (Qwen2.5-3B), while others (LLaMA-3.1-8B) are fully stable. This phenomenon extends SpinQuant's observation of rotation variance in weight quantization to the KV cache domain, where the effect is qualitatively more severe. We trace the root cause to layer-wise norm heterogeneity and propose a gradient-free sign pattern selection (200 candidates, 8 calibration samples, one-time) that eliminates catastrophic spikes with zero additional hardware cost. All source code is available at https://github.com/Axelidea/AXELRAM.

AI.tldr: AXELRAM是一种智能SRAM宏架构，可直接从量化KV缓存索引计算注意力分数而无需反量化，通过设计时固定码本和不对称路径设计实现102.4倍乘法减少，并解决了某些模型中的灾难性PPL峰值问题。
AI.motivation: 动机是解决KV缓存量化中的计算效率问题。传统方法需要反量化操作，而AXELRAM旨在直接从量化索引计算注意力分数，减少计算开销。同时发现某些模型存在符号模式敏感性导致的灾难性PPL峰值问题，需要解决这一稳定性问题。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）基于正交变换的量化将坐标分布集中到N(0,1/d)，创建设计时固定码本；2）不对称路径设计（写入时变换，读取时查表，无逆变换）；3）通过多种子评估发现符号模式敏感性现象；4）提出基于层间范数异质性的梯度无关符号模式选择方法（200候选，8校准样本，一次性）。
AI.result: 结果：1）实现每查询乘法减少102.4倍；2）发现Qwen2.5-3B等模型存在灾难性PPL峰值（Δ>50），而LLaMA-3.1-8B完全稳定；3）提出的符号模式选择方法消除了灾难性峰值，无需额外硬件成本；4）所有源代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 结论：AXELRAM架构成功实现了直接从量化KV缓存索引计算注意力分数，显著减少计算开销。同时揭示了KV缓存量化中的符号模式敏感性现象，并提供了有效的解决方案，为高效稳定的注意力计算提供了新方法。

title: Conditional Sampling via Wasserstein Autoencoders and Triangular Transport
summary: We present Conditional Wasserstein Autoencoders (CWAEs), a framework for conditional simulation that exploits low-dimensional structure in both the conditioned and the conditioning variables. The key idea is to modify a Wasserstein autoencoder to use a (block-) triangular decoder and impose an appropriate independence assumption on the latent variables. We show that the resulting model gives an autoencoder that can exploit low-dimensional structure while simultaneously the decoder can be used for conditional simulation. We explore various theoretical properties of CWAEs, including their connections to conditional optimal transport (OT) problems. We also present alternative formulations that lead to three architectural variants forming the foundation of our algorithms. We present a series of numerical experiments that demonstrate that our different CWAE variants achieve substantial reductions in approximation error relative to the low-rank ensemble Kalman filter (LREnKF), particularly in problems where the support of the conditional measures is truly low-dimensional.

AI.tldr: 提出条件Wasserstein自编码器(CWAEs)框架，通过修改Wasserstein自编码器使用(块)三角解码器并施加适当的潜在变量独立性假设，实现条件模拟并利用低维结构。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够同时利用被条件变量和条件变量低维结构的条件模拟框架，改进现有方法在条件分布支撑集真正低维时的性能。
AI.method: 修改Wasserstein自编码器，采用(块)三角解码器结构，对潜在变量施加独立性假设，建立与条件最优传输问题的理论联系，提出三种架构变体。
AI.result: 不同CWAE变体相比低秩集成卡尔曼滤波器(LREnKF)显著降低了近似误差，特别是在条件测度支撑集真正低维的问题中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: CWAEs提供了一个有效的条件模拟框架，能够利用低维结构，在条件分布支撑集低维时相比传统方法有显著优势，并建立了与条件最优传输的理论联系。

title: Generalization Limits of Reinforcement Learning Alignment
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, accepted at JSAI 2026
summary: The safety of large language models (LLMs) relies on alignment techniques such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). However, recent theoretical analyses suggest that reinforcement learning-based training does not acquire new capabilities but merely redistributes the utilization probabilities of existing ones. In this study, we propose ``compound jailbreaks'' targeting OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, which exploit the generalization failures of alignment. This approach combines multiple attack techniques -- each individually defended against -- to saturate the instruction hierarchy maintenance process. Our evaluation shows that the attack success rate (ASR) increased from 14.3\% with individual methods to 71.4\% with the combined approach. These results provide empirical evidence for the hypothesis that safety training does not generalize as broadly as model capabilities, highlighting the need for multifaceted safety evaluations using compound attack scenarios.

AI.tldr: 通过组合多种攻击技术形成"复合越狱"，针对OpenAI GPT模型的安全对齐机制进行攻击，攻击成功率从14.3%提升至71.4%，证明安全训练泛化能力弱于模型能力
AI.motivation: 现有理论分析表明基于强化学习的对齐训练可能只是重新分配现有能力的利用概率，而非获得新能力。本研究旨在通过实证验证安全对齐的泛化失败问题，特别是当多种攻击技术组合时，安全机制可能被绕过
AI.method: 提出"复合越狱"攻击方法，针对OpenAI gpt-oss-20b模型，组合多种已被单独防御的攻击技术，通过饱和指令层次维护过程来利用对齐的泛化失败
AI.result: 攻击成功率从单一方法的14.3%显著提升至复合攻击的71.4%，为安全训练泛化能力弱于模型能力的假设提供了实证证据
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐训练无法像模型能力那样广泛泛化，需要使用复合攻击场景进行多方面的安全评估，当前的安全机制在面对组合攻击时存在显著脆弱性

title: Product-Stability: Provable Convergence for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability
summary: Empirically, modern deep learning training often occurs at the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the sharpness of the loss exceeds the threshold below which classical convergence analysis applies. Despite recent progress, existing theoretical explanations of EoS either rely on restrictive assumptions or focus on specific squared-loss-type objectives. In this work, we introduce and study a structural property of loss functions that we term product-stability. We show that for losses with product-stable minima, gradient descent applied to objectives of the form $(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$ can provably converge to the local minimum even when training in the EoS regime. This framework substantially generalizes prior results and applies to a broad class of losses, including binary cross entropy. Using bifurcation diagrams, we characterize the resulting training dynamics, explain the emergence of stable oscillations, and precisely quantify the sharpness at convergence. Together, our results offer a principled explanation for stable EoS training for a wider class of loss functions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了损失函数的乘积稳定性特性，证明了对于具有乘积稳定极小值的损失函数，即使在边缘稳定性(EoS)区域训练，梯度下降也能收敛到局部极小值，这推广了先前结果并适用于更广泛的损失函数类别。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习训练常在边缘稳定性(EoS)区域进行，此时损失函数的锐度超过了经典收敛分析适用的阈值。现有EoS理论解释要么依赖严格假设，要么仅关注特定平方损失类型目标，需要更通用的理论框架来解释更广泛损失函数在EoS区域的稳定训练。
AI.method: 引入并研究损失函数的乘积稳定性结构特性，证明对于具有乘积稳定极小值的损失函数，梯度下降应用于形式为$(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$的目标函数时，即使在EoS区域也能收敛到局部极小值。使用分岔图分析训练动态，解释稳定振荡的出现，并精确量化收敛时的锐度。
AI.result: 该框架显著推广了先前结果，适用于包括二元交叉熵在内的广泛损失函数类别。通过分岔图表征了训练动态，解释了稳定振荡的出现机制，并精确量化了收敛时的锐度，为更广泛损失函数在EoS区域的稳定训练提供了原理性解释。
AI.conclusion: 乘积稳定性为理解损失函数在边缘稳定性区域的训练行为提供了新的理论框架，能够解释更广泛损失函数在EoS区域的稳定训练动态，包括收敛性、振荡现象和锐度量化，推进了对现代深度学习训练机制的理论理解。

title: Finding Belief Geometries with Sparse Autoencoders
summary:
Understanding the geometric structure of internal representations is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. Prior work has shown that transformers trained on sequences generated by hidden Markov models encode probabilistic belief states as simplex-shaped geometries in their residual stream, with vertices corresponding to latent generative states. Whether large language models trained on naturalistic text develop analogous geometric representations remains an open question.
  We introduce a pipeline for discovering candidate simplex-structured subspaces in transformer representations, combining sparse autoencoders (SAEs), $k$-subspace clustering of SAE features, and simplex fitting using AANet. We validate the pipeline on a transformer trained on a multipartite hidden Markov model with known belief-state geometry. Applied to Gemma-2-9B, we identify 13 priority clusters exhibiting candidate simplex geometry ($K \geq 3$).
  A key challenge is distinguishing genuine belief-state encoding from tiling artifacts: latents can span a simplex-shaped subspace without the mixture coordinates carrying predictive signal beyond any individual feature. We therefore adopt barycentric prediction as our primary discriminating test. Among the 13 priority clusters, 3 exhibit a highly significant advantage on near-vertex samples (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-14}$) and 4 on simplex-interior samples. Together 5 distinct real clusters pass at least one split, while no null cluster passes either. One cluster, 768_596, additionally achieves the highest causal steering score in the dataset. This is the only case where passive prediction and active intervention converge. We present these findings as preliminary evidence that genuine belief-like geometry exists in Gemma-2-9B's representation space, and identify the structured evaluation that would be required to confirm this interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从transformer表示中发现候选单纯形结构子空间的流程，在Gemma-2-9B中识别出13个具有单纯形几何特征的优先级簇，其中5个通过了重心的预测测试，为大型语言模型中存在类似信念状态的几何表示提供了初步证据。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型在自然文本训练中是否发展出类似隐藏马尔可夫模型中观察到的信念状态几何表示（单纯形结构），这是机制可解释性的核心问题。
AI.method: 提出一个发现候选单纯形结构子空间的流程：结合稀疏自编码器（SAEs）、SAE特征的k-子空间聚类，以及使用AANet进行单纯形拟合。在已知信念状态几何的多部分隐藏马尔可夫模型上验证流程，然后应用于Gemma-2-9B模型。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2-9B中识别出13个优先级簇（K≥3）表现出候选单纯形几何。通过重心预测测试，3个簇在近顶点样本上表现出显著优势（Wilcoxon p<10^{-14}），4个在单纯形内部样本上表现良好。共5个不同的真实簇至少通过一个分割测试，而零簇均未通过。簇768_596还获得了最高的因果导向分数。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为Gemma-2-9B表示空间中存在真正的信念状几何提供了初步证据，但需要结构化评估来确认这一解释。研究强调了区分真实信念状态编码与平铺伪影的重要性，并提出了重心预测作为主要判别测试。

title: Beyond Semantic Manipulation: Token-Space Attacks on Reward Models
summary: Reward models (RMs) are widely used as optimization targets in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), yet they remain vulnerable to reward hacking.
