Existing attacks mainly operate within the semantic space, constructing human-readable adversarial outputs that exploit RM biases. In this work, we introduce a fundamentally different paradigm: Token Mapping Perturbation Attack (TOMPA), a framework that performs adversarial optimization directly in token space. By bypassing the standard decode-re-tokenize interface between the policy and the reward model, TOMPA enables the attack policy to optimize over raw token sequences rather than coherent natural language. Using only black-box scalar feedback, TOMPA automatically discovers non-linguistic token patterns that elicit extremely high rewards across multiple state-of-the-art RMs. Specifically, when targeting Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B, TOMPA nearly doubles the reward of GPT-5 reference answers and outperforms them on 98.0% of prompts. Despite these high scores, the generated outputs degenerate into nonsensical text, revealing that RMs can be systematically exploited beyond the semantic regime and exposing a critical vulnerability in current RLHF pipelines.

AI.tldr: TOMPA是一种直接在词元空间进行对抗优化的攻击框架，通过绕过策略与奖励模型之间的解码-重新词元化接口，利用黑盒标量反馈发现能获得极高奖励的非语言词元模式，揭示了当前RLHF流程中的关键漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型攻击主要在语义空间进行，构建人类可读的对抗输出以利用奖励模型偏差。本研究旨在探索一种根本不同的范式：直接在词元空间进行对抗优化，以揭示奖励模型在语义空间之外的系统性可被利用性。
AI.method: 提出Token Mapping Perturbation Attack (TOMPA)框架，绕过策略与奖励模型之间的标准解码-重新词元化接口，使攻击策略能够在原始词元序列而非连贯自然语言上进行优化。仅使用黑盒标量反馈，自动发现能引发极高奖励的非语言词元模式。
AI.result: 针对Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B模型，TOMPA几乎将GPT-5参考答案的奖励翻倍，并在98.0%的提示上优于GPT-5。尽管获得高分，生成的输出退化为无意义文本，表明奖励模型可以在语义体系之外被系统性利用。
AI.conclusion: TOMPA揭示了当前RLHF流程中的关键漏洞：奖励模型不仅容易受到语义空间攻击，还能在词元空间被系统性利用，生成无意义但获得高奖励的文本，这对基于奖励模型的RLHF系统的安全性提出了重要挑战。

title: Adaptive Semantic Communication for Wireless Image Transmission Leveraging Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
summary: Deep learning based semantic communication has achieved significant progress in wireless image transmission, but most existing schemes rely on fixed models and thus lack robustness to diverse image contents and dynamic channel conditions. To improve adaptability, recent studies have developed adaptive semantic communication strategies that adjust transmission or model behavior according to either source content or channel state. More recently, MoE-based semantic communication has emerged as a sparse and efficient adaptive architecture, although existing designs still mainly rely on single-driven routing. To address this limitation, we propose a novel multi-stage end-to-end image semantic communication system for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) channels, built upon an adaptive MoE Swin Transformer block. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic expert gating mechanism that jointly evaluates both real-time CSI and the semantic content of input image patches to compute adaptive routing probabilities. By selectively activating only a specialized subset of experts based on this joint condition, our approach breaks the rigid coupling of traditional adaptive methods and overcomes the bottlenecks of single-driven routing. Simulation results indicate a significant improvement in reconstruction quality over existing methods while maintaining the transmission efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于自适应MoE Swin Transformer的多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，通过联合评估CSI和图像语义内容的动态专家门控机制，实现更高效的MIMO信道传输。
AI.motivation: 现有语义通信方案大多依赖固定模型，缺乏对多样化图像内容和动态信道条件的鲁棒性。虽然已有自适应策略根据源内容或信道状态调整传输行为，但现有MoE方案仍主要依赖单驱动路由，存在局限性。
AI.method: 构建基于自适应MoE Swin Transformer块的多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，引入动态专家门控机制，联合评估实时CSI和输入图像块的语义内容来计算自适应路由概率，仅基于联合条件激活专家子集。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，相比现有方法在保持传输效率的同时，重建质量有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多驱动路由方法打破了传统自适应方法的刚性耦合，克服了单驱动路由的瓶颈，实现了更高效的MIMO信道语义通信。

title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant paradigm for scaling large language models, but their rapidly growing parameter sizes introduce a fundamental inefficiency during inference: most expert weights remain idle in GPU memory while competing with performance-critical runtime state such as the key-value (KV) cache. Since KV cache capacity directly determines serving throughput, this mismatch leads to underutilized memory and degraded performance. In this paper, we present FluxMoE, a new MoE inference system that decouples expert parameters from persistent GPU residency. FluxMoE introduces an expert paging abstraction that treats expert weights as streamed, transient resources, materializing them on demand and evicting them immediately after use, allowing GPU memory to be preferentially allocated to throughput-critical runtime state. We implement FluxMoE atop vLLM to enable efficient MoE inference under severe memory constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that FluxMoE achieves up to 3.0$\times$ throughput gains over vLLM in memory-intensive regimes, without compromising model fidelity.

AI.tldr: FluxMoE是一个新的MoE推理系统，通过专家分页抽象将专家权重从GPU常驻内存中解耦，按需加载和驱逐，优先分配内存给KV缓存，在内存受限环境下实现高达3倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: MoE模型参数规模快速增长导致推理时存在根本性低效：大多数专家权重在GPU内存中闲置，同时与性能关键运行时状态（如KV缓存）竞争内存。由于KV缓存容量直接决定服务吞吐量，这种不匹配导致内存利用不足和性能下降。
AI.method: FluxMoE引入专家分页抽象，将专家权重视为流式、瞬态资源，按需物化并在使用后立即驱逐，允许GPU内存优先分配给吞吐量关键的运行时状态。系统基于vLLM实现，支持内存受限环境下的高效MoE推理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FluxMoE在内存密集型场景下相比vLLM实现高达3.0倍的吞吐量提升，且不损害模型保真度。
AI.conclusion: FluxMoE通过解耦专家参数与GPU常驻内存，解决了MoE推理中的内存效率瓶颈，为大规模MoE模型部署提供了高效的内存管理方案。

title: Generative Frontiers: Why Evaluation Matters for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models have seen exciting recent progress, offering far more flexibility in generative trajectories than autoregressive models. This flexibility has motivated a growing body of research into new approaches to diffusion language modeling, which typically begins at the scale of GPT-2 small (150 million parameters). However, these advances introduce new issues with evaluation methodology. In this technical note, we discuss the limitations of current methodology and propose principled augmentations to ensure reliable comparisons. We first discuss why OpenWebText has become the standard benchmark, and why alternatives such as LM1B are inherently less meaningful. We then discuss the limitations of likelihood evaluations for diffusion models, and explain why relying on generative perplexity alone as a metric can lead to uninformative results. To address this, we show that generative perplexity and entropy are two components of the KL divergence to a reference distribution. This decomposition explains generative perplexity's sensitivity to entropy, and naturally suggests generative frontiers as a principled method for evaluating model generative quality. We conclude with empirical observations on model quality at this scale. We include a blog post with interactive content to illustrate the argument at https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/blog/eval_methodology/.

AI.tldr: 该技术笔记讨论了扩散语言模型评估方法的局限性，提出了基于KL散度分解的生成前沿作为更可靠的评估指标
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在生成轨迹上比自回归模型更灵活，但现有评估方法存在局限性，需要更可靠的比较方法
AI.method: 分析当前评估方法的局限性，提出将生成困惑度和熵作为KL散度的两个组成部分，建议使用生成前沿作为评估模型生成质量的原则性方法
AI.result: 揭示了生成困惑度对熵的敏感性，提出了生成前沿作为更可靠的评估指标，并在GPT-2小规模（1.5亿参数）尺度上提供了实证观察
AI.conclusion: 需要采用更原则性的评估方法来可靠比较扩散语言模型，生成前沿提供了更好的生成质量评估框架

title: Understanding Latent Diffusability via Fisher Geometry
summary: Diffusion models often degrade when trained in latent spaces (e.g., VAEs), yet the formal causes remain poorly understood. We quantify latent-space diffusability through the rate of change of the Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) along the diffusion trajectory. Our framework decomposes this MMSE rate into contributions from Fisher Information (FI) and Fisher Information Rate (FIR). We demonstrate that while global isometry ensures FI alignment, FIR is governed by the encoder's local geometric properties. Our analysis explicitly decouples latent geometric distortion into three measurable penalties: dimensional compression, tangential distortion, and curvature injection. We derive theoretical conditions for FIR preservation across spaces, ensuring maintained diffusability. Experiments across diverse autoencoding architectures validate our framework and establish these efficient FI and FIR metrics as a robust diagnostic suite for identifying and mitigating latent diffusion failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个理论框架，通过MMSE变化率量化潜在空间扩散性，将其分解为Fisher信息和Fisher信息率，识别潜在几何失真对扩散模型性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在潜在空间（如VAEs）训练时性能下降，但其根本原因尚不明确。需要量化潜在空间的可扩散性，并理解几何失真如何影响扩散过程。
AI.method: 通过最小均方误差变化率量化潜在空间扩散性，将其分解为Fisher信息和Fisher信息率。分析编码器局部几何特性对FIR的影响，将潜在几何失真分解为三个可测量惩罚项：维度压缩、切向失真和曲率注入。
AI.result: 建立了跨空间FIR保持的理论条件，确保扩散性维持。在不同自编码架构上的实验验证了该框架，并证明FI和FIR指标可作为识别和缓解潜在扩散失败的稳健诊断工具。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个理论框架，通过量化潜在空间几何失真对扩散过程的影响，解释了潜在空间扩散模型性能下降的原因，并为改进潜在空间扩散模型提供了诊断工具。

title: Towards Realistic Class-Incremental Learning with Free-Flow Increments
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) is typically evaluated under predefined schedules with equal-sized tasks, leaving more realistic and complex cases unexplored. However, a practical CIL system should learns immediately when any number of new classes arrive, without forcing fixed-size tasks. We formalize this setting as Free-Flow Class-Incremental Learning (FFCIL), where data arrives as a more realistic stream with a highly variable number of unseen classes each step. It will make many existing CIL methods brittle and lead to clear performance degradation. We propose a model-agnostic framework for robust CIL learning under free-flow arrivals. It comprises a class-wise mean (CWM) objective that replaces sample frequency weighted loss with uniformly aggregated class-conditional supervision, thereby stabilizing the learning signal across free-flow class increments, as well as method-wise adjustments that improve robustness for representative CIL paradigms. Specifically, we constrain distillation to replayed data, normalize the scale of contrastive and knowledge transfer losses, and introduce Dynamic Intervention Weight Alignment (DIWA) to prevent over-adjustment caused by unstable statistics from small class increments. Experiments confirm a clear performance degradation across various CIL baselines under FFCIL, while our strategies yield consistent gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了自由流类增量学习(FFCIL)新范式，针对现实场景中类别数量高度变化的增量学习问题，提出类平均目标(CWM)和多种方法调整策略，显著提升了现有CIL方法在自由流场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有类增量学习(CIL)研究通常在预定义、等大小任务的简化场景下评估，而现实场景中数据流通常包含高度变化的类别数量。这种自由流场景会使现有CIL方法变得脆弱并导致性能显著下降，因此需要研究更实用的自由流类增量学习(FFCIL)问题。
AI.method: 提出了模型无关的FFCIL框架：1) 类平均目标(CWM)，用均匀聚合的类条件监督替代样本频率加权损失，稳定自由流类别增量下的学习信号；2) 针对代表性CIL范式的调整策略：约束蒸馏到回放数据、归一化对比和知识转移损失的尺度、引入动态干预权重对齐(DIWA)防止小类别增量导致的统计不稳定和过度调整。
AI.result: 实验证实各种CIL基线方法在FFCIL场景下均出现明显性能下降，而论文提出的策略在所有基线方法上均带来一致性能提升，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文形式化了自由流类增量学习(FFCIL)这一更现实的增量学习场景，提出的类平均目标和多种调整策略能够有效提升现有CIL方法在自由流场景下的鲁棒性，为实际应用中的增量学习系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: Extracting Money Laundering Transactions from Quasi-Temporal Graph Representation
summary: Money laundering presents a persistent challenge for financial institutions worldwide, while criminal organizations constantly evolve their tactics to bypass detection systems. Traditional anti-money laundering approaches mainly rely on predefined risk-based rules, leading to resource-intensive investigations and high numbers of false positive alerts. In order to restrict operational costs from exploding, while billions of transactions are being processed every day, financial institutions are investing in more sophisticated mechanisms to improve existing systems. In this paper, we present ExSTraQt (EXtract Suspicious TRAnsactions from Quasi-Temporal graph representation), an advanced supervised learning approach to detect money laundering (or suspicious) transactions in financial datasets. Our proposed framework excels in performance, when compared to the state-of-the-art AML (Anti Money Laundering) detection models. The key strengths of our framework are sheer simplicity, in terms of design and number of parameters; and scalability, in terms of the computing and memory requirements. We evaluated our framework on transaction-level detection accuracy using a real dataset; and a set of synthetic financial transaction datasets. We consistently achieve an uplift in the F1 score for most datasets, up to 1% for the real dataset; and more than 8% for one of the synthetic datasets. We also claim that our framework could seamlessly complement existing AML detection systems in banks. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/mhaseebtariq/exstraqt.

AI.tldr: ExSTraQt：一种基于准时序图表示的监督学习框架，用于检测金融交易中的洗钱活动，相比现有方法在性能和可扩展性方面均有提升。
AI.motivation: 传统反洗钱方法主要依赖预定义的风险规则，导致调查资源密集且误报率高。金融机构需要更复杂的机制来改进现有系统，以控制运营成本并提高检测效率。
AI.method: 提出ExSTraQt框架，采用准时序图表示提取可疑交易，是一种先进的监督学习方法。框架设计简单、参数少，计算和内存需求具有可扩展性。
AI.result: 在真实数据集和合成金融交易数据集上评估，相比最先进的AML检测模型，F1分数均有提升：真实数据集提升达1%，合成数据集提升超过8%。
AI.conclusion: ExSTraQt框架在检测洗钱交易方面表现出色，设计简单、可扩展性强，能够无缝补充银行现有的AML检测系统。

title: Efficient Logistic Regression with Mixture of Sigmoids
summary: This paper studies the Exponential Weights (EW) algorithm with an isotropic Gaussian prior for online logistic regression. We show that the near-optimal worst-case regret bound $O(d\log(Bn))$ for EW, established by Kakade and Ng (2005) against the best linear predictor of norm at most $B$, can be achieved with total worst-case computational complexity $O(B^3 n^5)$. This substantially improves on the $O(B^{18}n^{37})$ complexity of prior work achieving the same guarantee (Foster et al., 2018). Beyond efficiency, we analyze the large-$B$ regime under linear separability: after rescaling by $B$, the EW posterior converges as $B\to\infty$ to a standard Gaussian truncated to the version cone. Accordingly, the predictor converges to a solid-angle vote over separating directions and, on every fixed-margin slice of this cone, the mode of the corresponding truncated Gaussian is aligned with the hard-margin SVM direction. Using this geometry, we derive non-asymptotic regret bounds showing that once $B$ exceeds a margin-dependent threshold, the regret becomes independent of $B$ and grows only logarithmically with the inverse margin. Overall, our results show that EW can be both computationally tractable and geometrically adaptive in online classification.

AI.tldr: 指数权重算法在线性可分情况下，通过各向同性高斯先验实现O(d log(Bn))遗憾界，计算复杂度从O(B¹⁸n³⁷)大幅降至O(B³n⁵)，并在大B极限下收敛到截断高斯分布，与硬间隔SVM方向对齐。
AI.motivation: 研究指数权重算法在线性逻辑回归中的计算效率问题，解决先前工作计算复杂度极高（O(B¹⁸n³⁷)）的瓶颈，同时探索在线性可分情况下算法的几何适应性。
AI.method: 采用各向同性高斯先验的指数权重算法，分析其在线性可分大B极限下的后验分布收敛行为，证明其收敛到版本锥上的截断标准高斯分布，并建立与硬间隔SVM的几何联系。
AI.result: 将计算复杂度从O(B¹⁸n³⁷)大幅降低到O(B³n⁵)，同时保持O(d log(Bn))的近似最优遗憾界。在线性可分情况下，当B超过间隔依赖阈值时，遗憾界与B无关，仅随逆间隔对数增长。
AI.conclusion: 指数权重算法可以在保持近似最优遗憾界的同时实现计算可行性，并在在线分类中展现出几何适应性，特别是在线性可分情况下能自适应地收敛到硬间隔SVM方向。

title: Explainable Machine Learning Reveals 12-Fold Ucp1 Upregulation and Thermogenic Reprogramming in Female Mouse White Adipose Tissue After 37 Days of Microgravity: First AI/ML Analysis of NASA OSD-970
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. First AI/ML analysis of NASA OSD-970 (GLDS-790). Code available at https://github.com/Rashadul22/NASA_OSD970_Complete_Output
summary: Microgravity induces profound metabolic adaptations in mammalian physiology, yet the molecular mechanisms governing thermogenesis in female white adipose tissue (WAT) remain poorly characterized. This paper presents the first machine learning (ML) analysis of NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) dataset OSD-970, derived from the Rodent Research-1 (RR-1) mission. Using RT-qPCR data from 89 adipogenesis and thermogenesis pathway genes in gonadal WAT of 16 female C57BL/6J mice (8 flight, 8 ground control) following 37 days aboard the International Space Station (ISS), we applied differential expression analysis, multiple ML classifiers with Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV), and Explainable AI via SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). The most striking finding is a dramatic 12.21-fold upregulation of Ucp1 (Delta-Delta-Ct = -3.61, p = 0.0167) in microgravity-exposed WAT, accompanied by significant activation of the thermogenesis pathway (mean pathway fold-change = 3.24). The best-performing model (Random Forest with top-20 features) achieved AUC = 0.922, Accuracy = 0.812, and F1 = 0.824 via LOO-CV. SHAP analysis consistently ranked Ucp1 among the top predictive features, while Angpt2, Irs2, Jun, and Klf-family transcription factors emerged as dominant consensus classifiers. Principal component analysis (PCA) revealed clear separation between flight and ground samples, with PC1 explaining 69.1% of variance. These results suggest rapid thermogenic reprogramming in female WAT as a compensatory response to microgravity. This study demonstrates the power of explainable AI for re-analysis of newly released NASA space biology datasets, with direct implications for female astronaut health on long-duration missions and for Earth-based obesity and metabolic disease research.

AI.tldr: 首次应用机器学习分析NASA太空生物学数据，发现微重力环境下雌性小鼠白色脂肪组织中Ucp1基因表达显著上调12.21倍，表明微重力诱导快速产热重编程作为代偿反应。
AI.motivation: 微重力对哺乳动物生理产生深远代谢适应，但雌性白色脂肪组织产热的分子机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在利用机器学习重新分析NASA新发布的太空生物学数据集，揭示微重力对雌性脂肪组织产热通路的影响。
AI.method: 使用NASA OSD-970数据集（来自RR-1任务），分析16只雌性C57BL/6J小鼠（8只太空飞行，8只地面对照）性腺白色脂肪组织中89个脂肪生成和产热通路基因的RT-qPCR数据。应用差异表达分析、多种机器学习分类器（留一交叉验证）和可解释AI（SHAP分析）。
AI.result: 微重力暴露的白色脂肪组织中Ucp1基因表达显著上调12.21倍，产热通路平均上调3.24倍。最佳模型（随机森林，前20特征）AUC=0.922，准确率=0.812，F1=0.824。SHAP分析显示Ucp1是顶级预测特征，Angpt2、Irs2、Jun和Klf家族转录因子是主要分类器。PCA显示飞行与地面样本明显分离，PC1解释69.1%方差。
AI.conclusion: 微重力诱导雌性白色脂肪组织快速产热重编程，作为对微重力环境的代偿反应。研究展示了可解释AI在重新分析NASA太空生物学数据集中的强大能力，对长期太空任务中女性宇航员健康以及地球上的肥胖和代谢疾病研究具有直接意义。

title: Generating DDPM-based Samples from Tilted Distributions
summary: Given $n$ independent samples from a $d$-dimensional probability distribution, our aim is to generate diffusion-based samples from a distribution obtained by tilting the original, where the degree of tilt is parametrized by $θ\in \mathbb{R}^d$. We define a plug-in estimator and show that it is minimax-optimal. We develop Wasserstein bounds between the distribution of the plug-in estimator and the true distribution as a function of $n$ and $θ$, illustrating regimes where the output and the desired true distribution are close. Further, under some assumptions, we prove the TV-accuracy of running Diffusion on these tilted samples. Our theoretical results are supported by extensive simulations. Applications of our work include finance, weather and climate modelling, and many other domains, where the aim may be to generate samples from a tilted distribution that satisfies practically motivated moment constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型的倾斜分布采样方法，通过插件估计器实现最小最大最优性，并建立Wasserstein距离和TV精度理论保证
AI.motivation: 在金融、天气气候建模等领域，需要从满足特定矩约束的倾斜分布中生成样本。现有方法缺乏理论保证，需要开发具有理论保证的扩散采样方法
AI.method: 提出插件估计器方法，从原始分布中采样，通过参数θ控制倾斜程度。建立Wasserstein距离理论界，分析插件估计器分布与真实分布的关系，并在一定假设下证明扩散过程的TV精度
AI.result: 证明插件估计器具有最小最大最优性，建立了n和θ的函数形式的Wasserstein距离理论界，识别了输出与真实分布接近的机制，并在假设下证明了扩散采样的TV精度
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从倾斜分布中生成样本提供了理论保证的扩散采样框架，在金融、天气气候建模等领域有广泛应用前景，并通过大量模拟验证了理论结果

title: Co-Evolution of Policy and Internal Reward for Language Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents learn by interacting with environments, but long-horizon training remains fundamentally bottlenecked by sparse and delayed rewards. Existing methods typically address this challenge through post-hoc credit assignment or external reward models, which provide limited guidance at inference time and often separate reward improvement from policy improvement. We propose Self-Guide, a self-generated internal reward for language agents that supports both inference-time guidance and training-time supervision. Specifically, the agent uses Self-Guide as a short self-guidance signal to steer the next action during inference, and converts the same signal into step-level internal reward for denser policy optimization during training. This creates a co-evolving loop: better policy produces better guidance, and better guidance further improves policy as internal reward. Across three agent benchmarks, inference-time self-guidance already yields clear gains, while jointly evolving policy and internal reward with GRPO brings further improvements (8\%) over baselines trained solely with environment reward. Overall, our results suggest that language agents can improve not only by collecting more experience, but also by learning to generate and refine their own internal reward during acting and learning.

AI.tldr: Self-Guide：为语言智能体提出的自生成内部奖励方法，支持推理时引导和训练时监督，通过策略与内部奖励的协同进化提升性能
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体通过与环境的交互学习，但长时程训练面临稀疏和延迟奖励的根本瓶颈。现有方法通常通过事后信用分配或外部奖励模型解决，这些方法在推理时提供有限指导，且往往将奖励改进与策略改进分离。
AI.method: 提出Self-Guide方法，智能体使用自生成的内部奖励作为短期自引导信号在推理时引导下一步行动，并将相同信号转换为步级内部奖励用于训练时更密集的策略优化。这创建了协同进化循环：更好的策略产生更好的引导，更好的引导作为内部奖励进一步改进策略。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准测试中，推理时自引导已带来明显收益，而使用GRPO联合进化策略和内部奖励相比仅使用环境奖励训练的基线带来进一步8%的改进。
AI.conclusion: 语言智能体不仅可以通过收集更多经验改进，还可以通过在行动和学习过程中学习生成和优化自己的内部奖励来提升性能。

title: Self-Distilled RLVR
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a popular training paradigm in the LLM community. This paradigm selects a larger model as the teacher to provide dense, fine-grained signals for each sampled trajectory, in contrast to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), which only obtains sparse signals from verifiable outcomes in the environment. Recently, the community has explored on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where the same model serves as both teacher and student, with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as reference answers to enable self-evolution. This paper demonstrates that learning signals solely derived from the privileged teacher result in severe information leakage and unstable long-term training. Accordingly, we identify the optimal niche for self-distillation and propose \textbf{RLSD} (\textbf{RL}VR with \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{D}istillation). Specifically, we leverage self-distillation to obtain token-level policy differences for determining fine-grained update magnitudes, while continuing to use RLVR to derive reliable update directions from environmental feedback (e.g., response correctness). This enables RLSD to simultaneously harness the strengths of both RLVR and OPSD, achieving a higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability.

AI.tldr: 提出RLSD方法，结合RLVR的可靠更新方向和OPSD的细粒度更新幅度，解决纯自蒸馏的信息泄露和不稳定问题
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：纯基于特权教师的自蒸馏会导致信息泄露和训练不稳定，而仅依赖环境反馈的RLVR只能获得稀疏信号
AI.method: 提出RLSD方法，结合RLVR和自蒸馏的优势：使用自蒸馏获得token级策略差异来确定细粒度更新幅度，同时继续使用RLVR从环境反馈中获取可靠的更新方向
AI.result: RLSD能够同时利用RLVR和OPSD的优势，实现更高的收敛上限和更好的训练稳定性
AI.conclusion: RLSD方法通过将自蒸馏用于确定更新幅度、RLVR用于确定更新方向，找到了自蒸馏的最佳应用场景，解决了现有方法的局限性

title: Understanding the Role of Hallucination in Reinforcement Post-Training of Multimodal Reasoning Models
summary: The recent success of reinforcement learning (RL) in large reasoning models has inspired the growing adoption of RL for post-training Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enhance their visual reasoning capabilities. Although many studies have reported improved performance, it remains unclear whether RL training truly enables models to learn from visual information. In this work, we propose the Hallucination-as-Cue Framework, an analytical framework designed to investigate the effects of RL-based post-training on multimodal reasoning models from the perspective of model hallucination. Specifically, we introduce hallucination-inductive, modality-specific corruptions that remove or replace essential information required to derive correct answers, thereby forcing the model to reason by hallucination. By applying these corruptions during both training and evaluation, our framework provides a unique perspective for diagnosing RL training dynamics and understanding the intrinsic properties of datasets. Through extensive experiments and analyses across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks, we reveal that the role of model hallucination for RL-training is more significant than previously recognized. For instance, we find that RL post-training under purely hallucination-inductive settings can still significantly improve models' reasoning performance, and in some cases even outperform standard training. These findings challenge prevailing assumptions about MLLM reasoning training and motivate the development of more modality-aware RL-based training designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了幻觉作为线索框架，用于分析RL后训练对多模态大语言模型视觉推理能力的影响，通过引入幻觉诱导的模态特定破坏来研究模型是否真正从视觉信息中学习。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习在多模态大语言模型后训练中广泛应用且报告了性能提升，但尚不清楚RL训练是否真正使模型从视觉信息中学习。需要一种分析框架来研究RL后训练对多模态推理模型的影响，特别是从模型幻觉的角度。
AI.method: 提出幻觉作为线索框架，引入幻觉诱导的模态特定破坏，移除或替换推导正确答案所需的关键信息，迫使模型通过幻觉进行推理。在训练和评估阶段应用这些破坏，为诊断RL训练动态和理解数据集内在特性提供独特视角。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准测试中的广泛实验和分析表明，模型幻觉在RL训练中的作用比先前认识到的更为重要。在纯幻觉诱导设置下进行RL后训练仍能显著提升模型推理性能，在某些情况下甚至优于标准训练。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了关于MLLM推理训练的普遍假设，并激励开发更具模态感知的基于RL的训练设计。幻觉作为线索框架为理解RL后训练对多模态模型的影响提供了新的分析工具。

title: Reflective Context Learning: Studying the Optimization Primitives of Context Space
comment: Under review at COLM. Github: https://github.com/nvassilyev/RCL
summary: Generally capable agents must learn from experience in ways that generalize across tasks and environments. The fundamental problems of learning, including credit assignment, overfitting, forgetting, local optima, and high-variance learning signals, persist whether the learned object lies in parameter space or context space. While these challenges are well understood in classical machine learning optimization, they remain underexplored in context space, leading current methods to be fragmented and ad hoc. We present Reflective Context Learning (RCL), a unified framework for agents that learn through repeated interaction, reflection on behavior and failure modes, and iterative updates to context. In RCL, reflection converts trajectories and current context into a directional update signal analogous to gradients, while mutation applies that signal to improve future behavior in context space. We recast recent context-optimization approaches as instances of this shared learning problem and systematically extend them with classical optimization primitives, including batching, improved credit-assignment signal, auxiliary losses, failure replay, and grouped rollouts for variance reduction. On AppWorld, BrowseComp+, and RewardBench2, these primitives improve over strong baselines, with their relative importance shifting across task regimes. We further analyze robustness to initialization, the effects of batch size, sampling and curriculum strategy, optimizer-state variants, and the impact of allocating stronger or weaker models to different optimization components. Our results suggest that learning through context updates should be treated not as a set of isolated algorithms, but as an optimization problem whose mechanisms can be studied systematically and improved through transferable principles.

AI.tldr: RCL是一个统一框架，将上下文学习视为优化问题，通过反思和突变机制改进上下文空间中的学习，并系统应用经典优化原语提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前上下文学习方法零散且临时，未充分探索学习中的基本问题（信用分配、过拟合、遗忘、局部最优、高方差学习信号等），需要统一框架来系统改进。
AI.method: 提出反思性上下文学习(RCL)框架：反思机制将轨迹和当前上下文转换为类似梯度的方向性更新信号，突变机制应用该信号改进上下文空间中的未来行为。将现有方法重新表述为此共享学习问题实例，并系统引入批处理、改进信用分配信号、辅助损失、失败回放、分组rollouts等经典优化原语。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、BrowseComp+和RewardBench2上，这些优化原语显著提升了强基线的性能，且不同任务机制下各原语的重要性不同。分析了初始化鲁棒性、批量大小影响、采样和课程策略、优化器状态变体以及不同强度模型分配的影响。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习不应被视为孤立算法集合，而应作为优化问题处理，其机制可通过可转移原则进行系统研究和改进。RCL为此提供了统一框架。

title: Gradient Boosting within a Single Attention Layer
summary: Transformer attention computes a single softmax-weighted average over values -- a one-pass estimate that cannot correct its own errors. We introduce \emph{gradient-boosted attention}, which applies the principle of gradient boosting \emph{within} a single attention layer: a second attention pass, with its own learned projections, attends to the prediction error of the first and applies a gated correction. Under a squared reconstruction objective, the construction maps onto Friedman's gradient boosting machine, with each attention pass as a base learner and the per-dimension gate as the shrinkage parameter. We show that a single Hopfield-style update erases all query information orthogonal to the stored-pattern subspace, and that further iteration under local contraction can collapse distinct queries in the same region to the same fixed point. We also show that separate projections for the correction pass can recover residual information inaccessible to the shared-projection approach of Tukey's twicing. On a 10M-token subset of WikiText-103, gradient-boosted attention achieves a test perplexity of $67.9$ compared to $72.2$ for standard attention, $69.6$ for Twicing Attention, and $69.0$ for a parameter-matched wider baseline, with two rounds capturing most of the benefit.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度提升注意力机制，在单层注意力中引入梯度提升思想：第二遍注意力关注第一遍的预测误差并进行门控校正，显著降低语言建模困惑度。
AI.motivation: 传统Transformer注意力通过单次softmax加权平均计算值，这种一次性估计无法自我校正错误。需要一种机制能够在注意力层内部进行误差校正。
AI.method: 提出梯度提升注意力：1）第一遍标准注意力计算；2）第二遍注意力关注第一遍的预测误差，使用独立学习的投影；3）通过逐维度门控进行校正。该方法将梯度提升思想映射到注意力机制中，每个注意力遍作为基础学习器，门控作为收缩参数。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103的10M token子集上，梯度提升注意力测试困惑度为67.9，优于标准注意力(72.2)、Twicing注意力(69.6)和参数匹配的加宽基线(69.0)。两轮注意力即可获得大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: 梯度提升注意力通过引入内部校正机制有效提升了注意力性能，将梯度提升原理成功应用于注意力机制设计，为注意力架构改进提供了新思路。

title: Hierarchical Planning with Latent World Models
summary: Model predictive control (MPC) with learned world models has emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control, particularly for its ability to generalize zero-shot when deployed in new environments. However, learned world models often struggle with long-horizon control due to the accumulation of prediction errors and the exponentially growing search space. In this work, we address these challenges by learning latent world models at multiple temporal scales and performing hierarchical planning across these scales, enabling long-horizon reasoning while substantially reducing inference-time planning complexity. Our approach serves as a modular planning abstraction that applies across diverse latent world-model architectures and domains. We demonstrate that this hierarchical approach enables zero-shot control on real-world non-greedy robotic tasks, achieving a 70% success rate on pick-&-place using only a final goal specification, compared to 0% for a single-level world model. In addition, across physics-based simulated environments including push manipulation and maze navigation, hierarchical planning achieves higher success while requiring up to 4x less planning-time compute.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种分层规划方法，通过在多时间尺度上学习潜在世界模型，解决学习世界模型在长时域控制中预测误差累积和搜索空间指数增长的问题。
AI.motivation: 基于学习世界模型的模型预测控制（MPC）在具身控制中表现出色，特别是在新环境中具有零样本泛化能力。然而，学习的世界模型在长时域控制中存在两个主要问题：1）预测误差的累积；2）搜索空间随规划时域呈指数增长。这些问题限制了学习世界模型在复杂、长时域任务中的应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层规划方法：1）在多时间尺度上学习潜在世界模型；2）在这些尺度上进行分层规划。这种方法作为一个模块化的规划抽象，适用于多种潜在世界模型架构和领域。通过在不同时间尺度上进行规划，实现了长时域推理，同时显著降低了推理时的规划复杂度。
AI.result: 1）在真实世界非贪婪机器人任务中实现了零样本控制，在仅使用最终目标规格的情况下，拾取放置任务的成功率达到70%，而单层世界模型为0%；2）在物理模拟环境中（包括推动操作和迷宫导航），分层规划实现了更高的成功率，同时规划时间计算需求减少了最多4倍。
AI.conclusion: 分层规划方法通过在多时间尺度上学习世界模型并进行分层规划，有效解决了学习世界模型在长时域控制中的挑战。该方法不仅提高了任务成功率，还显著降低了规划复杂度，为基于学习世界模型的模型预测控制在复杂、长时域任务中的应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Enhancing Robustness of Federated Learning via Server Learning
summary: This paper explores the use of server learning for enhancing the robustness of federated learning against malicious attacks even when clients' training data are not independent and identically distributed. We propose a heuristic algorithm that uses server learning and client update filtering in combination with geometric median aggregation. We demonstrate via experiments that this approach can achieve significant improvement in model accuracy even when the fraction of malicious clients is high, even more than $50\%$ in some cases, and the dataset utilized by the server is small and could be synthetic with its distribution not necessarily close to that of the clients' aggregated data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合服务器学习和客户端更新过滤的联邦学习鲁棒性增强方法，能在非IID数据和高比例恶意客户端情况下显著提升模型精度
AI.motivation: 解决联邦学习在非独立同分布数据和恶意攻击下的鲁棒性问题，特别是在高比例恶意客户端情况下保护模型训练的安全性
AI.method: 提出启发式算法，结合服务器学习和客户端更新过滤，使用几何中位数聚合方法，服务器可使用小规模甚至合成数据集
AI.result: 实验证明该方法能显著提升模型精度，即使恶意客户端比例超过50%，且服务器数据集小、分布与客户端聚合数据不一定相近
AI.conclusion: 服务器学习与客户端更新过滤结合几何中位数聚合的方法能有效增强联邦学习对恶意攻击的鲁棒性，适用于非IID数据和高恶意比例场景
